screens.zh: 是否真按风险导向做审计，能从账里找出问题，而不是照着程序表打勾。
screens.en: Whether they audit risk-first and actually find issues in the numbers, instead of ticking through a program.

asks.zh: 收入这个科目你怎么设计审计程序，函证回不来你换什么办法？
asks.en: How do you design procedures over revenue, and what alternatives do you run when confirmations never come back?

asks.zh: 你怎么判断一家公司的存货跌价准备计提够不够？
asks.en: How do you judge whether an inventory write-down provision is adequate?

asks.zh: 讲一次你查出来的审计差异，最后和管理层怎么谈的？
asks.en: Walk me through an audit difference you found and how you settled it with management.

asks.zh: 重要性水平你怎么定，实质性程序的样本量怎么来的？
asks.en: How do you set materiality, and how do you size samples for substantive testing?

insider.zh: 强的人从业务实质倒推账务处理站不站得住，弱的人把底稿做齐就以为审完了。
insider.en: Strong auditors reason from business substance back to the accounting; weak ones think a complete workpaper file means the audit is done.

followups.zh: 管理层坚持不调整，你的底线在哪，出什么意见？
followups.en: Management refuses to adjust — where is your line, and what opinion do you issue?

followups.zh: 分析性程序做出来的偏差，你怎么分清是正常波动还是舞弊信号？
followups.en: When analytics throw a variance, how do you tell normal fluctuation from a fraud signal?

screens.zh: 能不能把经营数据做成管理层敢拿去做决策的预测，每个口径都说得清来源。
screens.en: Can they turn operating data into forecasts management will actually decide on, with every definition traceable.

asks.zh: 滚动预测你怎么搭，预算和实际差得远时你怎么归因？
asks.en: How do you build a rolling forecast, and how do you attribute a large budget-to-actual variance?

asks.zh: 三张表联动的模型你怎么做，现金流量表怎么和资产负债表对上？
asks.en: How do you build a three-statement model, and how does the cash flow statement tie back to the balance sheet?

asks.zh: 业务部门要上一个新项目，你怎么算回报、用什么口径把它拒掉？
asks.en: A business unit pitches a new project — how do you run the returns, and on what basis do you say no?

asks.zh: 讲一次你发现的成本异常，是怎么查出来的？
asks.en: A cost anomaly you caught — how did you find it?

insider.zh: 强的人讲得出每个数字的口径和假设从哪来，弱的人只会把系统导出的表拼在一起。
insider.en: Strong analysts can name the definition and source behind every number; weak ones just staple system exports together.

followups.zh: 预测和实际差了两成，复盘时你改的是假设还是模型？
followups.en: Off by twenty percent — did you fix the assumption or the model?

followups.zh: 销售口径和财务口径不一致，你对外报哪一个？
followups.en: Sales numbers and finance numbers disagree — which one do you report?

screens.zh: 风险计量的功底，以及能不能把限额定到业务愿意执行、又真兜得住的位置。
screens.en: Real measurement chops, plus limits the desk will actually respect and that still hold in a shock.

asks.zh: 风险价值和预期尾部损失你都用过吗，各自在什么情况下会失效？
asks.en: You have used both VaR and expected shortfall — where does each one break down?

asks.zh: 一个交易台连续贴着限额但没超，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A desk keeps running right up against its limit without breaching — what do you do?

asks.zh: 压力测试的情景你怎么设计，历史情景和假设情景怎么搭配？
asks.en: How do you design stress scenarios, and how do you mix historical with hypothetical ones?

asks.zh: 模型验证你怎么做，回溯检验的例外超标时怎么定性？
asks.en: How do you validate a model, and how do you conclude when backtesting exceptions exceed tolerance?

insider.zh: 强的人清楚模型在哪些假设下会崩、并提前备好替代口径，弱的人报一个数字却说不清置信水平和持有期。
insider.en: Strong risk managers know which assumptions blow up the model and bring a fallback; weak ones quote a number without the confidence level or holding period.

followups.zh: 前台说你的限额太紧、影响做生意，你怎么谈？
followups.en: The desk says your limits are strangling the business — how do you negotiate?

followups.zh: 压力期相关性集体上跳，你的分散化假设还成立吗？
followups.en: Correlations all jump toward one in a stress — does your diversification assumption survive?

screens.zh: 能不能把监管条文翻成可执行的控制点，也顶得住业务要放行的压力。
screens.en: Can they turn regulation into controls people can actually run, and hold the line when the business pushes.

asks.zh: 客户尽职调查里实际受益人你怎么认定，穿透不下去怎么办？
asks.en: How do you establish the ultimate beneficial owner in CDD, and what do you do when the structure won't unwrap?

asks.zh: 反洗钱监测规则误报太多，你怎么调阈值又不放过该报的？
asks.en: AML monitoring throws too many false positives — how do you tune without losing true hits?

asks.zh: 一笔可疑交易从发现到报送走哪几步，时限是什么？
asks.en: Walk a suspicious transaction from detection to filing — what are the steps and the deadlines?

asks.zh: 业务部门要做一个新产品，你的合规意见怎么出？
asks.en: The business wants to launch a new product — how do you write your compliance opinion?

insider.zh: 强的人分得清哪些是硬红线、哪些能用流程设计缓释，弱的人一律说不许做或者一律放行。
insider.en: Strong officers separate hard prohibitions from what process design can mitigate; weak ones either block everything or wave everything through.

followups.zh: 大客户被列入名单但业务已经开展，存量你怎么处置？
followups.en: A major client hits a sanctions list mid-relationship — what happens to the existing exposure?

followups.zh: 监管现场检查提出的问题，整改方案怎么写才不会被打回？
followups.en: After an on-site examination finding, how do you write a remediation plan that won't be sent back?

screens.zh: 定价和准备金评估的技术细节是否过硬，以及假设变一档对结果的影响说不说得清。
screens.en: Technical depth in pricing and reserving, and whether they can quantify what one notch of assumption change does.

asks.zh: 准备金你用哪几种方法评估，链梯法在什么情况下会失真？
asks.en: Which reserving methods do you run, and when does chain ladder mislead you?

asks.zh: 一款产品的费率怎么定，纯风险保费和附加费用怎么拆？
asks.en: How do you set a rate, and how do you split the risk premium from the expense and profit loading?

asks.zh: 赔付率或死亡率假设你怎么选，经验数据不够时怎么办？
asks.en: How do you pick a loss-ratio or mortality assumption when your own experience data is thin?

asks.zh: 新准则下的合同服务边际对你的定价假设有什么约束？
asks.en: Under IFRS 17, how does the contractual service margin constrain your pricing assumptions?

insider.zh: 强的人讲得清每个假设的来源和敏感度，弱的人只会跑一遍模型报出一个数。
insider.en: Strong actuaries can source and stress every assumption; weak ones just run the model and read out a number.

followups.zh: 准备金评估结果和管理层的利润目标差很多，你怎么谈？
followups.en: Your reserve indication is far off management's profit target — how do you handle that conversation?

followups.zh: 尾部长的险种，你怎么判断已发生未报案的估计够不够？
followups.en: On a long-tail line, how do you know your IBNR estimate is sufficient?

screens.zh: 能不能在风险和保费之间做出敢签字的判断，而不是一味拒保或者照单全收。
screens.en: Can they make a call they'll sign their name to, rather than declining everything or writing everything.

asks.zh: 一份高风险的投保申请，你会加什么条件、免赔和费率怎么定？
asks.en: A high-hazard submission comes in — what terms do you attach, and how do you set the deductible and rate?

asks.zh: 逆选择和道德风险的迹象你怎么识别？
asks.en: How do you spot adverse selection and moral hazard in a submission?

asks.zh: 再保安排对你的承保决定有什么影响，什么情况下必须分出去？
asks.en: How does the reinsurance program shape your decision, and when must you cede?

asks.zh: 讲一个你拒保、后来证明判断对了的案子，你当时看的是什么？
asks.en: A risk you declined that later proved you right — what did you see?

insider.zh: 强的人说得出自己签的单和整个组合赔付率的关系，弱的人只会按核保手册逐条打勾。
insider.en: Strong underwriters connect the risks they wrote to the loss ratio of the book; weak ones just tick down the guidelines.

followups.zh: 销售说这单不签客户就走，你怎么回？
followups.en: The producer says the client walks if you don't write it — what's your answer?

followups.zh: 同样一个风险续保时赔付变差了，你怎么调条件？
followups.en: Same risk, worse loss experience at renewal — how do you re-price or re-term it?

screens.zh: 定损准不准、认不认得出骗保，同时不把该赔的案子拖成投诉。
screens.en: Accurate loss estimates, an eye for fraud, and no valid claim left to fester into a complaint.

asks.zh: 一个赔案的定损金额你怎么核，和修理厂报价差很多时怎么办？
asks.en: How do you verify a loss estimate, and what happens when the repair shop's quote is far above it?

asks.zh: 哪些迹象会让你怀疑骗保，你怎么取证？
asks.en: Which indicators make you suspect fraud, and how do you build the evidence?

asks.zh: 保单责任范围有争议，你怎么向客户解释拒赔？
asks.en: Coverage is disputed — how do you explain a denial to the insured?

asks.zh: 手上案子压得多，你按什么顺序处理？
asks.en: Your desk is backed up — how do you sequence the files?

insider.zh: 强的人在赔付金额和客户关系之间找得到支点，弱的人要么好说话就赔、要么一律往拒赔上靠。
insider.en: Strong adjusters find the balance between indemnity and the relationship; weak ones either cave or reflexively deny.

followups.zh: 你拒赔的案子客户投诉到监管，卷宗里留了什么依据？
followups.en: The insured complains to the regulator about your denial — what's in the file to back you up?

followups.zh: 定损结论被复核推翻过吗，问题出在哪？
followups.en: Has a reviewer overturned your estimate, and what went wrong?

screens.zh: 有没有自己的判断和能被验证的推演，而不是把公司公告改写一遍。
screens.en: A real view with a falsifiable path to it, not a rewrite of the company's own disclosure.

asks.zh: 挑一家你覆盖的公司，讲你的盈利预测怎么搭、关键假设是哪两三个？
asks.en: Take a name you cover — how is your earnings model built, and what are the two or three assumptions that matter?

asks.zh: 你给它怎么估值，为什么用这个口径而不用市盈率？
asks.en: How do you value it, and why that method over a simple P/E?

asks.zh: 你和市场一致预期分歧最大的地方在哪，凭什么？
asks.en: Where do you differ most from consensus, and on what evidence?

asks.zh: 你的调研怎么做，除了管理层还问谁？
asks.en: How do you do your fieldwork — who besides management do you talk to?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清自己可能错在哪、什么信号会让他改观点，弱的人一路看多、目标价跟着股价改。
insider.en: Strong analysts name what would prove them wrong; weak ones stay bullish and move the target price after the stock.

followups.zh: 你的目标价隐含多少倍估值，历史区间在哪？
followups.en: What multiple does your target price imply, and where does that sit in its history?

followups.zh: 公司业绩证伪了你的假设，你多久调评级？
followups.en: Results break your assumption — how fast do you change the rating?

screens.zh: 能不能在关键节点给出有立场的判断，还带得动团队、扛得住机构客户的检验。
screens.en: A call with a stance at the moments that count, plus the standing to lead a team and survive institutional scrutiny.

asks.zh: 你今年最重要的一个判断是什么，逆着市场的地方在哪？
asks.en: Your most important call this year — where did it go against the market?

asks.zh: 团队里有人的观点和你相反，研报口径怎么处理？
asks.en: A team member's view contradicts yours — how do you handle what gets published?

asks.zh: 覆盖优先级你怎么排，人手不够时先放掉谁？
asks.en: How do you set coverage priorities, and what gets dropped when you're short-staffed?

asks.zh: 机构客户的排名和研究质量冲突时你怎么取舍？
asks.en: When client rankings and research quality pull apart, which way do you go?

insider.zh: 强的人有几个被验证过的成名判断和明确的框架，弱的人靠勤奋路演和维护关系撑住排名。
insider.en: Strong chiefs have a framework and a few calls the market remembers; weak ones hold their ranking on roadshow miles and relationships.

followups.zh: 你错得最贵的一次判断是什么，之后框架改了什么？
followups.en: Your costliest wrong call — what changed in your framework afterward?

followups.zh: 新人写的报告结论不成立，你是压下来还是让他发？
followups.en: A junior's conclusion doesn't hold up — do you kill it or let it publish?

screens.zh: 有没有可复述的投资框架，业绩归因说不说得清是能力还是行情。
screens.en: A framework they can restate, and attribution honest enough to separate skill from beta.

asks.zh: 你的超额收益来自哪里，做过归因吗，行业配置和个股选择各占多少？
asks.en: Where does your alpha come from — have you run attribution, and how does it split between allocation and selection?

asks.zh: 一只重仓股跌了三成，你怎么判断该加仓还是止损？
asks.en: A top holding is down thirty percent — how do you decide between adding and cutting?

asks.zh: 你的组合集中度和换手率是多少，为什么是这个水平？
asks.en: What are your concentration and turnover, and why at those levels?

asks.zh: 回撤最大的那段时间你做了什么？
asks.en: What did you actually do through your worst drawdown?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清自己的风格在什么市场里会吃亏并守住不漂移，弱的人业绩好时讲框架、业绩差时怪市场。
insider.en: Strong PMs know which regime punishes their style and refuse to drift; weak ones credit the framework when up and the market when down.

followups.zh: 规模变大之后策略容量还够吗，风格漂移过没有？
followups.en: As assets grew, did capacity hold — and did the style drift?

followups.zh: 卖出纪律是什么，上一次按纪律卖的是哪一笔？
followups.en: What's your sell discipline, and when did you last actually follow it?

screens.zh: 能不能给出可下手的建议，赔率、胜率和亏钱的情形都摆得出来。
screens.en: A recommendation you can act on, with the odds, the hit rate and the downside case spelled out.

asks.zh: 推一只你现在最有把握的股票，赔率和胜率你怎么算？
asks.en: Pitch your highest-conviction name — how do you frame the odds and the payoff?

asks.zh: 你和卖方分析师的分歧通常出在哪？
asks.en: Where do you typically diverge from the sell side?

asks.zh: 一家公司的利润和现金流长期背离，你会查哪几处？
asks.en: Earnings and cash flow diverge for years — where do you dig?

asks.zh: 你的推荐被基金经理否掉过吗，他质疑的是什么？
asks.en: A PM has killed one of your pitches — what was the objection?

insider.zh: 强的人先讲自己错的情形和触发条件，弱的人只讲逻辑不讲价格和赔率。
insider.en: Strong analysts lead with the bear case and its triggers; weak ones tell a story with no price and no odds.

followups.zh: 跌到什么位置说明你的逻辑错了？
followups.en: At what price do you conclude the thesis is wrong?

followups.zh: 你的调研有多少是一手的，见过几个上下游？
followups.en: How much of your work is primary — how many suppliers and customers have you met?

screens.zh: 是否真懂回测里的陷阱，做出来的因子在样本外和扣掉成本之后还站得住。
screens.en: Whether they know where backtests lie, and whether the factor survives out of sample and after costs.

asks.zh: 一个因子回测很漂亮，你怎么排除数据挖掘和幸存者偏差？
asks.en: A factor backtests beautifully — how do you rule out data snooping and survivorship bias?

asks.zh: 交易成本和市场冲击你怎么建模，策略容量怎么估？
asks.en: How do you model transaction costs and market impact, and how do you size strategy capacity?

asks.zh: 因子之间高度相关，你怎么做正交化和权重分配？
asks.en: Your factors are highly correlated — how do you orthogonalize and weight them?

asks.zh: 策略上线后收益衰减，你怎么判断是失效还是正常波动？
asks.en: Live performance decays — how do you tell alpha decay from normal variance?

insider.zh: 强的人先把前视偏差、样本外检验和成本假设摆出来，弱的人拿一条夏普比率很高的净值曲线来汇报。
insider.en: Strong researchers open with lookahead bias, out-of-sample design and cost assumptions; weak ones open with a high-Sharpe equity curve.

followups.zh: 你的样本外数据留了多长，反复用过没有？
followups.en: How much out-of-sample data did you hold back, and how many times have you touched it?

followups.zh: 换手率压一半，这个因子还剩多少收益？
followups.en: Halve the turnover — how much of the return is left?

screens.zh: 报价和库存管理的手感，以及亏钱时的纪律，这比赚钱的故事更能说明问题。
screens.en: Feel for quoting and inventory, and discipline when it goes against them — that tells more than the winning trades.

asks.zh: 做市时买卖价差怎么定，库存偏了你怎么调报价？
asks.en: How do you set your bid-ask, and how do you skew quotes when inventory gets one-sided?

asks.zh: 流动性突然消失、你手上还有大头寸，你怎么办？
asks.en: Liquidity vanishes while you're carrying size — what do you do?

asks.zh: 一笔大单进来，你怎么判断对手方是不是有信息优势？
asks.en: A large order hits you — how do you judge whether the flow is informed?

asks.zh: 你的止损纪律是什么，上一次触发是什么情况？
asks.en: What's your stop discipline, and when did it last trigger?

insider.zh: 强的人对自己的持仓风险和最差情形报得出数字，弱的人讲的全是赚钱的单子。
insider.en: Strong traders can quote their position risk and worst case; weak ones only narrate winners.

followups.zh: 你亏得最多的那一天发生了什么，之后改了什么？
followups.en: Your worst day — what happened, and what changed after?

followups.zh: 隔夜头寸的限额是多少，超了谁批？
followups.en: What's your overnight limit, and who signs off on a breach?

screens.zh: 能不能把市场观点讲成客户听得懂的交易机会，同时守住报价和额度。
screens.en: Can they turn a market view into a trade the client understands, while holding the price and the line.

asks.zh: 客户要做一个方向性头寸，你怎么给他配工具、把成本算清楚？
asks.en: A client wants directional exposure — how do you structure it and price the all-in cost?

asks.zh: 你手上的产品和客户的真实需求不匹配，你怎么处理？
asks.en: What you're pushing doesn't fit what the client actually needs — then what?

asks.zh: 市场剧烈波动那天你给客户打了几个电话，说的是什么？
asks.en: On the day the market gapped, how many clients did you call and what did you say?

asks.zh: 交易员给的价格客户嫌贵，中间你怎么协调？
asks.en: The trader's price is too wide for the client — how do you bridge it?

insider.zh: 强的人清楚客户的持仓和考核压力在哪，弱的人只会转发研究观点和报价单。
insider.en: Strong salespeople know the client's book and what they're measured on; weak ones forward research and axe sheets.

followups.zh: 客户做的交易亏了钱来找你，你怎么应对？
followups.en: A trade you sold went against the client and they're on the phone — how do you handle it?

followups.zh: 哪类客户你会主动少做，为什么？
followups.en: Which clients do you deliberately do less with, and why?

screens.zh: 尽调里能不能自己发现问题，也扛得住申报节奏和反馈意见的来回。
screens.en: Do they find the issues themselves in diligence, and can they carry a filing through rounds of comments.

asks.zh: 尽调里你发现过什么实质性问题，怎么核实、后来怎么处理？
asks.en: A substantive issue you surfaced in diligence — how did you verify it and how was it resolved?

asks.zh: 一家公司的收入和现金流对不上，你会查哪几处？
asks.en: Revenue and cash collection don't line up — which items do you go after?

asks.zh: 估值这块你怎么做，可比公司怎么选、什么时候相对估值不能用？
asks.en: How do you run valuation, how do you pick comps, and when does relative valuation stop working?

asks.zh: 监管的反馈意见你怎么回，最难的一条是什么？
asks.en: How do you respond to a regulator comment letter — what was the hardest question you got?

insider.zh: 强的人知道哪些问题会卡住申报并提前解决，弱的人只会按模板改材料和调表格。
insider.en: Strong associates know which issues stall a filing and clear them early; weak ones just update templates and tie out schedules.

followups.zh: 客户不愿意披露的事项，你怎么处理？
followups.en: The client won't disclose something — what do you do?

followups.zh: 项目做到一半发现硬伤，你怎么跟内核和客户说？
followups.en: You find a deal-breaker mid-process — how do you tell the committee and the client?

screens.zh: 能不能找到有真实融资需求又还得上钱的企业，并把方案组织到审批过得去。
screens.en: Can they find borrowers with real needs who can repay, and package credit that gets approved.

asks.zh: 一家企业的还款来源你怎么判断，看哪几张表、还看哪些表外信息？
asks.en: How do you assess a borrower's repayment source — which statements, and what do you look at outside them?

asks.zh: 抵押担保和信用方式怎么选，第二还款来源怎么落实？
asks.en: Secured versus clean credit — how do you choose, and how do you nail down the secondary source of repayment?

asks.zh: 讲一笔你做过的授信，风险点是什么、你加了哪些条件？
asks.en: Walk me through a facility you structured — the risks, and the covenants you attached.

asks.zh: 贷后发现企业经营变差，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Post-disbursement, the borrower's business deteriorates — what do you do?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清客户的资金链和上下游占款，弱的人只报规模、靠名单式营销。
insider.en: Strong bankers can trace the client's cash cycle and who is financing whom; weak ones report volume and work a list.

followups.zh: 你的客户里出过不良吗，事后看最早的信号是什么？
followups.en: Any of your credits go bad — with hindsight, what was the earliest signal?

followups.zh: 审批部门不批你的方案，你怎么改？
followups.en: Credit turns down your structure — how do you rework it?

screens.zh: 能不能在监管边界内把金融产品设计出来，风险成本和体验都算得清。
screens.en: Can they design a financial product inside the regulatory perimeter, with risk cost and experience both quantified.

asks.zh: 一款信贷产品的额度和定价怎么设计，风险成本怎么算进去？
asks.en: How do you set limits and price a credit product, and how does risk cost enter the pricing?

asks.zh: 你的产品涉及哪些持牌主体和资金流向，合规边界在哪？
asks.en: Which licensed entities and money flows does your product touch, and where's the regulatory boundary?

asks.zh: 反欺诈和通过率的矛盾你怎么处理，盯哪几个指标？
asks.en: Fraud controls versus approval rate — how do you trade off, and which metrics do you watch?

asks.zh: 支付链路上一笔钱要走哪些环节，哪里最容易出问题？
asks.en: Trace a payment end to end — which hop breaks most often?

insider.zh: 强的人算得清单位经济和风险成本，弱的人只讲用户增长和转化率。
insider.en: Strong PMs can walk the unit economics including risk cost; weak ones only talk growth and conversion.

followups.zh: 监管口径变了，你的产品要停掉哪一部分？
followups.en: The rules shift — which part of the product has to stop?

followups.zh: 坏账超预期时你先动定价还是先动客群？
followups.en: Losses run hot — do you move price first or the customer cut?

screens.zh: 能不能进到高净值客户的核心决策圈，把家族的资产、股权和传承一起接住。
screens.en: Can they get inside the family's decision circle and hold assets, ownership and succession together.

asks.zh: 你管的客户资产规模多大，财富来源结构是什么样的？
asks.en: How much do you manage, and what's the source-of-wealth mix?

asks.zh: 一个企业家客户的家族信托和股权安排，你从哪切入？
asks.en: An entrepreneur client needs a trust and shareholding plan — where do you start?

asks.zh: 客户重仓自己公司的股票，你怎么劝他分散？
asks.en: The client is concentrated in their own company's stock — how do you make the diversification case?

asks.zh: 客户在市场高点要加杠杆买入，你怎么处理？
asks.en: The client wants leverage at the top of the market — how do you handle it?

insider.zh: 强的人被客户当成家族事务的商量对象，弱的人只在有产品额度时才联系客户。
insider.en: Strong private bankers get consulted on family matters; weak ones call only when there's allocation to place.

followups.zh: 客户的下一代不认你，你怎么办？
followups.en: The next generation doesn't take your calls — what now?

followups.zh: 你推荐的产品亏了、客户要赎回，你怎么谈？
followups.en: A product you recommended is down and the client wants out — how do you talk it through?

screens.zh: 是按客户的风险承受能力做配置，还是跟着任务指标卖产品。
screens.en: Do they allocate to the client's actual risk capacity, or sell to the sales target.

asks.zh: 一个五十岁、还有房贷、风险偏好中等的客户，你怎么给他配？
asks.en: Fifty years old, a mortgage outstanding, moderate risk tolerance — how do you allocate?

asks.zh: 客户只认存款和保本，你怎么和他谈资产配置？
asks.en: The client only trusts deposits and principal guarantees — how do you open the allocation conversation?

asks.zh: 净值波动时客户集体要赎回，你怎么应对？
asks.en: Markets wobble and your clients all want out at once — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你的客户回访率和续投率是多少？
asks.en: What are your client review coverage and reinvestment rates?

insider.zh: 强的人靠客户复购和转介绍活着，弱的人靠冲刺月的额度和话术活着。
insider.en: Strong advisors live on repeat business and referrals; weak ones live on quarter-end allocation and a script.

followups.zh: 你卖过后来亏钱的产品吗，客户找上来你怎么处理？
followups.en: You sold something that lost money — what happened when the client came back?

followups.zh: 任务指标和客户利益冲突的那一次，你怎么选的？
followups.en: The one time the target conflicted with the client's interest — which did you pick?

screens.zh: 客户从哪来、留不留得住，投资建议有没有可复述的依据。
screens.en: Where the book comes from, whether it stays, and whether the advice has a stated basis.

asks.zh: 你的客户主要从哪来，去年新增多少、留下多少？
asks.en: Where does your book come from — how much did you add last year, and how much stayed?

asks.zh: 客户要追一只已经涨了很多的热门股，你怎么说？
asks.en: A client wants to chase a name that's already run — what do you tell them?

asks.zh: 你的投资建议依据是什么，跟着谁的研究还是自己判断？
asks.en: What's your advice based on — whose research, or your own view?

asks.zh: 客户账户回撤大了，你的沟通节奏是什么？
asks.en: An account is deep in drawdown — what's your communication cadence?

insider.zh: 强的人算得清客户留存和资产净流入，弱的人只报开户数和佣金。
insider.en: Strong advisors track retention and net new assets; weak ones report accounts opened and commission.

followups.zh: 你劝住过客户的哪一次操作，后来验证了吗？
followups.en: A trade you talked a client out of — how did it turn out?

followups.zh: 客户要求你代为操作账户，你怎么处理？
followups.en: A client asks you to trade the account for them — what do you do?

screens.zh: 能不能把摸不清的资产摸清，再把一堆漏洞排出真正该先修的顺序。
screens.en: Can they get an unknown estate under inventory, then rank a pile of findings into what actually gets fixed first.

asks.zh: 一家公司资产台账不全，影子资产你怎么摸出来？
asks.en: The asset inventory is incomplete — how do you surface the shadow assets?

asks.zh: 漏洞扫出来上万条，你按什么排修复优先级？
asks.en: Ten thousand findings from the scanner — how do you prioritize remediation?

asks.zh: 评分很高但实际利用不了的漏洞，你怎么判断？
asks.en: High CVSS but not actually exploitable in your environment — how do you make that call?

asks.zh: 资产的业务重要性谁说了算，你怎么定级？
asks.en: Who decides business criticality, and how do you classify an asset?

insider.zh: 强的人把漏洞和实际暴露面、业务影响绑在一起排序，弱的人按扫描器的评分从高到低出报表。
insider.en: Strong analysts rank by real exposure and business impact; weak ones sort the scanner output by severity and email it.

followups.zh: 业务方拒绝修，你怎么推动，什么情况下接受风险？
followups.en: The owner refuses to patch — how do you push, and when do you accept the risk?

followups.zh: 你的资产清单多久就不准了，怎么保持鲜度？
followups.en: How fast does your inventory go stale, and how do you keep it current?

screens.zh: 有没有真正的攻击思路和手上功夫，报告能不能让研发照着修。
screens.en: Genuine attacker thinking and hands-on skill, plus a report engineers can actually fix from.

asks.zh: 只给你一个域名，你从哪一步开始，信息收集怎么做？
asks.en: You get one domain and nothing else — where do you start, and how do you do recon?

asks.zh: 拿到一个低权限立足点之后，你怎么提权和横向移动？
asks.en: You have a low-privilege foothold — how do you escalate and move laterally?

asks.zh: 你挖到过最有意思的一个漏洞是什么，利用链怎么串起来的？
asks.en: The most interesting bug you've found — how did the exploit chain come together?

asks.zh: 内网里看到一条通往域控的路径，你怎么在不影响业务的前提下验证？
asks.en: You see a path to domain admin — how do you prove it without breaking production?

insider.zh: 强的人从业务逻辑和信任关系里找路，弱的人只会跑扫描器再套现成的利用脚本。
insider.en: Strong testers find the path through business logic and trust relationships; weak ones run a scanner and paste a public exploit.

followups.zh: 报告怎么写才能让研发一次改对，风险等级凭什么定？
followups.en: How do you write findings so the fix lands first time, and how do you justify the severity?

followups.zh: 客户说这个漏洞利用条件太苛刻、不打算修，你怎么证明它可达？
followups.en: The client says the preconditions are unrealistic and won't fix — how do you prove reachability?

screens.zh: 能不能在成本、性能和安全之间给出有取舍的架构，而不是把控制项堆满。
screens.en: An architecture with explicit trade-offs across cost, performance and security, not a wall of controls.

asks.zh: 一个新系统上云，纵深防御怎么分层，边界放在哪？
asks.en: A new system moves to cloud — how do you layer defense in depth, and where does the boundary sit?

asks.zh: 零信任你落地过哪几块，身份和网络分段先做哪个？
asks.en: Which parts of zero trust have you actually shipped — identity or segmentation first?

asks.zh: 密钥和凭据的管理你怎么设计，轮换怎么做？
asks.en: How do you design secrets and credential management, and how does rotation work?

asks.zh: 有一处控制业务确实接受不了，你用什么补偿方式？
asks.en: The business genuinely can't take one control — what compensating measure do you put in?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清每一层控制拦的是哪种攻击、失效时谁兜底，弱的人罗列一堆产品清单当架构。
insider.en: Strong architects can say which attack each layer stops and what catches it when that layer fails; weak ones hand you a product list.

followups.zh: 你设计的基线实际落地率是多少，没落地的原因是什么？
followups.en: What share of your baseline is actually deployed, and why did the rest stall?

followups.zh: 加了这层控制，性能和运维各付出了什么？
followups.en: That extra layer — what did it cost in latency and in operations?

screens.zh: 能不能让研发愿意配合，把安全检查嵌进流水线又不拖慢发布。
screens.en: Can they get engineers on side and put checks in the pipeline without slowing releases.

asks.zh: 静态扫描误报太多、研发不愿意用，你怎么办？
asks.en: SAST is too noisy and the team has stopped looking at it — what do you do?

asks.zh: 一次威胁建模你怎么做，什么阶段介入？
asks.en: Walk me through a threat model you ran — at what stage did you engage?

asks.zh: 做代码审计你最先看哪几处？
asks.en: Reviewing code for security, where do you look first?

asks.zh: 依赖库爆了高危漏洞，你怎么定影响面和修复节奏？
asks.en: A dependency drops a critical CVE — how do you scope the blast radius and set the fix timeline?

insider.zh: 强的人把安全门槛设计成研发顺手就过的一步，弱的人靠发工单和拦发布施压。
insider.en: Strong AppSec engineers make the secure path the easy path; weak ones file tickets and block builds.

followups.zh: 研发赶版本要跳过安全检查，你的例外流程怎么设计？
followups.en: A team wants to skip the gate to hit a date — how is your exception process designed?

followups.zh: 你上线的规则拦下过什么真问题，误报率多少？
followups.en: What real issue has your rule caught, and what's its false positive rate?

screens.zh: 分诊的判断力和降噪的实际动作，能不能从一堆告警里挑出真事件。
screens.en: Triage judgement and real noise reduction — can they pull the true incident out of the queue.

asks.zh: 一条告警到你面前，你按什么顺序看，几分钟内决定要不要升级？
asks.en: An alert lands on you — in what order do you look, and how fast do you decide to escalate?

asks.zh: 告警量太大你怎么降噪，是调规则还是补数据源？
asks.en: Alert volume is unmanageable — do you tune rules or fix the data sources?

asks.zh: 内部运维操作和真的横向移动，你怎么区分？
asks.en: Legitimate admin activity versus real lateral movement — how do you tell them apart?

asks.zh: 你升级过的事件里，后来判定为误报的占多少？
asks.en: Of the incidents you escalated, what share turned out to be false positives?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清自己的分诊依据和漏报风险，弱的人照剧本关单、把不确定的一律往上抛。
insider.en: Strong analysts can state their triage reasoning and where they might be missing something; weak ones close by playbook and punt anything unclear upward.

followups.zh: 你关掉的告警后来变成真事件，是怎么被发现的？
followups.en: An alert you closed became a real incident — how did it resurface?

followups.zh: 值班交接时哪些信息必须写清楚？
followups.en: At shift handover, what has to be written down?

screens.zh: 能不能把情报和攻击手法变成命中率高、噪音低的检测规则。
screens.en: Can they convert intel and TTPs into detections that fire on the real thing and stay quiet otherwise.

asks.zh: 拿到一份新的攻击手法描述，你怎么把它变成一条检测规则？
asks.en: You get a write-up of a new technique — how do you turn it into a detection?

asks.zh: 检测覆盖度你怎么衡量，现在哪些技战术是盲区？
asks.en: How do you measure detection coverage, and which techniques are blind spots today?

asks.zh: 一条规则误报太多，删掉又怕漏，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A rule is too noisy to keep and too important to delete — what do you do?

asks.zh: 情报里的失陷指标你怎么筛，直接进封禁列表吗？
asks.en: How do you vet IOCs from a feed — do they go straight into a blocklist?

insider.zh: 强的人按攻击行为写检测并做过对抗验证，弱的人堆一堆失陷指标当检测能力。
insider.en: Strong engineers write behavioral detections and validate them against a real emulation; weak ones stack IOC lists and call it coverage.

followups.zh: 规则上线前你怎么验证，用什么数据做回放？
followups.en: How do you validate a rule before it ships, and what data do you replay?

followups.zh: 攻击者换了工具你的规则还在不在，怎么写得更耐久？
followups.en: The adversary swaps tooling — does your rule survive, and how do you make it more durable?

screens.zh: 能不能把安全讲成业务和董事会听得懂的风险，再把预算和人排到刀口上。
screens.en: Can they frame security as risk the board understands, then put budget and people where it counts.

asks.zh: 预算只剩现在的一半，你砍哪些、保哪些？
asks.en: Your budget is halved — what gets cut and what is protected?

asks.zh: 你怎么向管理层汇报安全态势，用哪几个指标？
asks.en: How do you report posture to the executive team, and on which metrics?

asks.zh: 出了重大事件，对外披露和对内追责你怎么安排？
asks.en: After a major incident, how do you handle external disclosure and internal accountability?

asks.zh: 业务要上一个明显有风险的项目，高层还支持，你怎么处理？
asks.en: The business wants a clearly risky project and leadership backs it — what do you do?

insider.zh: 强的人用风险敞口和事件损失说话，弱的人拿告警数量和采购的产品数量充业绩。
insider.en: Strong security leaders argue in exposure and loss; weak ones report alert counts and tools purchased.

followups.zh: 你任内的安全投入换来了哪些可衡量的变化？
followups.en: What measurable change did your spend buy?

followups.zh: 团队留不住人，你怎么解决？
followups.en: You can't retain the team — how do you fix that?

screens.zh: 事故当下的处置顺序和判断力，能不能在不毁掉证据的前提下先止血。
screens.en: Sequencing and judgement under fire — can they stop the bleeding without destroying the evidence.

asks.zh: 接到一台服务器被入侵的报告，头三十分钟你做什么，按什么顺序？
asks.en: A server is reported compromised — what do you do in the first thirty minutes, and in what order?

asks.zh: 什么情况下你直接断网，什么情况下先留着观察？
asks.en: When do you pull it off the network, and when do you leave it up and watch?

asks.zh: 遏制、根除、恢复的边界你怎么定，什么时候敢说事件结束了？
asks.en: How do you draw the line between containment, eradication and recovery, and when do you call an incident closed?

asks.zh: 勒索软件已经加密了一部分系统，你的处置顺序是什么？
asks.en: Ransomware has already encrypted part of the estate — what's your sequence?

insider.zh: 强的人先保住证据、判断清范围再动手清理，弱的人急着重装系统，结果第二天又被打进来。
insider.en: Strong responders preserve evidence and scope the intrusion before cleaning; weak ones rebuild the box and get owned again the next day.

followups.zh: 根因你怎么确认，入口没找到的事件你敢结案吗？
followups.en: How do you confirm root cause — would you close an incident with no known entry point?

followups.zh: 业务要求立刻恢复，你怎么在恢复和取证之间排序？
followups.en: The business demands immediate restoration — how do you sequence recovery against forensics?

screens.zh: 证据链规不规范、时间线能不能还原，结论拿不拿得出去举证。
screens.en: Discipline in the evidence chain, ability to rebuild a timeline, and findings that hold up as evidence.

asks.zh: 一台还在运行的服务器要取证，你的采集顺序是什么？
asks.en: You need to acquire from a live server — what's your collection order?

asks.zh: 内存和磁盘都要取，你先动哪个，为什么？
asks.en: Memory and disk both matter — which do you take first, and why?

asks.zh: 证据的完整性和保管链你怎么保证？
asks.en: How do you preserve integrity and chain of custody?

asks.zh: 日志被清掉了，你还能从哪里还原时间线？
asks.en: The logs were wiped — where else do you rebuild the timeline from?

insider.zh: 强的人对易失性顺序和哈希校验形成了肌肉记忆，弱的人在被入侵的机器上直接翻文件，把痕迹踩没了。
insider.en: Strong examiners treat order of volatility and hashing as muscle memory; weak ones browse the compromised host and trample the artifacts.

followups.zh: 取证结论如果要在法律程序里用，哪些环节必须补齐？
followups.en: If the findings go to court, which steps must be tightened?

followups.zh: 时间戳来自不同设备而且不同步，你怎么对齐时间线？
followups.en: Timestamps come from unsynchronized devices — how do you align the timeline?

screens.zh: 能不能把业务安全地恢复回来，并把复盘结论真的变成加固动作。
screens.en: Can they bring service back safely and turn post-mortem findings into hardening that actually ships.

asks.zh: 备份还在但可能已经被污染，你怎么判断能不能用？
asks.en: Backups exist but may be poisoned — how do you decide whether to trust them?

asks.zh: 恢复顺序你怎么排，哪些系统必须先起来？
asks.en: How do you sequence restoration — what has to come up first?

asks.zh: 复盘结论怎么落成加固项，谁来验收？
asks.en: How do post-mortem findings become hardening work, and who signs it off?

asks.zh: 恢复演练你做过吗，实际恢复时间和目标差多少？
asks.en: Have you run a restore drill — how far was actual recovery time from the objective?

insider.zh: 强的人恢复前先确认攻击者已经出局、入口已经堵上，弱的人急着把服务拉起来，把后门一起还原了。
insider.en: Strong engineers confirm the adversary is out and the entry point is closed before restoring; weak ones rush service back up and restore the backdoor with it.

followups.zh: 上一次演练暴露了什么问题，改掉了吗？
followups.en: What did your last drill expose, and did it get fixed?

followups.zh: 恢复目标时间是谁定的，业务认这个数吗？
followups.en: Who set the recovery time objective, and does the business agree with it?

screens.zh: 能不能把合规要求翻成技术团队做得下去的控制项，而不是发一堆表格。
screens.en: Can they translate obligations into controls engineering can run, instead of circulating spreadsheets.

asks.zh: 等级保护测评和 ISO 27001 你都做过吗，控制项怎么复用？
asks.en: You've run both MLPS assessment and ISO 27001 — how do you reuse controls across them?

asks.zh: 个人信息的处理你怎么梳理，跨境传输走哪套流程？
asks.en: How do you map personal data processing, and what's the process for cross-border transfer?

asks.zh: 有一项控制业务确实做不到，替代控制你怎么设计和记录？
asks.en: One control is genuinely not feasible — how do you design and document the compensating control?

asks.zh: 供应商的安全评估你怎么做，怎么在合同里落成条款？
asks.en: How do you assess vendor security, and how does it land in the contract?

insider.zh: 强的人把一次合规工作变成能长期运转的控制，弱的人应付完检查就把材料归档了。
insider.en: Strong GRC people leave behind controls that keep running; weak ones pass the assessment and file the binder.

followups.zh: 你写的制度落地情况怎么样，怎么验证真的在执行？
followups.en: Are the policies you wrote actually followed, and how do you verify that?

followups.zh: 检查前发现有控制项不达标，你怎么处理？
followups.en: You find a control failing right before an assessment — what do you do?

screens.zh: 能不能独立验证控制真的在跑，整改项写得让人改得动。
screens.en: Can they independently prove a control is operating, and write findings someone can act on.

asks.zh: 一项访问控制到底有没有生效，你是看配置还是抽样测试？
asks.en: To prove an access control is effective, do you inspect configuration or sample-test it?

asks.zh: 权限审阅你怎么做，离职和转岗的账号怎么查？
asks.en: How do you run an access review, and how do you catch leaver and mover accounts?

asks.zh: 特权账号的使用你怎么审，日志不全时怎么办？
asks.en: How do you audit privileged account use when the logs are incomplete?

asks.zh: 你出的整改项被拖着不做，你怎么推？
asks.en: Your findings are past due and untouched — how do you push them through?

insider.zh: 强的人拿证据说话、坚持抽样验证，弱的人靠对方填的自评表出报告。
insider.en: Strong auditors work from evidence and insist on sampling; weak ones write the report off the auditee's self-assessment.

followups.zh: 这项控制被绕过的情形你测过吗？
followups.en: Have you tested the ways that control can be bypassed?

followups.zh: 整改完成后的验证你怎么做，谁签字？
followups.en: How do you verify remediation, and who signs off?

screens.zh: 能不能用毛利、售罄率和周转把货盘定下来，选品讲得出依据，卖不动的认得出来并及时砍掉。
screens.en: Can build an assortment they defend with margin, sell-through and turns — and cut a loser in time.

asks.zh: 你上一季的货盘是怎么定的，宽度和深度怎么分配？
asks.en: How did you build last season's assortment — how did you split breadth and depth?

asks.zh: 一个你重点押的新品卖不动，你什么时候决定砍，库存怎么处理？
asks.en: A SKU you bet on isn't moving — when do you cut it, and how do you clear the stock?

asks.zh: 自有品牌和品牌商品在货架上怎么配比，价格怎么定？
asks.en: How do you balance own-brand against national brands on shelf, and how do you price?

asks.zh: 供应商的返点和账期你怎么谈？
asks.en: How do you negotiate rebates and payment terms with suppliers?

insider.zh: 强的人张口就是售罄率、毛利率和周转天数，说得清哪个品类在替哪个品类赚钱，弱的人凭个人口味选品，只报上新数量。
insider.en: Strong buyers talk sell-through, gross margin and turns and know which category subsidises which; weak ones buy to personal taste and quote SKU counts.

followups.zh: 那个卖不动的品，事后复盘错在选品的哪一步？
followups.en: That dead SKU — where in the buying process did it go wrong?

followups.zh: 你说的毛利是前台毛利，还是扣完退货和折扣的？
followups.en: Is that margin front-end margin, or net of returns and markdowns?

screens.zh: 能不能在缺货和积压之间把补货量定住，多仓多店之间的库存真调得动。
screens.en: Can hold replenishment between stockouts and dead stock, and actually move inventory across stores and warehouses.

asks.zh: 你的补货模型看哪几个参数，安全库存怎么定？
asks.en: What drives your replenishment model, and how do you set safety stock?

asks.zh: 爆款断货和滞销积压同时发生，你先处理哪个？
asks.en: A hero SKU is out of stock while slow movers pile up — which do you fix first?

asks.zh: 门店之间的库存怎么调拨，谁拍板？
asks.en: How does stock get transferred between stores, and who signs it off?

asks.zh: 大促前的备货你怎么估，估错了怎么收场？
asks.en: How do you forecast a big promo buy, and what do you do when it's wrong?

insider.zh: 强的人分得清缺货是预测错了、供应商没到货还是门店没上架，弱的人拿上周销量乘一个系数就报数。
insider.en: Strong planners can tell whether a stockout came from the forecast, the supplier or the shelf; weak ones take last week's sales times a factor.

followups.zh: 你的预测准确率多少，用什么口径算的？
followups.en: What's your forecast accuracy, and how is it measured?

followups.zh: 供应商到货率长期不达标，你怎么改约束条件？
followups.en: If supplier fill rate keeps missing, how do you change the terms?

screens.zh: 能不能把一家店的营收、毛利和人效一起扛住，货、场、人三样都调得动。
screens.en: Can hold one store's revenue, margin and labour productivity together, and pull all three levers — product, floor and people.

asks.zh: 店里客流没少但成交额掉了，你怎么查？
asks.en: Footfall is flat but sales are down — how do you diagnose it?

asks.zh: 排班和人力成本怎么定，旺季怎么加、淡季怎么减？
asks.en: How do you set rosters and labour cost across peak and slow seasons?

asks.zh: 一个资深员工不服管，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A long-tenured employee won't follow you — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 陈列和动线你调过什么，效果怎么衡量？
asks.en: What have you changed in layout or traffic flow, and how did you measure it?

insider.zh: 强的人把客流、进店率、转化率和客单价这条链拆开，找出掉的是哪一环，弱的人只会喊加大促销力度。
insider.en: Strong managers break the chain — footfall, entry rate, conversion, basket size — and find the broken link; weak ones just call for a bigger promotion.

followups.zh: 那次促销拉起来的销售，算完毛利是正的还是负的？
followups.en: That promotion — was margin positive or negative after it?

followups.zh: 店里的损耗和盘亏是多少，你怎么压下去的？
followups.en: What's your shrink, and how did you bring it down?

screens.zh: 能不能一手管住十几家店的标准执行，一手把新店选址和回本周期算准。
screens.en: Runs standards across a dozen stores with one hand and underwrites new-site payback with the other.

asks.zh: 你怎么判断一个点位值不值得开，看哪几个数？
asks.en: How do you judge whether a site is worth opening — which numbers?

asks.zh: 同一套标准，有的店做得到有的做不到，你怎么办？
asks.en: Same standard, some stores hit it and some don't — what do you do?

asks.zh: 一家老店持续亏损，你什么时候建议关店？
asks.en: A mature store keeps losing money — when do you recommend closing it?

asks.zh: 你带过多少个店长，怎么发现一个店长出了问题？
asks.en: How many store managers have you run, and how do you spot one in trouble?

insider.zh: 强的人说得出自己开过的店的回本周期，也认得出判断失误的那几家，弱的人只讲巡店检查表。
insider.en: Strong supervisors can name the payback period of the stores they opened and the ones they got wrong; weak ones only talk about the store-visit checklist.

followups.zh: 你判断错的那个点位，事后看错在哪个假设上？
followups.en: The site you misjudged — which assumption was off?

followups.zh: 新店的坪效和成熟店差多少，多久追上？
followups.en: How far below mature stores does a new one open, and how long to catch up?

screens.zh: 能不能把半小时到家的履约成本和缺货率同时压住，还兼顾平台上的经营。
screens.en: Can hold fulfilment cost and out-of-stock rate down on 30-minute delivery while still working the aggregator platforms.

asks.zh: 你的准时率是多少，单均履约成本多少？
asks.en: What's your on-time rate, and your fulfilment cost per order?

asks.zh: 前置仓只放得下几千个商品，你怎么选？
asks.en: A dark store only holds a few thousand SKUs — how do you choose them?

asks.zh: 缺货造成的缺项和退单，你怎么降？
asks.en: How do you cut missing items and cancellations from stockouts?

asks.zh: 平台的流量规则变了，你的应对是什么？
asks.en: The platform changed its traffic rules — what's your response?

insider.zh: 强的人算得清一单的履约成本和边际，知道哪些单不该接，弱的人只盯单量和补贴。
insider.en: Strong operators know the contribution of a single order and which orders not to take; weak ones only watch order volume and subsidies.

followups.zh: 门店即仓和独立前置仓，你会选哪个，为什么？
followups.en: Store-as-warehouse or a standalone dark store — which do you pick, and why?

followups.zh: 高峰运力不够的时候，你怎么削峰？
followups.en: Rider capacity runs short at peak — how do you shave the peak?

screens.zh: 能不能把自有商城和平台店铺的流量、转化和复购做起来，不靠一味投钱买量。
screens.en: Can grow traffic, conversion and repurchase on the owned store and the marketplaces without just buying traffic.

asks.zh: 你店铺的转化率是多少，哪一步流失最大？
asks.en: What's your store conversion rate, and where's the biggest drop-off?

asks.zh: 自有小程序和平台店铺的定位怎么分，价格怎么统一？
asks.en: How do you position the own mini-program against marketplace stores, and keep pricing consistent?

asks.zh: 一场大促你怎么排节奏，从蓄水到收尾？
asks.en: How do you pace a big sale, from warm-up to wrap-up?

asks.zh: 投放的投入产出比你怎么看，到多少你还敢投？
asks.en: How do you read ad ROI, and at what level do you keep spending?

insider.zh: 强的人把流量、转化、客单和复购拆开算账，知道钱花在哪一环最值，弱的人只报总成交额。
insider.en: Strong operators split the P&L into traffic, conversion, basket and repurchase and know which link pays back; weak ones only report GMV.

followups.zh: 线上价格比门店低，店长找上来，你怎么处理？
followups.en: Online is cheaper than in-store and a store manager complains — how do you handle it?

followups.zh: 那场大促之后一个月的复购是多少？
followups.en: What was repurchase in the month after that sale?

screens.zh: 能不能把加进来的人留在社群里持续下单，而不是发一轮券就做成死群。
screens.en: Can keep the people they added buying, instead of running one coupon round and letting the group die.

asks.zh: 从零建一个社群，你前两周做什么？
asks.en: Building a community group from zero — what do you do in the first two weeks?

asks.zh: 活跃和成交怎么平衡，一天发几条内容？
asks.en: How do you balance engagement and sales, and how many posts a day?

asks.zh: 一个群从活跃做到没人说话，你怎么救？
asks.en: A group went from active to dead — how do you revive it?

asks.zh: 导购的社群业绩怎么算，怎么让门店愿意加人？
asks.en: How is private-domain revenue credited, so stores are willing to add customers?

insider.zh: 强的人有一套内容和触达节奏，说得出群成交占比和退群率，弱的人天天发广告，把群做成没人看的公告板。
insider.en: Strong operators have a content and outreach cadence and can quote group sales share and opt-out rate; weak ones post ads daily until the group goes silent.

followups.zh: 群里的成交，有多少是本来就会到店买的？
followups.en: How much of that group revenue would have walked into the store anyway?

followups.zh: 导购把客户加成自己的私人客户，你怎么管？
followups.en: Staff add customers to their personal accounts — how do you manage that?

screens.zh: 能不能把会员分层做成真拉得动复购的动作，权益成本也算得清。
screens.en: Can turn member tiers into actions that actually lift repurchase, with the cost of perks fully counted.

asks.zh: 你怎么给会员分层，分完之后各层的动作有什么不一样？
asks.en: How do you tier members, and what changes per tier afterwards?

asks.zh: 会员权益的成本和带来的增量，你怎么算？
asks.en: How do you cost member perks against the incremental sales they bring?

asks.zh: 一批会员半年没回来买，你怎么唤醒，唤回了多少？
asks.en: A cohort hasn't bought in six months — how do you win them back, and how many came?

asks.zh: 付费会员卡你会怎么定价、放哪些权益？
asks.en: How would you price a paid membership and what goes in it?

insider.zh: 强的人留出对照组把增量算出来，弱的人把发券之后的成交都算成自己的功劳。
insider.en: Strong CRM leads use a holdout group to prove incrementality; weak ones claim every post-coupon sale as their own.

followups.zh: 你说的复购提升，扣掉本来就会买的那部分还剩多少？
followups.en: Net of members who'd have bought anyway, how much of that lift is left?

followups.zh: 积分和折扣哪个更划算，为什么？
followups.en: Points or discounts — which pays better, and why?

screens.zh: 能不能在门店、线上和即时零售抢同一批货、同一个客的时候拍板，把冲突压下去。
screens.en: Can rule when stores, online and instant retail fight over the same stock and the same customer, and make the conflict stop.

asks.zh: 线上和门店抢库存，你的分配规则是什么？
asks.en: Online and stores compete for inventory — what's your allocation rule?

asks.zh: 线上下单门店发货，业绩和毛利算给谁？
asks.en: An online order shipped from a store — who gets the sales and the margin?

asks.zh: 店长抵触到家业务，你怎么推下去？
asks.en: Store managers resist on-demand delivery — how do you push it through?

asks.zh: 你负责的全渠道，会员和库存实际打通到哪一步？
asks.en: In your omnichannel setup, how far did member and inventory unification actually get?

insider.zh: 强的人把渠道利益冲突用规则和考核落下来，弱的人开会喊打通，散会各干各的。
insider.en: Strong directors settle channel conflict with rules and incentives; weak ones preach integration in the meeting and everyone goes back to their own silo.

followups.zh: 那套业绩归属规则推下去有人不认，你怎么办？
followups.en: Someone rejected that credit-allocation rule — then what?

followups.zh: 同一个会员在各渠道的重复识别率多少，怎么去重的？
followups.en: What's the duplicate rate on unified member identity, and how do you dedupe?

screens.zh: 能不能把门店、线上和履约各自的诉求收成一套公共能力，还推得动上线。
screens.en: Can converge store, online and fulfilment demands into shared capability, and get it shipped.

asks.zh: 库存中台你怎么设计，可售库存和实物库存怎么对上？
asks.en: How do you design the inventory core — how do available and physical stock reconcile?

asks.zh: 一个需求只有一家业务方要，你接不接，怎么判断？
asks.en: Only one business unit wants a feature — do you build it, and how do you decide?

asks.zh: 老系统和新中台并行的那段时间，你怎么迁？
asks.en: During the period the legacy system runs alongside the new core, how do you migrate?

asks.zh: 会员在门店和线上是两套账号，你怎么合？
asks.en: Members exist as two IDs in store and online — how do you merge them?

insider.zh: 强的人先定清楚每类数据以谁为准再谈接口，弱的人来一个需求加一张表，把中台做成需求池。
insider.en: Strong platform PMs settle the system of record before discussing APIs; weak ones add a table per request until the core is just a request queue.

followups.zh: 超卖发生过吗，根因和你的兜底是什么？
followups.en: Has overselling happened — root cause and your fallback?

followups.zh: 业务方绕过中台自己建了一套，你怎么收回来？
followups.en: A team bypassed the core and built their own — how do you bring them back?

screens.zh: 能不能把动销和会员数据做成买手、店长真照着改的结论，而不是又一堆报表。
screens.en: Can turn sell-through and member data into something buyers and store managers will act on, not another stack of reports.

asks.zh: 一个品类销售下滑，你怎么拆到能动手的原因？
asks.en: A category is declining — how do you break it down to something actionable?

asks.zh: 门店之间业绩差三倍，你怎么判断是店的问题还是商圈的问题？
asks.en: Stores differ threefold in sales — how do you tell store problem from catchment problem?

asks.zh: 你算过的哪些指标真的影响了选品决策？
asks.en: Which metrics of yours actually changed a buying decision?

asks.zh: 同一个客在线上线下怎么识别，识别不准会怎么影响结论？
asks.en: How do you identify the same customer online and in-store, and what breaks if you get it wrong?

insider.zh: 强的人从业务要做的动作倒推该看什么数，结论落到砍哪个品、补哪个仓，弱的人只做同比环比的看板。
insider.en: Strong analysts work backwards from the decision and land on which SKU to cut and which warehouse to refill; weak ones ship year-over-year dashboards.

followups.zh: 你给的建议买手最后照做了吗，结果怎样？
followups.en: Did the buyer actually follow your recommendation, and what happened?

followups.zh: 促销期的数据你怎么剔掉影响再看基线？
followups.en: How do you strip promo periods out to see the baseline?

screens.zh: 能不能把埋点规范立起来，接入管线做到不丢数据、不重复上报，客户端和库表变更都接得住。
screens.en: Can build tracking specs and ingestion pipelines that don't lose or duplicate records and survive client and schema changes.

asks.zh: 一个新业务要埋点，你怎么定事件和属性规范？
asks.en: A new product needs tracking — how do you define the event and property spec?

asks.zh: 数据库变更捕获怎么接，全量和增量怎么衔接？
asks.en: How do you wire up CDC, and how do the initial snapshot and the incremental stream join up?

asks.zh: 客户端在弱网和进程被杀的时候，上报怎么保证不丢？
asks.en: How do you avoid losing client events on flaky networks or app kills?

asks.zh: 上游改了埋点字段没通知你，你怎么发现？
asks.en: Upstream changed a tracked field without telling you — how do you find out?

insider.zh: 强的人先把事件定义和版本管起来再写代码，弱的人来一个需求加一个事件，半年后没人说得清指标是从哪个埋点来的。
insider.en: Strong ingestion engineers version event definitions before writing code; weak ones add an event per request until nobody can say which metric came from which hit.

followups.zh: 丢数和重复上报你分别怎么定位，拿什么对账？
followups.en: How do you separately localise loss and duplication, and what do you reconcile against?

followups.zh: 你的管线是至少一次还是恰好一次，为什么这么选？
followups.en: Is your pipeline at-least-once or exactly-once, and why?

screens.zh: 能不能把实时任务跑稳，乱序、迟到数据、状态膨胀和反压这几件事真处理过。
screens.en: Can keep streaming jobs stable — out-of-order events, late data, state growth and backpressure all handled for real.

asks.zh: 数据乱序又有迟到，你的水位线和窗口怎么设？
asks.en: Events arrive out of order and late — how do you set watermarks and windows?

asks.zh: 任务出现反压，你从哪里开始查？
asks.en: A job is under backpressure — where do you start looking?

asks.zh: 状态越跑越大，你怎么控？
asks.en: State keeps growing — how do you bound it?

asks.zh: 同一个指标实时和离线算出来不一致，你怎么对？
asks.en: The same metric differs between the streaming and batch paths — how do you reconcile?

insider.zh: 强的人讲得出自己任务的状态大小、检查点耗时和恢复时长，弱的人只说用了 Flink，出问题就重启。
insider.en: Strong streaming engineers can quote their state size, checkpoint duration and recovery time; weak ones say they used Flink and restart when it breaks.

followups.zh: 一次重启之后下游出现重复数据，你怎么让它幂等？
followups.en: A restart duplicated records downstream — how do you make consumers idempotent?

followups.zh: 你的检查点间隔为什么设成这个值？
followups.en: Why is your checkpoint interval set where it is?

screens.zh: 能不能把湖仓底座选对建成，表格式、小文件、查询性能和成本都真算过。
screens.en: Can pick and land a lakehouse foundation with table format, small files, query performance and cost all worked out.

asks.zh: 你为什么选这套表格式，和另外两家比差在哪？
asks.en: Why this table format, and where does it lose to the other two?

asks.zh: 小文件太多把查询拖慢了，你怎么治？
asks.en: Small files are dragging queries down — how do you fix it?

asks.zh: 存储和计算的成本你怎么算，省下来的是哪一块？
asks.en: How do you account for storage and compute cost, and which part did you actually save?

asks.zh: 一张表的结构要改，怎么让下游不炸？
asks.en: A table's schema has to change — how do you keep downstream from breaking?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清自己平台的查询延迟、成本曲线和分区设计的取舍，弱的人照着文档搭一套，跑不快也说不出为什么。
insider.en: Strong platform engineers can state their query latency, cost curve and the tradeoff behind the partition design; weak ones follow the docs and can't say why it's slow.

followups.zh: 你说的性能提升，是同一份数据、同一个查询比出来的吗？
followups.en: Was that speedup measured on the same data and the same query?

followups.zh: 湖和仓两套并存的那段时间，指标口径怎么对齐？
followups.en: While lake and warehouse ran in parallel, how did you keep definitions aligned?

screens.zh: 能不能把集群跑稳，扩容、故障恢复和容量预估都自己扛过一遍。
screens.en: Can keep the cluster up, having personally owned scaling, failure recovery and capacity forecasting.

asks.zh: 集群某个节点挂了，你的处理顺序是什么？
asks.en: A node in the cluster dies — what's your order of operations?

asks.zh: 容量规划你怎么做，什么时候决定扩容？
asks.en: How do you do capacity planning, and when do you decide to scale out?

asks.zh: 一个查询把集群拖垮了，你怎么隔离和限流？
asks.en: One query took the cluster down — how do you isolate and throttle?

asks.zh: 备份和恢复你实际演练过吗，恢复要多久？
asks.en: Have you actually rehearsed a restore, and how long does it take?

insider.zh: 强的人有容量水位线和演练记录，说得出上次故障恢复用了多久，弱的人等到磁盘写满才发现要扩容。
insider.en: Strong ops keep capacity thresholds and drill records and can quote the last incident's recovery time; weak ones find out they need capacity when the disks fill.

followups.zh: 最长的那次故障持续多久，卡在哪一步？
followups.en: What was your longest outage, and which step held it up?

followups.zh: 半夜的告警你收到多少条，哪些是噪声？
followups.en: How many pages do you get overnight, and which are noise?

screens.zh: 能不能把杂乱的原始数据分层建成别人敢用的模型，口径统一、后面还改得动。
screens.en: Can layer messy raw data into models other people trust, with consistent definitions and room to change.

asks.zh: 你的分层是怎么划的，每层放什么、不放什么？
asks.en: How do you split your layers — what belongs in each, and what doesn't?

asks.zh: 一个维度是缓慢变化的，你怎么留历史？
asks.en: A dimension changes slowly — how do you keep history?

asks.zh: 同一个指标各业务口径不一样，你怎么统一？
asks.en: Business units define the same metric differently — how do you converge them?

asks.zh: 宽表和星型模型你怎么选？
asks.en: Wide table or star schema — how do you choose?

insider.zh: 强的人先把业务过程和口径定清楚再动手建模，弱的人一层套一层加宽表，最后谁也不敢删。
insider.en: Strong modellers pin down the business process and the definitions before building; weak ones stack wide table on wide table until nobody dares delete one.

followups.zh: 你的模型上线后被下游改成什么样了，为什么？
followups.en: What did downstream teams turn your model into after launch, and why?

followups.zh: 口径变了，历史数据要不要重跑，你怎么定？
followups.en: When a definition changes, do you backfill history — how do you decide?

screens.zh: 能不能把任务写对写快，数据倾斜、任务超时和资源浪费都真调过。
screens.en: Can write jobs that are correct and fast, having actually tuned skew, timeouts and wasted resources.

asks.zh: 一个任务出现数据倾斜，你怎么定位、怎么解？
asks.en: A job has data skew — how do you locate and fix it?

asks.zh: 一个跑三小时的任务你优化到多久，改了什么？
asks.en: You cut a three-hour job to what, and what did you change?

asks.zh: 上游延迟导致你的任务赶不上产出时间，你怎么办？
asks.en: Upstream is late and your job will miss its deadline — what do you do?

asks.zh: 任务的重跑和补数逻辑你怎么定？
asks.en: How do you design rerun and backfill logic for a job?

insider.zh: 强的人看执行计划和资源用量找瓶颈，弱的人靠加内存、加并发硬扛过去。
insider.en: Strong developers read the execution plan and resource usage to find the bottleneck; weak ones throw memory and parallelism at it.

followups.zh: 那次优化省了多少资源，怎么核出来的？
followups.en: How much resource did that optimisation save, and how was it verified?

followups.zh: 补数的时候怎么保证不重复、不遗漏？
followups.en: During a backfill, how do you guarantee no duplicates and no gaps?

screens.zh: 能不能把模糊的业务问题拆成查得动的问题，给出让人敢照着做决定的结论。
screens.en: Can turn a vague business question into a queryable one and land a finding someone will act on.

asks.zh: 一个核心指标一夜之间掉了 20%，你怎么查？
asks.en: A core metric dropped 20% overnight — how do you investigate?

asks.zh: 讲一个你的分析真的改变了业务决策的例子。
asks.en: Walk me through an analysis of yours that actually changed a decision.

asks.zh: 实验结果不显著，业务方还想上，你怎么说？
asks.en: The experiment isn't significant but the team still wants to ship — what do you say?

asks.zh: 相关和因果你怎么分，举一个你踩过的例子。
asks.en: How do you separate correlation from causation — give me one you got wrong.

insider.zh: 强的人先问这个结论要支持什么决定，弱的人拿到需求就跑数，交一堆图表让业务方自己看。
insider.en: Strong analysts ask which decision the finding has to support first; weak ones start querying on receipt and hand over charts for the business to interpret.

followups.zh: 那次结论如果反过来，你的建议会变吗？
followups.en: If that finding had gone the other way, would your recommendation change?

followups.zh: 你怎么排除是口径变化或者埋点变更造成的波动？
followups.en: How do you rule out a definition change or a tracking change causing the swing?

screens.zh: 能不能把指标口径定住、看板做得有人真在用，而不是攒一堆没人打开的报表。
screens.en: Can lock down the metric layer and build dashboards people actually open, instead of piling up reports.

asks.zh: 一个指标的口径你怎么定，谁来确认？
asks.en: How do you define a metric, and who signs off?

asks.zh: 两个部门同一个指标的数对不上，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Two departments' numbers for the same metric don't match — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 看板做完没人用，你怎么办？
asks.en: The dashboard shipped and nobody uses it — what now?

asks.zh: 报表查得慢，你从哪几层优化？
asks.en: Reports are slow — which layers do you optimise?

insider.zh: 强的人先把指标定义和责任人定下来，弱的人有求必应做报表，最后一个指标好几个版本。
insider.en: Strong BI engineers converge definitions and name an owner first; weak ones build every report requested until one metric has several versions.

followups.zh: 你的看板每天多少人在看，都是谁？
followups.en: How many people open your dashboard daily, and who are they?

followups.zh: 那批下线的报表，你怎么说服业务方的？
followups.en: How did you convince the business to retire those reports?

screens.zh: 能不能把业务问题转成建得出来、上得了线的模型，还说得清值多少钱。
screens.en: Can turn a business problem into a model that can be built and shipped, and say what it's worth.

asks.zh: 你的模型上线后比基线好多少，怎么验证的？
asks.en: How much better is your model than the baseline in production, and how was that validated?

asks.zh: 样本不平衡、标签又脏，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Labels are dirty and classes imbalanced — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 业务方要可解释，效果要让一步，你怎么定？
asks.en: The business wants interpretability at some cost to performance — how do you decide?

asks.zh: 一个模型上线三个月效果衰减，你怎么查？
asks.en: A model decayed three months after launch — how do you investigate?

insider.zh: 强的人拿对照实验和业务收益说话，弱的人只报离线指标，说不清上线之后值多少钱。
insider.en: Strong data scientists argue with holdout experiments and business impact; weak ones report offline scores and can't say what it's worth live.

followups.zh: 你说的收益，业务方或者财务认吗？
followups.en: Does the business owner or finance accept that impact number?

followups.zh: 特征里有没有用到预测那一刻拿不到的信息？
followups.en: Do any features use information unavailable at prediction time?

screens.zh: 能不能在一堆取数需求里判断该建什么能力，把数据做成产品而不是需求池。
screens.en: Can judge which capability to build out of a pile of ad-hoc data requests, making data a product rather than a queue.

asks.zh: 一堆临时取数需求，你怎么判断哪些该做成产品？
asks.en: A stack of ad-hoc pull requests — how do you decide which to productise?

asks.zh: 数据平台的优先级你怎么排，用什么衡量做得值？
asks.en: How do you prioritise the data platform, and how do you measure whether it was worth it?

asks.zh: 指标口径上业务和技术各执一词，你怎么拍？
asks.en: Business and engineering disagree on a metric definition — how do you rule?

asks.zh: 你做过的数据产品，谁在用，用出了什么结果？
asks.en: A data product you built — who uses it, and what came of it?

insider.zh: 强的人说得出自己产品有多少人在用、替业务省下多少时间，弱的人把工作汇报成上线了多少张看板。
insider.en: Strong data PMs can quote users and the hours they saved the business; weak ones report how many dashboards shipped.

followups.zh: 那个功能上线后使用率多少，没人用的部分你怎么处理？
followups.en: What's the adoption rate after launch, and what do you do with the unused parts?

followups.zh: 你砍掉过什么需求，怎么跟需求方谈的？
followups.en: What have you killed, and how did you tell the requester?

screens.zh: 能不能在没有强制权力的位置上，把质量规则和权限真落进管线，而不是发一份规范就完事。
screens.en: Can get quality rules and access controls into the pipelines from a seat with no authority, not just publish a standard.

asks.zh: 数据质量规则你怎么定，卡在哪一层？
asks.en: How do you set data quality rules, and at which layer do they block?

asks.zh: 一张核心表出了脏数据，你的排查和归责流程是什么？
asks.en: Dirty data landed in a core table — what's your triage and accountability flow?

asks.zh: 血缘你怎么采，采不全的那部分怎么补？
asks.en: How do you collect lineage, and how do you fill the gaps?

asks.zh: 权限收紧后业务方抱怨取不到数，你怎么平衡？
asks.en: Access got tighter and the business can't get its data — how do you balance it?

insider.zh: 强的人把规则做成上线前的卡口和自动检测，弱的人靠发规范、出事之后追责。
insider.en: Strong governance leads turn rules into pre-release gates and automated checks; weak ones circulate a standard and assign blame after the fact.

followups.zh: 治理之后质量指标从多少变到了多少？
followups.en: After governance, what did the quality metrics move from and to?

followups.zh: 有团队不配合，你靠什么推动？
followups.en: A team won't cooperate — what leverage do you have?

screens.zh: 能不能在内存和功耗都很紧的芯片上把固件写稳，远程升级失败也不会把设备刷成砖。
screens.en: Can write stable firmware on a chip tight on RAM and power, and update over the air without bricking.

asks.zh: 一个电池设备的功耗你怎么降，量到了多少？
asks.en: How do you cut power draw on a battery device, and what did you measure it down to?

asks.zh: 空中升级你怎么做，升级过程中断电了怎么办？
asks.en: How does your OTA work, and what happens if power drops mid-update?

asks.zh: 一个偶发死机，实验室复现不出来，你怎么查？
asks.en: An intermittent hang you can't reproduce on the bench — how do you chase it?

asks.zh: 中断和任务优先级你怎么排，遇到过优先级反转吗？
asks.en: How do you assign interrupt and task priorities — ever hit priority inversion?

insider.zh: 强的人用示波器、逻辑分析仪和日志把偶发问题定住，弱的人加一堆打印，问题好了也说不清为什么。
insider.en: Strong embedded engineers pin intermittent bugs with a scope, a logic analyser and logs; weak ones sprinkle prints and never learn why it stopped.

followups.zh: 你说的功耗数据是哪种工况下测的？
followups.en: Under what duty cycle was that power figure measured?

followups.zh: 现场那批设备起不来了，你的回滚方案是什么？
followups.en: A field batch bricked — what's your rollback path?

screens.zh: 能不能把板子设计成量产做得出、认证过得去，器件选型经得起供货和成本的推敲。
screens.en: Can design a board that manufactures and certifies, with component choices that survive supply and cost scrutiny.

asks.zh: 你这版板子改了几次，每次是因为什么？
asks.en: How many revisions did this board take, and what drove each one?

asks.zh: 电磁兼容测试没过，你怎么定位、怎么整改？
asks.en: It failed EMC — how do you localise and fix it?

asks.zh: 一颗主芯片停产或者涨价，你怎么换？
asks.en: A main chip goes end-of-life or spikes in price — how do you swap it?

asks.zh: 户外设备的防水防尘和温漂你怎么处理？
asks.en: How do you handle ingress protection and temperature drift on outdoor units?

insider.zh: 强的人从量产、认证和供货倒推着选器件，弱的人只按功能选，样机能跑就交出去。
insider.en: Strong hardware engineers choose parts backwards from production, certification and supply; weak ones pick on function and hand over a working prototype.

followups.zh: 你的物料成本降了多少，牺牲了什么？
followups.en: How much bill-of-materials cost did you take out, and what did you give up?

followups.zh: 这颗替代料你验证到了什么程度？
followups.en: How far did you qualify the alternate part?

screens.zh: 能不能想清楚哪些计算留在边缘、哪些送云端，断网的时候现场还能自己跑。
screens.en: Can reason about what computes at the edge and what goes to the cloud, and keep the site running when the link drops.

asks.zh: 哪些逻辑你放在边缘，判断依据是什么？
asks.en: Which logic sits at the edge, and on what basis?

asks.zh: 网关断网两小时，数据和控制怎么办？
asks.en: The gateway is offline for two hours — what happens to data and control?

asks.zh: 上千个网关的程序和模型怎么远程更新？
asks.en: How do you update software and models on a thousand gateways remotely?

asks.zh: 边缘设备资源有限，模型怎么裁？
asks.en: Resources are tight on the edge box — how do you shrink the model?

insider.zh: 强的人拿延迟、带宽成本和断网可用性算这条边界，弱的人凭感觉把能搬的都搬到边缘。
insider.en: Strong edge engineers draw that boundary with latency, bandwidth cost and offline availability; weak ones push whatever can move to the edge on instinct.

followups.zh: 断网期间攒下的数据回传时，怎么防止把云端打垮？
followups.en: When the backlog flushes after reconnect, how do you keep it from flooding the cloud?

followups.zh: 边缘和云端的规则不一致时以谁为准？
followups.en: When edge and cloud rules disagree, which wins?

screens.zh: 能不能在真实环境的干扰和遮挡下把连接做稳，制式选型说得出取舍。
screens.en: Can keep connectivity stable through real-world interference and obstruction, and defend the radio choice.

asks.zh: 这个场景你选哪种无线制式，为什么不选另外两种？
asks.en: Which radio technology for this deployment, and why not the other two?

asks.zh: 现场丢包掉线，你怎么分清是射频、协议还是环境问题？
asks.en: Packet loss and dropouts on site — how do you tell RF from protocol from environment?

asks.zh: 几百个节点组网，你怎么防止互相干扰？
asks.en: Hundreds of nodes in one network — how do you avoid mutual interference?

asks.zh: 功耗和上报频率怎么折中，电池要撑几年？
asks.en: How do you trade power against reporting interval when the battery has to last years?

insider.zh: 强的人手里有现场实测数据，说得出接收灵敏度、丢包率和真实覆盖距离，弱的人照搬芯片手册上的理论值。
insider.en: Strong RF engineers carry field measurements — sensitivity, packet loss, real range; weak ones quote the datasheet.

followups.zh: 手册上的距离和你实测差多少，差在哪？
followups.en: How far off is the datasheet range from your field result, and why?

followups.zh: 现场有别的设备抢同一个频段，你怎么办？
followups.en: Another system is on the same band on site — what do you do?

screens.zh: 能不能撑住海量设备长连接和批量升级，设备身份、影子和离线判定都设计过。
screens.en: Can hold up mass device connections and firmware rollouts, having designed identity, shadow and offline state.

asks.zh: 百万级设备长连接，你的接入层怎么设计？
asks.en: A million devices on persistent connections — how do you design the ingress tier?

asks.zh: 设备批量重连把服务打垮过吗，你怎么防？
asks.en: Has a mass reconnect ever taken the service down, and how do you prevent it?

asks.zh: 设备影子和指令下发怎么保证最终执行到？
asks.en: How do device shadow and command delivery guarantee eventual execution?

asks.zh: 设备离线怎么判定，误判会造成什么？
asks.en: How do you decide a device is offline, and what does a false call cost?

insider.zh: 强的人把重连风暴和弱网当成常态来设计，弱的人按普通网页服务的思路做接入。
insider.en: Strong platform engineers design for reconnect storms and flaky links as the normal case; weak ones build ingress like an ordinary web service.

followups.zh: 一次固件批量升级你怎么灰度，失败怎么回滚？
followups.en: How do you canary a mass firmware rollout, and roll back a failure?

followups.zh: 指令下发失败的那些设备，你怎么补上？
followups.en: The devices whose commands failed — how do you catch them up?

screens.zh: 能不能把时序数据存得下、查得快，告警调到既不漏报也不刷屏。
screens.en: Can store and query time-series at volume, and tune alerting that neither misses nor floods.

asks.zh: 时序数据你怎么存，降采样和保留策略怎么定？
asks.en: How do you store time-series, and how do you set downsampling and retention?

asks.zh: 告警太多没人看，你怎么收敛？
asks.en: Alerts are too noisy for anyone to read — how do you consolidate?

asks.zh: 传感器数据跳变和缺失，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Sensor readings spike and drop out — how do you handle that?

asks.zh: 规则引擎的规则谁来配，配错了拿什么兜？
asks.en: Who authors the rules in the rule engine, and what catches a bad one?

insider.zh: 强的人拿误报率和漏报率调阈值，弱的人阈值一设就不管，最后现场把告警全关了。
insider.en: Strong IoT data engineers tune thresholds against false-positive and miss rates; weak ones set a threshold once until the site turns alerting off entirely.

followups.zh: 你的告警里有多少条最后真有人处理？
followups.en: What share of your alerts actually got acted on?

followups.zh: 设备时间不准导致数据错位，你怎么校？
followups.en: Device clocks drift and misalign the data — how do you correct it?

screens.zh: 能不能把设备数据做成现场的人真用得下去的界面，实时性和异常状态都照顾到。
screens.en: Can turn device data into a screen the people on site will actually use, with live updates and abnormal states handled.

asks.zh: 上千个点位的实时看板，你怎么保证不卡？
asks.en: A live dashboard with thousands of tags — how do you keep it responsive?

asks.zh: 设备离线或者数据延迟，界面上怎么表达？
asks.en: A device goes offline or data lags — how does the UI say so?

asks.zh: 现场工人不看手机只看大屏，你怎么设计？
asks.en: Workers on the floor watch a wall display, not a phone — how do you design for that?

asks.zh: 控制指令从界面发出去，怎么让人知道到底执行了没有？
asks.en: A control command goes out from the UI — how does the operator know it executed?

insider.zh: 强的人去过现场，知道操作的人戴着手套、光线还很差，弱的人按后台管理系统的套路堆表格。
insider.en: Strong IoT app developers have been on site and know the operator wears gloves in bad light; weak ones lay out tables like a back-office admin panel.

followups.zh: 那个界面上线后现场怎么反馈的，你改了什么？
followups.en: What did the site say after launch, and what did you change?

followups.zh: 断网时界面上还是几分钟前的数，你怎么标注？
followups.en: Offline, the screen shows data minutes old — how do you label that?

screens.zh: 能不能在客户现场把需求、可行性和成本一起谈定，方案交得出去也落得下去。
screens.en: Can settle requirements, feasibility and cost with the customer on site, and hand over something that lands.

asks.zh: 客户要的功能现有平台做不到，你怎么谈？
asks.en: The customer wants what the platform can't do — how do you handle the conversation?

asks.zh: 一个项目的硬件、施工和运维成本你怎么估？
asks.en: How do you cost hardware, installation and ongoing service on a project?

asks.zh: 现场环境和方案假设不一样，你怎么改？
asks.en: The site doesn't match your design assumptions — how do you adapt?

asks.zh: 一个失败的项目，卡在哪，你的责任是什么？
asks.en: A project that failed — where did it stall, and what was your part?

insider.zh: 强的人在签合同之前就把现场的坑摸清楚，弱的人先答应下来，交付时才发现做不到。
insider.en: Strong solutions engineers walk the site and find the traps before the contract is signed; weak ones say yes and discover it at delivery.

followups.zh: 你估的成本和最后实际差多少，差在哪？
followups.en: How far off was your cost estimate, and where?

followups.zh: 客户的验收标准怎么写的，谁签字？
followups.en: How is the acceptance criterion written, and who signs it?

screens.zh: 能不能把硬件、连接和软件的账一起算，选对场景并说清客户为什么愿意付钱。
screens.en: Can add up hardware, connectivity and software economics together, pick the right use case and say why anyone pays.

asks.zh: 你这个产品的成本结构是什么，硬件、流量卡和云各占多少？
asks.en: What's the cost structure — how much is hardware, SIM data and cloud?

asks.zh: 一个场景你怎么判断值不值得做？
asks.en: How do you judge whether a use case is worth building?

asks.zh: 硬件已经量产了，需求变了怎么办？
asks.en: Hardware is already in production and the requirement changes — what now?

asks.zh: 设备卖出去之后的服务费怎么收，客户认吗？
asks.en: How do you charge for service after the device is sold, and does the customer accept it?

insider.zh: 强的人提前把硬件迭代慢、装到现场就难改这件事算进方案，弱的人按软件产品的节奏排需求。
insider.en: Strong IoT PMs price in that hardware iterates slowly and is hard to change once installed; weak ones plan the roadmap on a software cadence.

followups.zh: 一台设备一年的连接成本是多少？
followups.en: What does connectivity cost per device per year?

followups.zh: 已经装在客户现场的老设备怎么兼容新功能？
followups.en: How do older units already in the field get the new feature?

screens.zh: 能不能在便宜的硬件上把设备身份和固件保护做到位，又不把成本和产线拖住。
screens.en: Can get device identity and firmware protection right on cheap hardware without stalling cost or the production line.

asks.zh: 设备的身份和密钥怎么发放，产线上怎么写进去？
asks.en: How are device identities and keys issued, and how are they written on the line?

asks.zh: 固件被人扒下来逆向，你有哪些防护？
asks.en: Someone pulls the firmware and reverses it — what protections do you have?

asks.zh: 一批已经在现场的设备发现漏洞，你怎么修？
asks.en: A vulnerability is found in a batch already deployed — how do you patch it?

asks.zh: 加密带来的开销在低功耗设备上怎么权衡？
asks.en: How do you trade the overhead of encryption against a low-power device?

insider.zh: 强的人从产线上注入密钥一路管到现场升级，弱的人在通信上加个加密就说安全做完了。
insider.en: Strong IoT security engineers own the chain from key injection on the line to field updates; weak ones encrypt the transport and call it done.

followups.zh: 设备出厂之后密钥还能不能轮换，怎么换？
followups.en: Can keys be rotated after the unit ships, and how?

followups.zh: 那次漏洞最终有多少设备升级上了，剩下的怎么办？
followups.en: How many devices actually took that patch, and what about the rest?

screens.zh: 能不能从用户行为里找到真问题，把它落成能验证的方案，说清动了哪个指标。
screens.en: Can they find the real problem in user behavior, ship a testable solution, and name the metric it moved.

asks.zh: 你上一个版本改了什么，哪个指标动了，动了多少？
asks.en: What did your last release change, which metric moved, and by how much?

asks.zh: 一个功能上线后留存没起来，你怎么判断是需求没找准还是体验没做好？
asks.en: Retention didn't lift after launch — how do you tell whether the need or the experience was wrong?

asks.zh: 手上五个需求只排得下两个，你怎么定顺序？
asks.en: Five asks, room for two — how do you sequence them?

asks.zh: 挑一个你天天在用的产品，说一处你会改的地方和理由。
asks.en: Pick a product you use daily and name one thing you'd change, and why.

insider.zh: 强的人讲得出这个决定背后的用户场景和自己放弃了什么，弱的人只会背需求清单和上线时间。
insider.en: Strong PMs name the user situation behind a call and what they gave up; weak ones recite the backlog and the ship date.

followups.zh: 这个指标涨了，你怎么排除是同期活动带来的？
followups.en: That metric rose — how did you rule out the campaign running at the same time?

followups.zh: 数据和用户访谈说的相反，你信哪个？
followups.en: If the data and the user interviews disagree, which do you trust?

screens.zh: 看作品集里的判断力，能不能说清每一屏为什么这么排，改稿时靠什么依据而不是个人审美。
screens.en: Judgment in the portfolio — why each screen is laid out that way, and what evidence drives a revision rather than taste.

asks.zh: 挑作品集里一个流程，讲你砍掉了哪些步骤、为什么。
asks.en: Take one flow from your portfolio — which steps did you cut, and why?

asks.zh: 产品经理给的流程你觉得不对，你怎么推回去？
asks.en: You think the PM's flow is wrong — how do you push back?

asks.zh: 你怎么验证一个设计好不好用，做过哪种测试？
asks.en: How do you validate that a design works, and what testing have you run?

asks.zh: 开发说这个交互实现成本太高，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Engineering says the interaction is too expensive to build — what then?

insider.zh: 强的人讲得出每个界面元素解决的具体使用障碍，弱的人只谈版式好看和参考了哪个大厂。
insider.en: Strong designers name the specific friction each element removes; weak ones talk layout and which big-name app they copied.

followups.zh: 这个方案在低网速和老机型上会怎样？
followups.en: How does this hold up on a slow network and an old handset?

followups.zh: 你说做过可用性测试，找了几个人，问的是什么？
followups.en: You ran usability testing — with how many people, asking what?

screens.zh: 手写代码的基本功、把需求拆成接口和数据模型的能力，以及线上出问题时的排查路数。
screens.en: Coding fundamentals, turning a requirement into APIs and a data model, and a real routine for debugging production.

asks.zh: 这个接口背后的表你怎么设计，索引加在哪？
asks.en: How would you design the tables behind this API, and where do the indexes go?

asks.zh: 接口响应突然变慢，你按什么顺序排查？
asks.en: The endpoint suddenly slows down — in what order do you investigate?

asks.zh: 高并发下扣库存怎么保证不超卖？
asks.en: How do you keep inventory from overselling under high concurrency?

asks.zh: 缓存和数据库不一致了，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Cache and database are out of sync — how do you handle it?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清自己的服务在什么量级会先崩、崩在哪一环，弱的人只答用了什么框架和中间件。
insider.en: Strong engineers know at what load their service breaks and which hop goes first; weak ones just list frameworks and middleware.

followups.zh: 你说加了缓存，缓存击穿和雪崩你怎么防？
followups.en: You added a cache — how do you guard against stampedes and cascading misses?

followups.zh: 这个事务边界画在哪，为什么？
followups.en: Where does the transaction boundary sit, and why?

screens.zh: 能不能把线上指标的问题拆成召回、排序、特征上的具体动作，并且分得清离线涨和线上涨。
screens.en: Can they break a live-metric problem into concrete moves in recall, ranking and features, and tell an offline gain from a real online one.

asks.zh: 你的模型上线后哪个指标涨了，离线指标涨了线上没涨你怎么查？
asks.en: Which metric moved after your model shipped, and if offline gains don't show online, how do you chase it?

asks.zh: 召回和排序你各做过什么，训练样本怎么构造的？
asks.en: What have you built in recall versus ranking, and how did you construct training samples?

asks.zh: 新用户和新内容的冷启动你怎么做？
asks.en: How do you cold-start new users and new items?

asks.zh: 一个线上实验多久能看结论，怎么判断它被污染了？
asks.en: How long before an experiment is readable, and how do you tell it's contaminated?

insider.zh: 强的人讲得清样本怎么采、特征穿越怎么躲，弱的人只报模型结构和论文名字。
insider.en: Strong engineers explain how samples were drawn and how leakage was avoided; weak ones recite architectures and paper names.

followups.zh: 那次特征穿越你是怎么发现的？
followups.en: How did you catch that feature leakage?

followups.zh: 长期留存和当下点击冲突，你的目标函数怎么配权重？
followups.en: When long-term retention fights same-session clicks, how is your objective weighted?

screens.zh: 能不能把留存和活跃拆到具体人群和动作上，靠一轮轮策略把数推上去，而不是只做活动执行。
screens.en: Can they break retention and engagement down to cohorts and actions and push the numbers with successive plays, not just run events.

asks.zh: 次日留存掉了三个点，你先查什么？
asks.en: Day-one retention dropped three points — what do you check first?

asks.zh: 你做过效果最好的一次活动，成本和真正拉回的用户算得清吗？
asks.en: Your best campaign — can you account for its cost and the users it actually brought back?

asks.zh: 沉默用户你怎么分层，每层的唤醒动作分别是什么？
asks.en: How do you segment dormant users, and what's the wake-up action for each?

asks.zh: 推送发多了用户会烦，你怎么定频次和人群？
asks.en: Too many pushes annoy people — how do you set frequency and audience?

insider.zh: 强的人做完一轮说得清哪个人群哪个动作有效、下一轮改什么，弱的人只汇报办了几场活动、发了多少券。
insider.en: Strong ops can say which cohort and action worked and what changes next round; weak ones report campaigns run and coupons sent.

followups.zh: 你唤醒回来的用户，第二周还在吗？
followups.en: Are the users you reactivated still there a week later?

followups.zh: 去掉自然回流，这次留存提升还剩多少？
followups.en: Strip out organic return — how much of that retention lift is left?

screens.zh: 能不能一边把获客成本压住一边把规模做上去，还看得懂后端留存和回本，而不只是前端量。
screens.en: Can they hold acquisition cost down while scaling volume, and read downstream retention and payback, not just top-of-funnel counts.

asks.zh: 你负责的获客成本从多少做到多少，靠哪几个动作？
asks.en: Where did your acquisition cost start and end, and which moves got you there?

asks.zh: 一个渠道量能起但留存差，你砍还是留？
asks.en: A channel delivers volume but poor retention — do you cut it or keep it?

asks.zh: 讲一次失败的增长实验，你之后改了什么判断？
asks.en: A growth experiment that failed — what judgment did you change after?

asks.zh: 预算翻倍你怎么花，边际成本你盯什么？
asks.en: Budget doubles — how do you spend it, and how do you watch marginal cost?

insider.zh: 强的人算到用户回本周期和渠道衰减，弱的人只报下载量和注册数。
insider.en: Strong leads track payback period and channel decay; weak ones report installs and signups.

followups.zh: 这条渠道的量里，有多少是本来就会来的人？
followups.en: How much of that channel's volume would have come anyway?

followups.zh: 实验的样本量和显著性你是怎么定的？
followups.en: How did you set sample size and significance?

screens.zh: 能不能自己找到线索、推动客户内部多个角色一起点头，把单子按预测的节奏签下来。
screens.en: Can they source their own pipeline, work a multi-stakeholder decision, and close on the timeline they forecast.

asks.zh: 讲你签下的最大一单，线索从哪来，中间卡在哪。
asks.en: Walk your biggest win — where did the lead come from, and where did it stall?

asks.zh: 客户说要再考虑一下然后就没声了，你怎么推进？
asks.en: The buyer says they'll think about it and goes quiet — how do you move it?

asks.zh: 你的季度预测怎么做，上季度准不准？
asks.en: How do you build a quarterly forecast, and how accurate was last quarter's?

asks.zh: 客户嫌贵要打折，你怎么谈？
asks.en: They push for a discount — how do you negotiate?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清客户里谁批钱、谁能否决、为什么现在必须买，弱的人只熟对接人，报单子时全是有戏。
insider.en: Strong sellers know who signs, who can veto and why the buyer needs it now; weak ones only know their champion and call every deal promising.

followups.zh: 这一单如果丢了，会丢在谁手上？
followups.en: If this deal dies, who kills it?

followups.zh: 你说客户很有意向，他为这件事做过什么动作？
followups.en: You say they're keen — what have they actually done about it?

screens.zh: 懂不懂业务的节奏，能不能把人、财、法的规则落成业务真能用的方案，而不是只念制度。
screens.en: Do they understand the business rhythm and turn people, finance and legal rules into something the business can use, instead of quoting policy.

asks.zh: 业务想要的用人方案不合规，你怎么找到能落地的做法？
asks.en: The hiring plan the business wants isn't compliant — how do you find a workable version?

asks.zh: 你支持的团队一年招了多少人，离职率怎么变的，你做了什么？
asks.en: How many did your team hire last year, how did attrition move, and what did you do?

asks.zh: 业务负责人绕过流程要特批，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A business lead goes around the process asking for an exception — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 预算超了要追加，你怎么审、怎么谈？
asks.en: They're over budget and want more — how do you review it and negotiate?

insider.zh: 强的人给业务两三个能选的方案，把各自的风险摊开说，弱的人只回答政策不允许。
insider.en: Strong partners hand over two or three options with the risk of each spelled out; weak ones only answer that policy forbids it.

followups.zh: 这次你顶回去了，后来业务是怎么解决的？
followups.en: You held the line — how did the business solve it in the end?

followups.zh: 你怎么知道一个团队真实的问题，而不是负责人转述的版本？
followups.en: How do you learn what's actually wrong in a team, not what the lead reports?

screens.zh: 能不能把创作者真招进来还留住，手上有多少能动的资源，单个创作者的产出和收入算不算得清。
screens.en: Can they actually sign creators and keep them posting — how much talent they can reach, and whether they track output and earnings per creator.

asks.zh: 你签过多少创作者，半年后还在更新的有多少？
asks.en: How many creators have you signed, and how many are still posting six months on?

asks.zh: 一个头部达人被别的平台挖，你拿什么留？
asks.en: A top creator is being courted by another platform — what do you keep them with?

asks.zh: 中腰部创作者掉得快，你怎么止住？
asks.en: Mid-tier creators churn fast — how do you stop it?

asks.zh: 你怎么判断一个新人值不值得给资源？
asks.en: How do you judge whether a newcomer deserves support?

insider.zh: 强的人盯签下来之后的更新率和创作者到手收入，弱的人只报签约数和粉丝量。
insider.en: Strong ops watch posting frequency and what creators actually earn after signing; weak ones report signed counts and follower numbers.

followups.zh: 你给出去的流量扶持，回报怎么算的？
followups.en: The traffic support you granted — how do you measure the return?

followups.zh: 那个头部达人最后留下了吗，代价是什么？
followups.en: Did that top creator stay, and at what cost?

screens.zh: 对内容的手感和执行密度，能不能自己找到能起量的选题，并说清它为什么会起。
screens.en: Feel for content and sheer execution volume — can they find topics that travel and explain why they will.

asks.zh: 最近平台上哪条内容火了，你觉得为什么？
asks.en: What blew up on the platform recently, and why do you think it did?

asks.zh: 你策划的哪个选题起量了，播放和互动是多少？
asks.en: A topic you planned that took off — what were the views and the interaction?

asks.zh: 一个话题数据不行，你是改还是直接换？
asks.en: A topic underperforms — do you fix it or drop it?

asks.zh: 你每天怎么找选题，看哪些地方？
asks.en: How do you find topics day to day, and where do you look?

insider.zh: 强的人说得出内容的钩子和前三秒做了什么，弱的人只说内容质量高、赶上了热点。
insider.en: Strong ops name the hook and what the first three seconds did; weak ones just say the content was good and the trend was hot.

followups.zh: 同一个选题换个创作者做还起得来吗，为什么？
followups.en: Would the same topic travel with a different creator, and why?

followups.zh: 你说的爆款，是推给了更多人，还是完播率高？
followups.en: That hit — was it pushed to more people, or did completion rate carry it?

screens.zh: 编解码和播放链路上的真实经验，能不能在画质、码率、秒开和成本之间找到交付得出去的平衡。
screens.en: Real codec and playback-path experience — can they balance quality, bitrate, instant start and cost into something shippable.

asks.zh: 秒开率上不去，你从哪几个环节查？
asks.en: Instant-start rate is stuck — which parts of the path do you check?

asks.zh: 同样画质下你怎么把码率降下来，降了多少？
asks.en: How do you cut bitrate at the same quality, and by how much did you?

asks.zh: 转码集群成本太高，你怎么优化？
asks.en: The transcoding cluster costs too much — how do you bring it down?

asks.zh: 弱网下的卡顿和花屏你怎么处理？
asks.en: How do you handle stalls and artifacts on weak networks?

insider.zh: 强的人拿画质评分和带宽成本一起说话，弱的人只说自己换了新编码器。
insider.en: Strong engineers argue quality scores and bandwidth cost together; weak ones just say they switched encoders.

followups.zh: 你说画质没降，用什么指标衡量的？
followups.en: You say quality held — measured with what?
