followups.zh: 老机型解不了新编码，你怎么兜底？
followups.en: Old devices can't decode the new codec — what's your fallback?

screens.zh: 能不能在时长、互动和创作者供给之间配好多目标，并且分得清自己的模型改动和大盘波动。
screens.en: Can they balance watch-time, interaction and creator supply as multiple objectives, and separate their model change from a platform-wide swing.

asks.zh: 你做的哪一版排序模型真的有效，提了什么，多少？
asks.en: Which ranking model version actually worked, what did it lift, and by how much?

asks.zh: 时长涨了但互动掉了，你怎么调？
asks.en: Watch-time is up but interaction is down — how do you retune?

asks.zh: 刚发布的内容没有行为数据，怎么让它有机会被看到？
asks.en: A fresh upload has no behavior data — how does it get a chance to be seen?

asks.zh: 多目标怎么融合，权重是怎么定下来的？
asks.en: How do you fuse multiple objectives, and how were the weights set?

insider.zh: 强的人清楚自己的模型对内容生态做了什么，弱的人把单一指标优化上去，供给那头却塌了。
insider.en: Strong engineers know what their model does to the content ecosystem; weak ones optimize one metric and starve supply.

followups.zh: 你说时长提了，是不是靠推更长的视频？
followups.en: The watch-time lift — did longer videos do it for you?

followups.zh: 实验期间大盘本身也在涨，你怎么拆开？
followups.en: The platform was also growing during the test — how did you separate the two?

screens.zh: 对违规边界的判断和策略手感，能不能在漏放和误伤之间把阈值定住，还扛得住舆情与监管压力。
screens.en: Judgment on where the line sits and a feel for policy — can they set thresholds between misses and false takedowns and hold up under public and regulatory pressure.

asks.zh: 一条内容正好在边界上，你放还是拦，依据是什么？
asks.en: A borderline piece — do you keep it or remove it, and on what basis?

asks.zh: 误伤申诉量突然涨上来，你怎么查？
asks.en: False-takedown appeals spike — how do you investigate?

asks.zh: 机审和人审的比例你怎么定，机审阈值怎么调？
asks.en: How do you split machine and human review, and how do you tune the model threshold?

asks.zh: 出现一种新的规避手法，你多久能拦住？
asks.en: A new evasion tactic appears — how fast can you block it?

insider.zh: 强的人拿漏放率和误伤率两头一起谈，弱的人只报审核量和一个准确率数字。
insider.en: Strong strategists argue miss rate and false-takedown rate together; weak ones report review volume and a single accuracy number.

followups.zh: 你说的准确率，分母是什么？
followups.en: That accuracy figure — what's the denominator?

followups.zh: 突发事件时审核量翻几倍，你怎么排人、怎么调策略？
followups.en: Volume triples during a breaking event — how do you staff and re-tune?

screens.zh: 能不能把氛围这件说不清的事拆成具体动作，既管得住核心用户，又不被他们绑住。
screens.en: Can they turn something as vague as vibe into concrete actions, and manage core users without being captured by them.

asks.zh: 你运营的社区里核心用户有多少，你怎么维护他们？
asks.en: How many core users does your community have, and how do you keep them?

asks.zh: 一个话题吵起来、快要出圈了，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A thread turns into a fight about to spill outside the platform — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 老用户嫌新人拉低氛围，你站哪边？
asks.en: Old-timers say newcomers are ruining the place — whose side are you on?

asks.zh: 社区氛围的好坏你用什么衡量？
asks.en: How do you measure whether the community is healthy?

insider.zh: 强的人有一份自己的核心用户名单和一套介入动作，弱的人只会发公告和置顶。
insider.en: Strong ops keep their own list of core users and a playbook for stepping in; weak ones only post announcements and pin threads.

followups.zh: 你介入那次争议之后，双方的活跃分别怎么变的？
followups.en: After you stepped into that fight, how did each side's activity move?

followups.zh: 你的干预有没有被用户看出来是运营在推？
followups.en: Could users tell it was ops steering it?

screens.zh: 对 feed 和互动产品的手感，能不能把停留和复访拆成具体改动，再用实验把结论落住。
screens.en: Feel for feed and interaction product — can they turn dwell and return into specific changes and settle them with experiments.

asks.zh: 你改过 feed 的哪个环节，人均时长动了多少？
asks.en: Which part of the feed did you change, and how much did time per user move?

asks.zh: 新用户前三天流失最多，你会先改哪一步？
asks.en: New users drop off hardest in the first three days — which step do you fix first?

asks.zh: 一个互动功能上线后没人用，你怎么复盘？
asks.en: An interaction feature ships and nobody uses it — how do you review it?

asks.zh: 时长和用户口碑冲突的时候，你怎么定？
asks.en: Watch-time and how users feel about the product conflict — how do you call it?

insider.zh: 强的人说得清一次改动同时影响了哪几个指标、代价在哪，弱的人只报涨了的那一个。
insider.en: Strong PMs name every metric one change touched and what it cost; weak ones report only the one that went up.

followups.zh: 这个功能是新增了互动，还是把评论从别处搬了过来？
followups.en: Did the feature create new interaction, or move comments in from elsewhere?

followups.zh: 实验只跑了一周，长期效应你怎么判断？
followups.en: One week of testing — how do you judge the long-run effect?

screens.zh: 能不能把买量、社交裂变和站内召回搭成一套跑得起规模的组合，也说得清活跃数里的水分。
screens.en: Can they combine paid, social referral and in-product win-back into something that scales, and be honest about what pads the active numbers.

asks.zh: 你负责的 DAU 从多少做到多少，拆开看是谁带来的？
asks.en: Where did your DAU start and end, and broken down, who brought it?

asks.zh: 买量成本涨了三成，你怎么应对？
asks.en: Media costs rise thirty percent — what do you do?

asks.zh: 买来的用户七天留存多少，比自然流量差多少？
asks.en: What's seven-day retention on paid users versus organic?

asks.zh: 裂变活动怎么防刷，你被刷过吗？
asks.en: How do you stop referral programs from being farmed, and have you been hit?

insider.zh: 强的人分得清新增里有多少是真人，弱的人只看总量涨了多少。
insider.en: Strong leads know how much of the new volume is real people; weak ones only see the total go up.

followups.zh: 去掉活动期，你说的活跃提升还剩多少？
followups.en: Take out the campaign window — how much of the lift remains?

followups.zh: 召回来的老用户是被什么召回的，你验证过吗？
followups.en: What actually brought the lapsed users back, and did you verify it?

screens.zh: 竞价机制和广告库存的功底，能不能在广告主效果、平台收入和用户体验三头之间做定量取舍。
screens.en: Auction mechanics and inventory fundamentals — can they trade advertiser performance, platform revenue and user experience with numbers.

asks.zh: 广告加载率提一个点，收入和留存各怎么变，你怎么定这个点？
asks.en: One more point of ad load — what happens to revenue and retention, and how do you settle on the number?

asks.zh: 竞价机制你做过哪一块，出价和排序公式怎么设计的？
asks.en: Which part of the auction have you owned, and how did you design bidding and ranking?

asks.zh: 广告主说投不出量，你从哪几处查？
asks.en: An advertiser says they can't spend — where do you look?

asks.zh: 中小广告主和大客户的需求打架，你先做谁的？
asks.en: Long-tail advertisers and key accounts want opposite things — who do you build for first?

insider.zh: 强的人算得清一次机制调整对广告主投放回报和平台单位流量收入各有什么影响，弱的人只堆定向和创意功能。
insider.en: Strong PMs can price what one mechanism change does to advertiser returns and to platform yield; weak ones pile on targeting and creative features.

followups.zh: 你调了排序公式，谁的量被挤掉了？
followups.en: You changed the ranking formula — whose spend got squeezed out?

followups.zh: 广告变多对体验的损耗，你用什么口径衡量？
followups.en: The experience cost of more ads — what measure do you use?

screens.zh: 投放操盘的实战手感，能不能盯住成本和消耗，在素材和定向上快速试出跑得动的组合。
screens.en: Hands-on delivery — can they hold cost and spend, and find a working creative-and-targeting combination fast.

asks.zh: 你手上最大的账户一天消耗多少，成本控在什么水平？
asks.en: Your biggest account — daily spend, and what cost did you hold it at?

asks.zh: 一条计划突然跑不动了，你按什么顺序调？
asks.en: A campaign suddenly stops delivering — in what order do you adjust?

asks.zh: 素材衰减很快，你怎么保证后面有新素材接上？
asks.en: Creative fatigues fast — how do you keep new assets coming?

asks.zh: 客户要的成本明显低于行业水平，你怎么谈？
asks.en: The client's target cost is well below market — how do you have that conversation?

insider.zh: 强的人知道自己的账户在哪个环节漏量、哪些调整其实没用，弱的人天天改出价看运气。
insider.en: Strong buyers know where their account leaks volume and which levers do nothing; weak ones nudge bids daily and hope.

followups.zh: 你说成本降了，量还在吗？
followups.en: Cost came down — did the volume stay?

followups.zh: 素材是你自己出的，还是等客户给？
followups.en: Did you make the creative yourself or wait for the client's?

screens.zh: 能不能盘住主播和公会，把开播率、单场时长和流水这几个数真拉起来。
screens.en: Can they run streamers and guilds and actually lift streaming hours, session length and gross tipping.

asks.zh: 你负责多少个主播，月流水多少，头部占几成？
asks.en: How many streamers do you run, what's monthly gross, and how much sits in the top few?

asks.zh: 一个主播流水掉了一半，你怎么查？
asks.en: A streamer's revenue halves — how do you investigate?

asks.zh: 开播率上不去，你怎么推？
asks.en: Streaming hours won't rise — how do you push them?

asks.zh: 公会要更多流量和更好的分成，你怎么谈？
asks.en: A guild wants more traffic and a better split — how do you negotiate?

insider.zh: 强的人对主播的开播节奏、连麦和榜单玩法都有具体安排，弱的人只在群里催开播。
insider.en: Strong ops have a plan for a streamer's schedule, co-streams and leaderboard plays; weak ones just nag them to go live in a group chat.

followups.zh: 你给的流量扶持，流水回报是怎么算的？
followups.en: The traffic you granted — how do you compute the revenue return?

followups.zh: 头部主播走了，你手上这盘会怎样？
followups.en: If your top streamer leaves, what happens to your book?

screens.zh: 指标口径的严谨度，以及能不能从数字里给出可执行的结论，而不只是取数和做看板。
screens.en: Rigor on metric definitions, and whether they get an actionable answer out of the numbers instead of just pulling data and building dashboards.

asks.zh: 大盘时长跌了两个点，你怎么定位？
asks.en: Platform watch-time is down two points — how do you localize it?

asks.zh: 一个指标的口径你怎么定，跨团队对不上怎么办？
asks.en: How do you define a metric, and what if teams disagree on the definition?

asks.zh: 你做过的哪个分析改变了业务的决定？
asks.en: Which analysis of yours changed a business decision?

asks.zh: 实验结果不显著，你怎么给结论？
asks.en: The test result isn't significant — what do you conclude?

insider.zh: 强的人先怀疑数据本身再看业务，弱的人拿到异常直接往原因上跳。
insider.en: Strong analysts suspect the data before the business; weak ones see an anomaly and jump straight to a cause.

followups.zh: 那次下跌，你排除埋点和口径变化了吗？
followups.en: That drop — did you rule out a tracking or definition change?

followups.zh: 你说的相关，怎么排除季节和活动的影响？
followups.en: You call it correlation — how did you strip out seasonality and campaigns?

screens.zh: 能不能把一座城的商户、运力、单量和盈亏一起扛住，还带得动一支地面团队。
screens.en: Can they carry a city's merchants, capacity, order volume and P&L together, and lead a field team.

asks.zh: 你管的城市单量和盈亏怎么变的，你做了哪几件事？
asks.en: How did your city's order volume and P&L move, and which few things did you do?

asks.zh: 竞对在你的城市大力补贴，你怎么打？
asks.en: A competitor floods your city with subsidies — how do you fight?

asks.zh: 团队里业绩垫底的人你怎么处理？
asks.en: Your worst-performing team member — how do you deal with it?

asks.zh: 新开一个区域，你第一个月的动作顺序是什么？
asks.en: Opening a new district — what's the order of your moves in month one?

insider.zh: 强的人算得清单均补贴和履约成本对城市盈亏的影响，弱的人只会加补贴、加人。
insider.en: Strong GMs can price what per-order subsidy and delivery cost do to city P&L; weak ones only add subsidy and headcount.

followups.zh: 你这座城的单均成本是多少，拆开都有哪些？
followups.en: What's your cost per order, and what's it made of?

followups.zh: 补贴停了以后单量回落了多少？
followups.en: When the subsidy stopped, how far did volume fall back?

screens.zh: 扛得住拒绝的韧性和当场说服老板签约的本事，也看有没有自己的拜访节奏和跟进记录。
screens.en: Resilience against rejection and the ability to close an owner on the spot, plus a real routine for visits and follow-up records.

asks.zh: 你一天拜访多少家，签下几家？
asks.en: How many merchants do you visit a day, and how many sign?

asks.zh: 老板说已经上了别的平台不想再上，你怎么说？
asks.en: The owner says they're already on another platform — what do you say?

asks.zh: 你签下来的商户，现在还在经营的有多少？
asks.en: How many of the merchants you signed are still trading?

asks.zh: 商户嫌佣金高，你怎么谈？
asks.en: They think the commission is too high — how do you negotiate?

insider.zh: 强的人记得每家老板在意什么、下次上门该带什么，弱的人扫完一条街就没有第二次跟进。
insider.en: Strong BDs remember what each owner cares about and what to bring next visit; weak ones cover a street once and never follow up.

followups.zh: 你签的商户里有多少一个月内就下架了，为什么？
followups.en: How many of your signings went dark within a month, and why?

followups.zh: 你怎么判断一家店签下来真能出单？
followups.en: How do you tell a shop will actually generate orders once it's live?

screens.zh: 能不能真把商户的生意做起来，从菜单、出餐、活动这些具体地方动手，而不是只处理工单。
screens.en: Can they genuinely grow a merchant's business by working the menu, kitchen speed and promotions, rather than closing tickets.

asks.zh: 你带的商户里出单最好的那家，你帮他改了什么？
asks.en: Your best-performing merchant — what did you change for them?

asks.zh: 一家店流量有但转化差，你从哪看？
asks.en: A shop gets traffic but converts badly — where do you look?

asks.zh: 商户不肯参加平台活动，你怎么谈？
asks.en: A merchant refuses to join a platform campaign — how do you talk to them?

asks.zh: 你手上多少商户，精力怎么分配？
asks.en: How many merchants do you carry, and how do you allocate your time?

insider.zh: 强的人会翻商户的菜单和评价，找出单的堵点，弱的人只把平台活动通知一遍。
insider.en: Strong ops read the merchant's menu and reviews to find what blocks orders; weak ones just relay the campaign announcement.

followups.zh: 你说帮他把单量做起来了，其中有多少是平台补贴撑着的？
followups.en: You lifted their orders — how much of that was platform subsidy holding it up?

followups.zh: 商户抱怨佣金和配送费，你怎么把账算给他听？
followups.en: They complain about commission and delivery fees — how do you walk them through the math?

screens.zh: 品类结构和毛利的账，能不能定下货架上主推什么、砍掉什么，并说清对单量和利润的影响。
screens.en: The assortment-and-margin math — can they decide what gets pushed and what gets cut, and say what it does to volume and profit.

asks.zh: 你负责的品类去年单量和毛利怎么变的？
asks.en: How did your category's order volume and margin move last year?

asks.zh: 一个品类在你的城市渗透率低，你怎么补供给？
asks.en: Your category has low penetration in this city — how do you add supply?

asks.zh: 选品你按什么标准，砍过哪些品？
asks.en: What's your selection standard, and what have you cut?

asks.zh: 品类之间抢同一批流量，你怎么分配？
asks.en: Categories compete for the same traffic — how do you allocate?

insider.zh: 强的人从缺什么供给、用户搜了什么没搜到入手，弱的人照着行业榜单抄一遍商品结构。
insider.en: Strong managers start from what supply is missing and what users searched for and didn't find; weak ones copy the industry's top-seller list.

followups.zh: 你说的渗透率，分母是怎么定的？
followups.en: That penetration figure — what's the denominator?

followups.zh: 主推品的毛利和它的拉新价值冲突时，你选哪个？
followups.en: When a hero item's margin fights its acquisition value, which do you pick?

screens.zh: 补贴和活动的账算不算得清，能不能找到既拉得动新客又不一直亏钱的做法。
screens.en: Whether the subsidy and campaign math holds up — can they acquire without bleeding and connect it to repeat orders.

asks.zh: 你发出去的券核销率多少，领券的人后来复购吗？
asks.en: Your coupons — what's the redemption rate, and do the redeemers order again?

asks.zh: 一次活动单量翻倍但亏得厉害，你怎么改？
asks.en: A campaign doubles orders and loses a lot of money — how do you change it?

asks.zh: 首单补贴给多少合适，你怎么试出来的？
asks.en: How much first-order subsidy is right, and how did you find that number?

asks.zh: 搜索和推荐的位置怎么分给不同品类？
asks.en: How do you split search and recommendation slots across categories?

insider.zh: 强的人盯补贴带来的增量订单和回本周期，弱的人只看活动期间那个单量峰值。
insider.en: Strong ops watch incremental orders and payback on subsidy; weak ones only look at the peak during the campaign.

followups.zh: 你说的增量，怎么排除本来就会下单的人？
followups.en: Incremental — how do you exclude people who'd have ordered anyway?

followups.zh: 券停了以后，这批用户还在下单吗？
followups.en: Once the coupons stopped, did that cohort keep ordering?

screens.zh: 能不能把下单、撮合、定价这条链上的异常想全，一条双边规则改下去会牵动谁也清楚。
screens.en: Can they think through every failure case from order to assignment to pricing, and know who a two-sided rule change hits.

asks.zh: 从下单到接单这一段，你处理过哪些异常场景？
asks.en: Between placing and accepting an order, which failure cases have you handled?

asks.zh: 配送费怎么定，涨了用户会流失，你怎么试？
asks.en: How do you set the delivery fee — raise it and users leave, so how do you test it?

asks.zh: 商户超时和骑手超时的责任怎么分，产品上怎么落？
asks.en: Merchant lateness versus rider lateness — how do you assign fault, and how does the product express it?

asks.zh: 高峰期爆单，产品上你有哪些手段？
asks.en: Peak-hour order flood — what product levers do you have?

insider.zh: 强的人一开口就把商户、骑手、用户三方的反应都算进去，弱的人只画用户端那条顺畅流程。
insider.en: Strong PMs work in the merchant, rider and user reaction from the first sentence; weak ones only draw a smooth consumer flow.

followups.zh: 这个规则上线后，骑手会怎么绕过去？
followups.en: With that rule live, how will riders game it?

followups.zh: 你说超时率降了，是真的快了，还是把预计时间放宽了？
followups.en: You cut the late rate — did delivery get faster, or did the ETA get looser?

screens.zh: 运筹和机器学习的真功底，把分单、定价、时间预估当成一个带约束的实时系统来解。
screens.en: Real OR and ML depth — treating assignment, pricing and ETA as one real-time constrained system.

asks.zh: 分单模型你怎么建，目标函数和约束是什么？
asks.en: How do you model dispatch, and what are the objective and the constraints?

asks.zh: 预计到达时间偏差大，你从哪几块查？
asks.en: ETA error is high — which pieces do you check?

asks.zh: 高峰运力不够，你怎么在拒单和延误之间分配？
asks.en: Capacity is short at peak — how do you split the pain between rejected orders and late ones?

asks.zh: 动态定价的上限怎么定，怎么避免用户觉得被宰？
asks.en: How do you cap surge pricing and keep users from feeling gouged?

insider.zh: 强的人清楚自己的模型把成本转给了骑手还是用户，弱的人只优化平均时长这一个数。
insider.en: Strong engineers know whether their model pushed cost onto riders or onto users; weak ones optimize average delivery time alone.

followups.zh: 你说时间预估准了，是尾部准了还是均值准了？
followups.en: You say the ETA got accurate — the tail or the mean?

followups.zh: 顺路单合并会让某些订单特别慢，你怎么兜住？
followups.en: Batching makes some orders very slow — how do you protect them?

screens.zh: 现场调度的实操能力，高峰和恶劣天气下能不能把时效和爆单守住。
screens.en: Hands-on dispatch — can they hold delivery times and absorb order floods at peak and in bad weather.

asks.zh: 暴雨天单量涨、骑手少，你的处置顺序是什么？
asks.en: Heavy rain, volume up, riders short — what's your order of action?

asks.zh: 你的站点时效多少，超时单主要卡在哪一段？
asks.en: What's your station's delivery time, and which leg do late orders stall in?

asks.zh: 排班怎么排，怎么让骑手愿意上高峰？
asks.en: How do you build the shift plan and get riders to take peak?

asks.zh: 一个站点连着被投诉，你怎么查？
asks.en: One station keeps getting complaints — how do you investigate?

insider.zh: 强的人按取餐、等餐、送达分段拆时效，弱的人只盯总时长，然后催骑手快点。
insider.en: Strong ops split delivery time into pickup, kitchen wait and drop-off; weak ones stare at the total and tell riders to hurry.

followups.zh: 你说超时率降了，有多少是靠调预计时间或者派单半径？
followups.en: Your late rate fell — how much came from adjusting ETAs or the assignment radius?

followups.zh: 高峰缺多少运力，你提前几天能看出来？
followups.en: How short is capacity at peak, and how many days ahead can you see it?

screens.zh: 能不能招得进、留得住骑手，把奖励、培训和关怀花的钱变成稳定的在线运力。
screens.en: Can they recruit and keep riders, and turn incentive, training and support spend into steady online capacity.

asks.zh: 你的骑手月流失多少，走的人主要卡在哪？
asks.en: What's your monthly rider attrition, and where do the leavers drop out?

asks.zh: 新骑手前两周留存最低，你做了什么？
asks.en: New riders churn hardest in the first two weeks — what did you do?

asks.zh: 奖励方案怎么设计，成本和在线时长怎么平衡？
asks.en: How do you design the incentive, and how do you balance cost against online hours?

asks.zh: 骑手情绪起来了、要集体停止接单，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Riders are angry and threatening to stop accepting orders — how do you handle it?

insider.zh: 强的人知道骑手在意的是单价、等餐还是罚款，弱的人只会加钱冲一波。
insider.en: Strong ops know whether riders care about per-order pay, kitchen waits or penalties; weak ones just throw money at one week.

followups.zh: 去掉奖励期，你说的留存提升还剩多少？
followups.en: Take out the incentive period — how much retention gain is left?

followups.zh: 骑手实际到手收入和你算的差多少，差在哪？
followups.en: How far is a rider's real take-home from your model, and where's the gap?

screens.zh: 备货和仓内效率的功底，能不能在缺货、损耗和周转之间把库存卡在合适的位置。
screens.en: Replenishment and in-warehouse fundamentals — can they land inventory between stockouts, spoilage and turns.

asks.zh: 你的仓缺货率和损耗率是多少，怎么压下来的？
asks.en: What are your stockout and shrink rates, and how did you bring them down?

asks.zh: 生鲜类怎么定订货量，预测靠什么？
asks.en: How do you set order quantities for fresh produce, and what drives the forecast?

asks.zh: 新开一个前置仓，选址和商品结构你怎么定？
asks.en: Opening a new forward warehouse — how do you pick the site and the assortment?

asks.zh: 仓内拣货效率怎么提，动线你怎么调？
asks.en: How do you raise picking productivity, and how did you change the pick path?

insider.zh: 强的人盯缺货和损耗两头一起看，弱的人只保不缺货，结果全砸在损耗上。
insider.en: Strong managers watch stockouts and spoilage at the same time; weak ones guarantee availability and eat it all in waste.

followups.zh: 你说的缺货率，是按商品算还是按订单算？
followups.en: Your stockout rate — per SKU or per order?

followups.zh: 预测失准的那几天，你是怎么补的？
followups.en: The days the forecast missed — how did you cover?

screens.zh: 判定的分寸和识别作弊的敏感度，处理投诉时既护住体验，又不让平台被人钻空子。
screens.en: Proportion in adjudication and a nose for fraud — protecting the experience without leaving the platform open to being worked.

asks.zh: 用户说菜里有异物要求赔付，你怎么判？
asks.en: A user claims there was something foreign in the food and wants compensation — how do you rule?

asks.zh: 你怎么识别刷单，抓过哪几种手法？
asks.en: How do you spot fake orders, and which schemes have you caught?

asks.zh: 商户和骑手互相甩责任，你怎么定责？
asks.en: Merchant and rider blame each other — how do you assign fault?

asks.zh: 恶意差评和真实差评你怎么分？
asks.en: How do you separate a malicious review from a real one?

insider.zh: 强的人有自己的一条证据链和判定顺序，弱的人一律先赔用户，把成本转给商户。
insider.en: Strong specialists have their own evidence chain and order of checks; weak ones pay every user out and pass the cost to the merchant.

followups.zh: 你的判定被推翻过吗，因为什么？
followups.en: Has a ruling of yours been overturned, and over what?

followups.zh: 你说抓到了刷单，误伤了多少正常商户？
followups.en: You caught fake orders — how many legitimate merchants got caught with them?

screens.zh: 能不能把订单密度、供需缺口和履约时效算成城市团队照着就能做的动作。
screens.en: Can they turn order density, supply-demand gaps and delivery times into moves a city team can execute.

asks.zh: 一个城市单量不涨，你怎么拆是需求问题还是供给问题？
asks.en: A city's volume is flat — how do you tell a demand problem from a supply problem?

asks.zh: 单均成本你怎么拆，哪一项最有优化空间？
asks.en: How do you break down cost per order, and which line has the most room?

asks.zh: 补贴的效果你怎么算，怎么排除自然增长？
asks.en: How do you measure subsidy effect and strip out organic growth?

asks.zh: 供需缺口你用什么指标衡量，怎么给到运营？
asks.en: What metric do you use for the supply-demand gap, and how do you hand it to ops?

insider.zh: 强的人算到网格和时段这一层，弱的人只出城市维度的日报。
insider.en: Strong analysts get down to the grid and the time slot; weak ones ship a city-level daily report.

followups.zh: 你说的缺口，是缺骑手还是缺商户，你怎么分开的？
followups.en: That gap — riders or merchants, and how did you separate them?

followups.zh: 你的结论落地了吗，运营照着做之后数怎么变？
followups.en: Did ops act on it, and what did the numbers do after?

screens.zh: 对一款产品从定档到上线的全盘掌控：买量、渠道、版本与舆情能不能同时管住。
screens.en: Owning a launch end to end: UA, channels, build, and sentiment held together.

asks.zh: 你发过的产品首月流水多少，回本了吗？
asks.en: First-month revenue on a title you shipped — did it pay back?

asks.zh: 定档前你要看哪几个测试数据才敢上？
asks.en: Which test metrics must you see before you greenlight the date?

asks.zh: 上线首日服务器出问题、评分掉到三分，你按什么顺序处理？
asks.en: Day-one outage and the rating drops — what's your order of action?

insider.zh: 强的人讲得出自己叫停或延期过哪一次以及依据，弱的人只讲发过什么。
insider.en: Strong publishers name a launch they delayed or stopped and why; weak ones list titles.

followups.zh: 这款产品的次留和七留分别多少，达标线你定在哪？
followups.en: Day-one and day-seven retention — where was your bar?

screens.zh: 买量的成本与回本判断：花出去的钱多久收回来，素材靠什么迭代。
screens.en: UA economics: payback horizon and how creative iterates.

asks.zh: 你的单个安装成本和首日回本率多少？
asks.en: What's your cost per install and day-one ROAS?

asks.zh: 一条素材跑衰了你怎么判断，下一条从哪里改？
asks.en: How do you know a creative has fatigued, and what changes next?

asks.zh: 预算翻倍但成本不能涨，你怎么做？
asks.en: Double the budget without raising cost — how?

insider.zh: 强的人盯的是长周期回本与素材产能，弱的人只报当天的量。
insider.en: Strong buyers watch long-horizon payback and creative throughput; weak ones report daily volume.

followups.zh: 买来的用户和自然用户的留存差多少？
followups.en: How far does paid retention trail organic?

screens.zh: 版本与活动的节奏感：靠什么把留存和付费同时撑住，而不是靠一次性冲量。
screens.en: Version and event cadence: holding retention and monetization together, not spiking once.

asks.zh: 你排的活动日历长什么样，为什么这么排？
asks.en: What does your event calendar look like, and why that order?

asks.zh: 付费率下滑，你会先动定价还是先动内容？
asks.en: Paying conversion is sliding — pricing first or content first?

asks.zh: 一次活动把大R榨干了，后面几个月怎么办？
asks.en: An event squeezed the whales dry — what happens the next few months?

insider.zh: 强的人会讲清一次活动对后续留存的透支，弱的人只报活动期间的流水峰值。
insider.en: Strong live ops explain what an event borrowed from later retention; weak ones quote peak revenue.

followups.zh: 这次活动之后大R的流失有变化吗？
followups.en: Did whale churn change after that event?

screens.zh: 赛事与社区的经营意识：投入能不能换回留存与口碑，不只是热闹。
screens.en: Esports and community as investment: does it buy retention and goodwill, not just noise.

asks.zh: 你办过的赛事花了多少、带来了什么可衡量的结果？
asks.en: What did your tournament cost, and what measurable result came back?

asks.zh: 社区里对某次改动骂声一片，你怎么处理？
asks.en: The community is furious about a change — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 怎么挑主播与合作方，标准是什么？
asks.en: How do you pick streamers and partners — what's the bar?

insider.zh: 强的人拿留存与回流数据说赛事价值，弱的人只报观看人数。
insider.en: Strong community leads justify events with retention and win-back data; weak ones quote viewership.

followups.zh: 赛事期间的新增用户三个月后还剩多少？
followups.en: Of the users acquired during the event, how many remain after three months?

screens.zh: 能不能扛住难缠客户、把账户做大做稳，同时护住创意团队不被带偏
screens.en: Can they hold a tough client, grow the account, and shield the creatives

asks.zh: 讲一个你把快流失的客户救回来的例子
asks.en: A time you saved an account about to leave

asks.zh: 客户临时砍预算又不肯降要求，你怎么谈
asks.en: Client cuts budget but not scope — how do you negotiate

asks.zh: 创意团队和客户期望对不上，你怎么处理
asks.en: Creatives and client misaligned — what do you do

asks.zh: 你负责的账户去年营收怎么变的，你做了什么
asks.en: How did your account's revenue move, and why

insider.zh: 强的人谈账户增长和客户的决策链，弱的人只会复述客户说了什么、当传话筒
insider.en: Strong talks growth and the client's decision chain; weak just relays messages

followups.zh: 你怎么判断一个客户值不值得继续投人力
followups.en: How do you decide if an account is worth staffing

followups.zh: 客户对接人和他老板意见相左时你怎么办
followups.en: When the client contact and their boss disagree

screens.zh: 能不能把模糊的生意问题设计成靠谱调研，挖出策略用得上的洞察
screens.en: Can they design real research and surface a usable insight

asks.zh: 一个定性定量都要用的项目，你怎么设计
asks.en: How do you design a mixed qual and quant study

asks.zh: 样本小、预算紧，你怎么保证结论站得住
asks.en: Small sample, tight budget — how do you keep findings sound

asks.zh: 你挖到过反直觉的消费者洞察吗，怎么验证的
asks.en: A counterintuitive insight you found and validated

insider.zh: 强的人给能改创意方向的洞察，弱的人把问卷结果念一遍
insider.en: Strong delivers an insight that redirects the work; weak recites survey results

followups.zh: 焦点小组里有人主导发言把讨论带偏了，你怎么处理
followups.en: A dominant voice skews a focus group — what do you do

screens.zh: 能不能把一堆信息收敛成锋利洞察，写出激发好创意的 brief
screens.en: Can they distill mess into a sharp insight and an inspiring brief

asks.zh: 挑一个你写过的 brief，讲你怎么从洞察走到创意方向
asks.en: Walk a brief from insight to creative direction

asks.zh: 客户要把所有卖点都塞进去，你怎么砍到一个核心主张
asks.en: Client wants every message — how do you cut to one

asks.zh: 一个平庸的品类，你怎么找到差异化的说法
asks.en: A dull category — how do you find a differentiated angle

insider.zh: 强的人说得清洞察是什么、为什么是它，弱的人把策略写成谁都不反对的正确废话
insider.en: Strong names the insight and why; weak writes strategy no one can disagree with

followups.zh: 你的 brief 出的创意客户不买，你怎么判断是策略还是创意的问题
followups.en: Client rejects the work — strategy or execution problem

screens.zh: 看作品本身，能不能想出概念、写出有记忆点又贴品牌声音的文案
screens.en: Portfolio: can they land a concept and a memorable, on-voice line

asks.zh: 挑作品集里你最得意的一个，讲从 brief 到成稿的过程
asks.en: Your best piece — brief to final

asks.zh: 同一个产品，用三种完全不同的调性各写一句 slogan
asks.en: One product, three tones, one line each

asks.zh: 你被毙得最狠的一稿是什么，后来怎么改的
asks.en: Your hardest kill, and how you revised

insider.zh: 有概念打底再落到文字的是真文案，只堆辞藻和谐音梗的没有内核
insider.en: A real writer has a concept first; wordplay alone is empty

followups.zh: 美术指导想的画面和你的文案打架，你们怎么收敛
followups.en: When the art direction fights your copy

screens.zh: 看审美和概念，能不能定视觉方向、带设计团队、在客户面前守住创意
screens.en: Taste and concept — set direction, lead designers, defend the work

asks.zh: 作品集里挑一个战役，讲视觉概念怎么来的
asks.en: A campaign — where the visual concept came from

asks.zh: 客户说想要高级但说不清，你怎么翻译成执行
asks.en: Client wants premium but can't define it — how do you translate

asks.zh: 你怎么带一个比你资深的设计师
asks.en: How do you lead a designer more senior than you

insider.zh: 强的人讲得清视觉背后的想法和取舍，弱的人只会说好看、跟着流行趋势走
insider.en: Strong explains the thinking behind the visuals; weak just says it looks good

followups.zh: 预算只够做一半的执行水准，你怎么保住创意的核心
followups.en: Half the budget — how do you protect the core idea

screens.zh: 看执行手上功夫、软件熟练度和出稿速度，能不能接住方向做成干净的稿
screens.en: Craft, tool fluency, speed — can they execute clean from direction

asks.zh: 作品集里哪些是你独立做的，哪些是跟着做的
asks.en: Which pieces were solo versus team

asks.zh: 给你一个方向和一天时间，你怎么排做稿的优先级
asks.en: One day, one brief — how do you prioritize

asks.zh: 同一套视觉要适配十几个尺寸的物料，你怎么做不崩
asks.en: One visual across a dozen formats — how do you keep it clean

insider.zh: 强的人接到含糊方向会先问清楚再动手，弱的人闷头做完全跑偏还得返工
insider.en: Strong clarifies vague direction first; weak charges off and reworks

followups.zh: 美术指导给的反馈你不认同，你怎么处理
followups.en: You disagree with your AD's feedback — what now

screens.zh: 能不能把定稿创意按预算和排期做成物料，管住供应商和现场突发
screens.en: Turn approved ideas into assets on time and budget, run vendors

asks.zh: 拍摄当天场地或天气出问题，你怎么救
asks.en: Shoot day goes wrong — how do you save it

asks.zh: 创意想要的效果超预算了，你怎么谈到能做的版本
asks.en: The idea is over budget — how do you land a doable version

asks.zh: 你怎么选和管外部供应商，报价怎么砍
asks.en: How do you pick, manage, and negotiate vendors

insider.zh: 强的人在创意可行性上早早介入，弱的人等定稿才发现做不出来或超支
insider.en: Strong flags feasibility early; weak finds out at final approval

followups.zh: 后期反复改导致要超期，你怎么和客户与创意重定预期
followups.en: Endless revisions blow the timeline — how do you reset

screens.zh: 能不能把各线物料按排期收齐、卡住节点，推着战役往上线走
screens.en: Can they assemble deliverables to schedule and push to the gate

asks.zh: 好几个项目同时抢同一个设计师，你怎么排
asks.en: Projects fight over one designer — how do you schedule

asks.zh: 创意线一直拖稿快赶不上媒介排期，你怎么办
asks.en: Creative slips against the media flight — what do you do

asks.zh: 你用什么方式盯进度，怎么让人愿意配合你催
asks.en: How do you track progress and get people to respond

insider.zh: 强的人提前看到瓶颈把冲突消化掉，弱的人到交稿期限那天才发现物料没齐
insider.en: Strong spots the bottleneck early; weak discovers gaps at the deadline

followups.zh: 客户临时插一个急单，你怎么重排不搞崩现有排期
followups.en: A rush job drops in — how do you reslot without breaking the plan

screens.zh: 能不能按受众和目标搭出合理的媒介组合，讲清预算为什么这么分
screens.en: Build a mix that fits audience and objective, justify the split

asks.zh: 给你一个目标人群和预算，你怎么定渠道组合
asks.en: Audience and budget — how do you set the channel mix

asks.zh: 品牌曝光和效果转化都要，预算怎么切
asks.en: Brand and performance both — how do you split budget

asks.zh: 你怎么评估一个新渠道值不值得试
asks.en: How do you decide whether to test a new channel

insider.zh: 强的人从受众的触媒习惯倒推渠道，弱的人套模板抄上一个案子的组合
insider.en: Strong reasons from media habits; weak copies the last plan

followups.zh: 投中发现主力渠道效果不行，你怎么当机立断调预算
followups.en: A core channel underperforms mid-flight — how do you shift

screens.zh: 能不能真上手采买和优化，控住成本和 pacing，把计划投出效果
screens.en: Hands-on buying and optimization, cost and pacing control

asks.zh: 一条广告 CPA 越投越高，你按什么顺序排查
asks.en: CPA keeps rising — what is your debug order

asks.zh: 预算快花超了但还没到量，你怎么调
asks.en: Pacing ahead of budget but volume short — how do you adjust

asks.zh: 手动优化和依赖平台自动出价，你怎么权衡
asks.en: Manual optimization versus platform auto-bidding

insider.zh: 盯转化和后端 ROI 的是老手，只看点击率、花完预算就交差的是新手
insider.en: Pros watch conversion and back-end ROI; rookies watch CTR and spend

followups.zh: 平台算法一次更新把你的账户跑崩了，你怎么应对
followups.en: A platform update tanks your account — what do you do

screens.zh: 能不能把投放数据算成诚实复盘，给出下一轮能改的动作
screens.en: Turn campaign data into an honest readout with a next action

asks.zh: 战役效果不好，你怎么定位是创意、媒介还是受众的问题
asks.en: Weak results — creative, media, or audience

asks.zh: 归因模型结论打架，你信哪个、怎么跟客户解释
asks.en: Attribution models disagree — which one, and how do you explain

asks.zh: 你做过最有用的一份复盘改变了什么决策
asks.en: A readout that actually changed a decision

insider.zh: 强的人的复盘直接指向下一步怎么改，弱的人堆一堆图表没有结论
insider.en: Strong's readout points to the next move; weak just dumps charts

followups.zh: 客户只想看好看的数字，你怎么把坏消息讲出来还不失信任
followups.en: Client wants only good numbers — how do you deliver bad news

screens.zh: 能不能在上线前挡住品牌、法律、事实错误，把客户审稿的来回控制住、尽快定稿
screens.en: Catch brand, legal, and factual errors, converge the sign-off loop

asks.zh: 你怎么建一套审稿清单，重点查什么
asks.en: How do you build a review checklist — what matters most

asks.zh: 客户来回改了七八轮还不签字，你怎么打破僵局
asks.en: Seven rounds and no sign-off — how do you break it

asks.zh: 一个错漏上线了，你怎么复盘流程哪里漏了
asks.en: An error shipped — how do you fix the process

insider.zh: 强的人分得清必须改的硬伤和客户的个人偏好，弱的人把所有意见一视同仁、没完没了
insider.en: Strong separates real defects from client taste; weak treats every note equally

followups.zh: 创意坚持某个做法但有合规风险，你怎么裁
followups.en: Creative insists on something with compliance risk — how do you rule

screens.zh: 看服务器与机架级硬件设计的真功夫，散热、供电、信号完整性和规模化成本
screens.en: Real server and rack design depth — thermals, power, signal integrity, cost at scale

asks.zh: 一款新服务器散热压不住，你从哪几个方向下手
asks.en: A server runs too hot — where do you start

asks.zh: 你怎么在性能、功耗和单机成本之间做取舍
asks.en: Trading off performance, power, and unit cost

asks.zh: 大批量上线后出现批次性硬件故障，你怎么定位根因
asks.en: Batch-wide hardware failures in the fleet — how do you find root cause

insider.zh: 强的人从整机柜和 TCO 想问题，弱的人只盯单块板子的参数好不好看
insider.en: Strong thinks in racks and TCO; weak fixates on one board's specs

followups.zh: 一个新加速卡的供电和散热和现有机架不兼容，你怎么权衡
followups.en: A new accelerator doesn't fit the rack's power and cooling — what gives

screens.zh: 能不能设计出不成为瓶颈的机房网络，拓扑、带宽、延迟和冗余怎么权衡
screens.en: Design a datacenter network that isn't the bottleneck

asks.zh: 给你一个新机房，你怎么规划网络拓扑
asks.en: A new datacenter — how do you plan the topology

asks.zh: 东西向流量暴涨把网络打满了，你怎么扩
asks.en: East-west traffic saturates the fabric — how do you scale

asks.zh: 你怎么设计冗余让单点故障不影响业务
asks.en: How do you design redundancy against single points of failure

insider.zh: 强的人按流量模型和故障域来设计，弱的人只堆带宽和设备、不算收敛比
insider.en: Strong designs from traffic model and fault domains; weak just adds bandwidth

followups.zh: 成本要砍但可用性不能降，你在拓扑上怎么取舍
followups.en: Cut cost without cutting availability — what do you trade

screens.zh: 看机房上架和系统运维的实操，出故障时的排查纪律和应急能力
screens.en: Hands-on rack and systems ops, incident discipline

asks.zh: 一台服务器半夜宕了，你的排查顺序是什么
asks.en: A server dies at 3am — your triage order

asks.zh: 你怎么做批量上架不出错，靠什么保证一致性
asks.en: Bulk provisioning without errors — how do you keep it consistent

asks.zh: 机房温度告警了，你先做什么
asks.en: A thermal alarm fires — first move

insider.zh: 靠 runbook 和自动化把重复操作标准化的才扛得住规模，每次手动救火全凭记忆的迟早翻车
insider.en: Standardizing with runbooks and automation scales; firefighting from memory doesn't

followups.zh: 同一个故障反复出现，你怎么从根上解决而不是每次重启
followups.en: A recurring failure — how do you fix root cause instead of rebooting

screens.zh: 能不能把物理算力做成弹性 IaaS，做虚拟化、自动化供给和基础设施即代码
screens.en: Turn physical capacity into elastic IaaS — virtualization, automation, IaC

asks.zh: 你怎么设计一个能自动扩缩容的计算资源池
asks.en: Design an auto-scaling compute pool

asks.zh: 怎么让客户配合按时提供数据和资源？

insider.zh: 强的用使用数据提前干预、把价值量化给客户，弱的等客户投诉才动、只做关系维护

asks.zh: 怎么判断一个功能到底该不该做？

asks.zh: 上线的功能没人用，你怎么办？

insider.en: Strong trade off by impact and maintainability; weak over-engineer or just ship

followups.en: How do you keep telemetry accurate enough to trust downstream

screens.zh: 能不能把使用数据变成可行动的洞察和模型，而不只是跑报表和炫算法
screens.en: Turn usage data into actionable insight and models, not just reports

asks.zh: 怎么建一个预测客户流失的模型？
asks.en: How would you build a churn-prediction model

asks.zh: 业务问你为什么这个月留存掉了，你怎么查？
asks.en: Retention dropped this month — how do you investigate

asks.zh: 一个模型准确率很高但没人用，问题在哪？
asks.en: A high-accuracy model nobody uses — what's wrong

asks.en: Real signal or noise in a metric move — how do you tell

asks.zh: 你会先攻漏斗的哪一环，为什么？

asks.en: How would you design an experiment to lift activation

asks.zh: 一个实验赢了但整体没涨，怎么回事？
asks.en: An experiment won but the overall number didn't move

asks.zh: 免费转付费卡住了，你怎么破？
asks.en: Free-to-paid conversion is stuck — how do you break it

insider.zh: 强的按杠杆最大的环节下手、认清实验和产品长期健康的关系，弱的堆增长黑客小技巧

followups.en: How do you keep growth tactics from burning retention and reputation

screens.zh: 能不能守住续约、把账户做大，平衡客户关系和商业目标，把净收入留存拉起来

asks.zh: 客户以砍价威胁不续约，你怎么谈？
asks.en: Customer threatens to walk unless you discount — negotiate it

asks.zh: 怎么找一个账户的增购机会？
asks.en: How do you find upsell in an account

asks.zh: 一个大客户想缩减用量，你怎么办？

asks.zh: 你怎么排优先级盯哪些账户？

insider.zh: 高手用价值和数据谈续约增购、提前布局，弱的临到期才救、只会降价保签
insider.en: Strong sell renewal and upsell on value and data; weak firefight late and just discount

followups.zh: 续约和涨价你怎么同时谈成？
followups.en: How do you land a renewal and a price increase together

screens.en: Turn happy customers into case studies, referrals and reusable acquisition assets

asks.zh: 怎么说动一个大客户愿意做公开案例？
asks.en: How do you get a big customer to go on record

asks.zh: 怎么建一个能持续产出转介绍的推荐机制？
asks.en: How do you build a referral engine that keeps producing

asks.zh: 客户愿意夸但不愿具名，你怎么办？
asks.en: They'll praise you but won't be named — what now

asks.en: How do you measure the real return of advocacy

followups.en: How do you work with sales and CS to find the right advocates

screens.zh: 能不能带来可持续的签单和客户信任，有没有可迁移的关系与行业声誉
screens.en: Can they originate revenue and carry client trust — a portable book

asks.zh: 你现在手上有多少能带过来、可跟进的客户关系和管线？
asks.en: What relationships and pipeline can you actually bring?

asks.zh: 讲一个你从零谈成的大单，怎么建立信任、怎么定价的？
asks.en: Walk me through a large deal you originated from scratch

asks.zh: 客户找的是你，还是你背后的品牌？
asks.en: Do clients buy you or your firm's brand?

asks.zh: 进一个你不熟的行业，你怎么快速建立可信度？
asks.en: How do you build credibility in an unfamiliar sector?

insider.zh: 弱的人讲交付和方法论，强的人讲怎么把关系变成收入、丢单后还留住客户

followups.en: How much revenue did you personally originate last year?

followups.zh: 有没有客户跟着你换过东家？
followups.en: Have clients followed you across firms?

screens.zh: 扛不扛得住客户高管现场质疑，能不能把团队分析收敛成客户敢拍板的建议并开始带单

asks.en: A time you pulled a drifting engagement back on track

insider.zh: 弱的人还在证明分析对不对，强的人已经在管客户的决策风险和这单后面的下一单

followups.zh: 你怎么判断一个建议客户到底会不会真去执行？
followups.en: How do you gauge whether the client will actually act?

screens.zh: 能不能把模糊难题拆成假设树和工作计划，同时管住团队节奏和客户预期
screens.en: Structure a vague problem into hypotheses and workplan, run team and client

asks.zh: 客户说增长停滞，第一周你怎么拆问题、怎么定工作计划？
asks.en: Client says growth stalled — how do you scope week one?

asks.zh: 一个分析师连续交不出活，还有三天汇报，你怎么办？
asks.en: An analyst keeps missing, three days to the readout

asks.en: Client wants more scope, no more budget — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 分析做到什么程度就够了、可以停？
asks.en: How do you know the analysis is enough to stop?

insider.zh: 弱的人埋头把分析做全，强的人先想清 so what 和结论长什么样，再倒推只做必要的分析
insider.en: Weak analyze everything; strong back-solve from the answer

followups.zh: 你带过最多几个人、几条工作线并行？
followups.en: Largest team and how many parallel workstreams?

followups.zh: 汇报前一晚发现核心数据错了，你怎么办？
followups.en: Night before the readout, the key number is wrong

screens.zh: 能不能独立扛住一个模块，从数据和访谈做到有观点的结论和故事线初稿
screens.en: Can they own a workstream end to end into a point of view

asks.en: How do you start a market-sizing module from zero?

asks.en: Interviewing an evasive exec — how do you get the truth?

asks.zh: 你的模块结论和另一个模块打架了，怎么办？
asks.en: Your module contradicts another — what do you do?

insider.zh: 弱的人交一堆分析让经理去总结，强的人交带判断的结论加下一步建议
insider.en: Weak hand up raw analysis; strong hand up conclusions

followups.zh: 你怎么快速验证一个假设站不站得住？
followups.en: How do you quickly test whether a hypothesis holds?

screens.zh: 拆解结构够不够清楚，建模和找数据够不够快够不够准，扛得住高强度
screens.en: Structured thinking, modeling speed and accuracy, stamina

asks.zh: 估一下中国每年卖出多少支牙刷。
asks.en: Estimate annual toothbrush sales in China

asks.zh: 一家连锁餐厅利润下滑，你从哪几方面查？
asks.en: A restaurant chain's profit is falling — how do you diagnose it?

asks.zh: Excel 里你最常用来查错的方法是什么？
asks.en: How do you catch errors in your Excel models?

asks.zh: 为什么想做咨询？
asks.en: Why consulting?

insider.zh: 弱的人一上来算数，强的人先把问题结构说清、讲清每步为什么这么拆
insider.en: Weak start computing; strong lay out the structure first

followups.zh: 你算出来的数，怎么快速判断量级对不对？
followups.en: How do you sanity-check the order of magnitude?

screens.zh: 能不能在客户现场把纸面方案落地，推动不归你管的人、化解组织阻力
screens.en: Can they drive real change on-site with people they don't manage

asks.zh: 一个建议客户中层集体抵制，你怎么推下去？
asks.en: Middle management resists the change — how do you push it through?

asks.zh: 怎么证明你落地的东西真产生了效果，而不是纸上数字？
asks.en: How do you prove realized impact, not paper savings?

asks.zh: 驻场半年，客户 sponsor 换人、方向也变了，你怎么办？
asks.en: Your sponsor changes mid-engagement — now what?

insider.zh: 弱的人盯着交付方案本身，强的人盯客户组织愿不愿意、有没有能力自己跑下去
insider.en: Weak track the plan; strong track whether the client can sustain it

followups.zh: 你怎么让客户在你走之后还能维持改进？
followups.en: How do you make the change stick after you leave?

screens.zh: 能不能在项目需求、人员利用率和个人发展之间做取舍，把合适的人配到合适的单上
screens.en: Balancing project needs, utilization, and people's development

asks.zh: 两个项目抢同一个稀缺技能的人，你怎么分？
asks.en: Two engagements need the same scarce person — how do you allocate?

asks.zh: 一个明星顾问只想挑项目，利用率却要保，你怎么谈？
asks.en: A star consultant cherry-picks while you must hold utilization

asks.zh: 怎么在配人时兼顾员工成长和留任？
asks.en: How do you staff for growth and retention at once?

insider.zh: 弱的人按空档表填人，强的人同时在管利用率、技能梯队和谁快要离职
insider.en: Weak fill the bench grid; strong manage skills and flight risk too

followups.zh: 淡季一批人没项目，你怎么安排？
followups.en: How do you handle a bench in a slow quarter?

screens.zh: 能不能快而准地从公开源和数据库里挖到能用的行业数据，并判断可信度
screens.en: Fast, reliable sourcing and judging source credibility

asks.zh: 两小时内摸清一个陌生细分市场，你怎么下手？
asks.en: Two hours to map an unfamiliar niche — how do you start?

asks.zh: 两个数据源数字对不上，你信哪个、怎么判断？
asks.en: Two sources disagree — which do you trust and why?

asks.zh: 你平时常用哪些行业数据库，各自适合查什么？
asks.en: Which databases do you use, and for what?

insider.zh: 弱的人把搜到的东西堆给团队，强的人先问清团队要回答什么问题再给筛过的答案
insider.en: Weak dump results; strong ask what question it serves first

followups.zh: 找不到直接数据时你怎么估算替代口径？
followups.en: No direct data — how do you build a proxy?

screens.zh: 建模能力够不够硬，能不能把模型结论讲成客户和团队听得懂、敢用的东西
screens.en: Modeling depth plus making it consumable for non-technical clients

asks.zh: 客户给的数据又脏又缺，项目只有三周，你怎么办？
asks.en: Dirty, incomplete client data and only three weeks

asks.zh: 怎么跟一个不懂技术的合伙人解释模型为什么可信？
asks.en: How do you explain model trustworthiness to a non-technical partner?

asks.zh: 讲一个你的模型最后真被客户用起来的例子。
asks.en: A model of yours the client actually adopted

insider.zh: 弱的人追求模型精度，强的人先想清模型要支撑哪个决策、精度到哪就够
insider.en: Weak chase accuracy; strong tie precision to the decision

followups.zh: 模型结论和合伙人的直觉相反，你怎么处理？
followups.en: Model contradicts the partner's gut — what do you do?

screens.zh: 能不能把粗糙结论做成一眼看懂的图表和页面，理解每页要传达的核心信息
screens.en: Turning rough analysis into clear slides that carry the message

asks.zh: 顾问给你一堆乱数据，只说要突出增长，这页你怎么设计？
asks.en: Messy data, brief is 'show growth' — how do you design the page?

asks.zh: 一页 slide 信息太多，你怎么砍？
asks.en: A slide is overloaded — how do you cut it down?

asks.zh: 汇报前两小时要改二十页图，你怎么排优先级？
asks.en: Twenty pages to fix two hours out — how do you prioritize?

insider.zh: 弱的人把图做漂亮，强的人先搞清这页的论点、让图服务论点
insider.en: Weak make it pretty; strong make it serve the point

followups.zh: 你怎么判断一个图表用错了类型？
followups.en: How do you tell a chart uses the wrong type?

screens.zh: 能不能快速找到对口专家、筛掉不相关和有合规风险的人，撑起访谈量
screens.en: Sourcing the right experts fast while screening relevance and compliance

asks.zh: 客户要两天内约到三个懂某小众供应链环节的人，你怎么找？
asks.en: Three niche supply-chain experts in two days — how?

asks.zh: 一个专家背景很好但可能有竞业风险，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Great expert but possible non-compete risk — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你怎么判断一个专家到底懂不懂客户真正想问的？
asks.en: How do you tell if an expert really knows the ask?

insider.zh: 弱的人按标题匹配专家，强的人核实这个人是不是真在关键岗位上做过关键决策
insider.en: Weak match titles; strong verify real decision experience

followups.zh: 怎么在通话前就筛掉会浪费客户时间的专家？
followups.en: How do you screen out a time-waster before the call?

screens.zh: 对疾病机制理解够不够深，能不能判断一个靶点是真有效还是假阳性、可不可成药
screens.en: Deep mechanism, judging whether a target is real and druggable

asks.zh: 你怎么验证一个靶点和疾病是因果，而不只是相关？
asks.en: How do you prove causality, not just correlation, for a target?

asks.zh: 讲一个你判断过可以砍掉的靶点，依据是什么？
asks.en: A target you decided to kill — on what evidence?

asks.zh: 动物模型有效但你怀疑转化不到人，你看哪些信号？
asks.en: Works in animals but you doubt translation — what signals?

insider.zh: 弱的人堆基因表达和相关性数据，强的人把因果验证、人类遗传学证据和可成药性一起看
insider.en: Weak cite expression; strong triangulate causality, genetics, druggability

followups.zh: 你怎么区分靶点无效和给药方式的问题？
followups.en: How do you separate a dead target from a delivery problem?

screens.zh: 结构活性关系推理硬不硬，能不能在活性、选择性和成药性之间同时优化
screens.en: SAR reasoning and multi-parameter optimization

asks.zh: 一个先导化合物活性好但代谢太快，你怎么改结构？
asks.en: Potent lead but fast metabolism — how do you fix the structure?

asks.zh: 怎么判断一个化合物系列已经走到头、该放弃了？
asks.en: How do you know a series is dead?

asks.zh: 活性和选择性打架时你怎么取舍？
asks.en: Potency versus selectivity — how do you trade off?

insider.zh: 弱的人只追活性，强的人从一开始就把 ADMET 和成药性放进优化里
insider.en: Weak chase potency; strong optimize ADMET from day one

followups.zh: 你怎么设计一轮合成让信息量最大？
followups.en: How do you design a synthesis round for maximum learning?

screens.zh: 处理组学数据的统计功底扎不扎实，能不能避免假阳性、把计算结果对接到实验验证
screens.en: Statistical rigor with omics and linking compute to wet-lab

asks.zh: 差异表达里几千个基因显著，你怎么缩到几个值得验证的靶点？
asks.en: Thousands of significant genes — how do you narrow to a few targets?

asks.zh: 你怎么控制多重检验带来的假阳性？
asks.en: How do you control multiple-testing false positives?

asks.zh: 计算预测的靶点湿实验没验出来，你怎么复盘？
asks.en: Predicted target fails validation — how do you debrief?

insider.zh: 弱的人报一堆统计显著的基因，强的人结合通路、先验生物学和可验证性去排优先级
insider.en: Weak report p-values; strong prioritize by pathway and testability

followups.zh: 批次效应你怎么识别和校正？
followups.en: How do you detect and correct batch effects?

screens.zh: 既懂模型又懂化学，能不能诚实看待生成分子的可合成性和实验兑现率
screens.en: Both ML and chemistry, honest about synthesizability and hit rate

asks.zh: 你的生成模型产出的分子，有多少真能合成、真被验证？
asks.en: Of your generated molecules, how many are made and validated?

asks.zh: 训练数据里的偏差怎么影响你的分子预测？
asks.en: How does training-data bias affect your predictions?

asks.zh: 你怎么跟药物化学家协作，而不是甩给他们一堆不靠谱的分子？
asks.en: How do you collaborate with chemists, not dump bad molecules?

insider.zh: 弱的人秀模型指标，强的人讲实验验证闭环和模型在数据稀疏区的失效
insider.en: Weak show metrics; strong show the validation loop and failure modes

followups.zh: 你怎么评估一个成药性预测模型到底可不可信？
followups.en: How do you judge whether a druggability model is trustworthy?

screens.zh: 临床前研究设计严不严谨，能不能从动物毒性信号判断人体风险、撑起 IND 申报
screens.en: Rigorous study design and translating animal signals to human risk

asks.zh: 你怎么设计剂量爬坡和确定首次人体起始剂量？
asks.en: How do you set dose escalation and the first-in-human dose?

asks.zh: 动物身上出现一个毒性信号，你怎么判断它转化到人的风险？
asks.en: An animal tox signal — how do you assess human risk?

asks.zh: 化合物疗效好但有肝毒性，你怎么给决策层建议？
asks.en: Efficacious but hepatotoxic — what do you advise leadership?

insider.zh: 弱的人只报安全窗口，强的人讲毒性机制、可逆性和跨种属外推的可信度
insider.en: Weak report the margin; strong reason mechanism, reversibility, extrapolation

followups.zh: 哪些动物毒性信号在人身上其实不用太担心，为什么？
followups.en: Which animal signals rarely translate to humans, and why?

screens.zh: 能不能把实验室合成放大成稳定可量产的工艺，同时守住质量和法规要求
screens.en: Scaling synthesis into a stable, compliant, manufacturable process

asks.zh: 实验室能做的反应放大到公斤级出问题，你怎么排查？
asks.en: A reaction breaks at kilo scale — how do you troubleshoot?

asks.zh: 怎么保证不同批次之间的一致性？
asks.en: How do you ensure batch-to-batch consistency?

asks.zh: 工艺变更后你怎么向监管证明前后可比？
asks.en: After a process change, how do you prove comparability to regulators?

insider.zh: 弱的人只关心收率，强的人同时管杂质谱、可放大性和申报口径
insider.en: Weak watch yield; strong watch impurities, scalability, and the filing

followups.zh: 关键工艺参数你怎么定它的控制范围？
followups.en: How do you set control ranges for critical process parameters?

screens.zh: 临床方案设计和获益风险判断，出安全信号时敢不敢做医学决策
screens.en: Protocol design, benefit-risk judgment, and safety calls

asks.zh: 一个受试者出现严重不良事件，你怎么判断要不要停试验？
asks.en: A serious adverse event — how do you decide whether to halt?

asks.zh: 主要终点怎么选才既有临床意义又能获批？
asks.en: How do you pick a primary endpoint that's meaningful and approvable?

asks.zh: 研究者对入排标准有异议，你怎么处理？
asks.en: An investigator disputes the eligibility criteria — how do you handle it?

insider.zh: 弱的人守着方案条文，强的人在患者安全、科学问题和监管可接受性之间做医学判断
insider.en: Weak follow the protocol; strong weigh safety, science, and regulator acceptance

followups.zh: 中期分析看到疗效不够，你怎么建议？
followups.en: Interim shows weak efficacy — what do you recommend?

screens.zh: 能不能把方案落地成多中心真实数据，管住入组进度、数据质量和 GCP 合规
screens.en: Running protocols into clean multi-site data, on time and GCP-compliant

asks.zh: 一个中心入组严重落后，你怎么办？
asks.en: A site is far behind on enrollment — what do you do?

asks.zh: 监查时发现一个中心数据有系统性问题，你怎么处理？
asks.en: You find systematic data issues at a site — how do you respond?

asks.zh: 研究者反复违背入排标准，你怎么管？
asks.en: An investigator keeps deviating on eligibility — how do you manage it?

insider.zh: 弱的人盯着访视清单打钩，强的人盯入组曲线、数据质量趋势和哪个中心要出事
insider.en: Weak tick visit checklists; strong watch enrollment curves and risk sites

followups.zh: 怎么在不牺牲质量的前提下抢回落后的时间线？
followups.en: How do you recover timeline without sacrificing quality?

screens.zh: 试验设计和统计分析计划扎不扎实，能不能处理缺失数据、多重性并顶住监管质询
screens.en: Trial design, SAP rigor, missing data, multiplicity, defending to regulators

asks.zh: 样本量怎么算的，假设从哪来？
asks.en: How did you power the study, and where did the assumptions come from?

asks.zh: 大量受试者脱落，你怎么处理缺失数据？
asks.en: Heavy dropout — how do you handle the missing data?

asks.zh: 多个次要终点都想声称阳性，你怎么控制一类错误？
asks.en: Multiple secondary endpoints — how do you control type I error?

insider.zh: 弱的人跑出 p 值，强的人先把要估计的量是什么、在哪个分析集上算，定义清楚再下结论
insider.en: Weak produce p-values; strong define the estimand and analysis set first

followups.zh: 监管质疑你的敏感性分析，你怎么答？
followups.en: Regulators challenge your sensitivity analysis — how do you respond?

screens.zh: 数据清洗和质疑管理严不严谨，能不能按时把数据库锁到可分析
screens.en: Rigorous cleaning and query management, locking the database on time

asks.zh: 怎么设计核查逻辑把录入错误查出来？
asks.en: How do you design edit checks to catch entry errors?

asks.zh: 锁库前发现一批数据有疑问，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Questionable data surfaces before lock — what do you do?

asks.zh: 研究中心迟迟不回质疑、影响锁库，你怎么推？
asks.en: Sites won't answer queries and lock slips — how do you push?

insider.zh: 弱的人等发现问题再查，强的人在建库时就把边界和逻辑核查设计进去
insider.en: Weak clean reactively; strong build checks into the database up front

followups.zh: 锁库后又发现错误，你怎么办？
followups.en: An error turns up after database lock — now what?

screens.zh: 熟不熟申报要求和监管沟通，能不能把各方证据整合成过得了审的申请
screens.en: Submission requirements and agency strategy into a filing that clears review

asks.zh: 监管发来一堆缺陷发补，时限很紧，你怎么组织回复？
asks.en: A tight deficiency response — how do you organize it?

asks.zh: 申报里临床和 CMC 数据口径打架，你怎么协调？
asks.en: Clinical and CMC data conflict in the dossier — how do you reconcile?

asks.zh: 一个适应症证据偏弱，你怎么和监管沟通策略？
asks.en: Weak evidence on an indication — what's your agency strategy?

insider.zh: 弱的人按清单交材料，强的人提前预判监管会问什么、把答案埋进申报里
insider.en: Weak submit to checklist; strong preempt the agency's questions

followups.zh: 怎么决定一次沟通会该问哪些问题？
followups.en: How do you decide what to ask at a regulatory meeting?

screens.zh: 医学专业深度够不够跟 KOL 平等对话，守不守得住非推广的合规边界
screens.en: Therapeutic depth to engage KOLs and holding the non-promotional line

asks.zh: 一个 KOL 质疑你产品的临床数据，你怎么科学地回应？
asks.en: A KOL challenges your data — how do you respond scientifically?

asks.zh: MSL 和销售的边界在哪，你怎么把握？
asks.en: Where is the MSL–sales line, and how do you hold it?

asks.zh: 你怎么从一次学术拜访里带回有价值的临床洞察？
asks.en: How do you bring back real insight from a KOL visit?

insider.zh: 弱的人像变相销售，强的人靠科学深度赢得 KOL 信任、把一线洞察带回公司
insider.en: Weak sell in disguise; strong earn trust and carry field insight back

followups.zh: 遇到超适应症的问题你怎么处理？
followups.en: How do you handle an off-label question?

screens.zh: 能不能站在支付方角度把疗效价值转成医保准入和定价，懂药物经济学
screens.en: Payer lens turning clinical value into reimbursement and price

asks.zh: 医保谈判前你怎么给一个新药定价值主张？
asks.en: How do you build the value story before a pricing negotiation?

asks.zh: 支付方只认省钱，你的药贵但疗效好，你怎么谈？
asks.en: Payer wants savings, your drug is costly but better — how do you negotiate?

asks.zh: 药物经济学模型里哪个假设最容易被支付方攻击？
asks.en: Which HEOR model assumption do payers attack most?

insider.zh: 弱的人拿临床数据说话，强的人拿支付方在意的预算影响和替代成本说话
insider.en: Weak lead with efficacy; strong lead with budget impact and offsets

followups.zh: 真实世界数据在准入谈判里怎么用？
followups.en: How do you use real-world data in access negotiations?

screens.zh: 咨询转化能力，能不能读懂家长和学员的真实顾虑并促成报名，同时不过度承诺
screens.en: Consultative conversion, reading real concerns without overselling

asks.zh: 家长说再考虑考虑，你怎么接？
asks.en: 'Let me think about it' — how do you respond?

asks.zh: 家长觉得太贵，你怎么谈价值而不是一味降价？
asks.en: Price objection — how do you sell value, not discount?

asks.zh: 你怎么判断一个学员适不适合我们的课程？
asks.en: How do you judge whether a student fits the program?

insider.zh: 弱的人背话术逼单，强的人先问出家长真正焦虑的是什么再对症
insider.en: Weak run a script to close; strong surface the real anxiety first

followups.zh: 学员报了名但明显不匹配，你会怎么做？
followups.en: Enrolled but clearly a poor fit — what do you do?

screens.zh: 学科功底加课堂把控，能不能真的把知识教进学生脑子里
screens.en: Subject mastery plus classroom control that makes students learn

asks.zh: 试讲一个你最拿手的知识点。
asks.en: Give a demo lesson on your strongest topic

asks.zh: 班上学生水平差距很大，你一节课怎么兼顾？
asks.en: Wide ability spread in one class — how do you teach it?

asks.zh: 一个学生就是不听课、还带节奏，你怎么办？
asks.en: A disruptive student pulls the class off — how do you handle it?

insider.zh: 弱的人把知识点讲完就算，强的人盯着学生有没有真听懂、当堂能不能用出来
insider.en: Weak finish the material; strong check students actually got it

followups.zh: 怎么判断一节课教得好不好，你看什么？
followups.en: How do you tell a lesson worked — what do you look at?

followups.zh: 家长质疑你的教学方法，你怎么沟通？
followups.en: A parent questions your method — how do you communicate?

screens.zh: 面向成人和兴趣学员的授课感染力，能不能把技能讲得实用、学员当场能上手
screens.en: Engaging adult delivery with practical, hands-on skill transfer

asks.zh: 试讲一段，让我感受你怎么带动课堂。
asks.en: Give a short demo showing how you energize a room

asks.zh: 成人学员基础参差不齐，你怎么让所有人都有收获？
asks.en: Mixed-level adults — how do you make sure everyone gains?

asks.zh: 你怎么让一门偏理论的内容变得学员愿意听？
asks.en: How do you make theory-heavy content engaging?

insider.zh: 弱的人讲得热闹，强的人让学员带着能落地的东西走出教室
insider.en: Weak entertain; strong send learners out with something usable

followups.zh: 学员反馈课程没用，你怎么调整？
followups.en: Learners say the course wasn't useful — how do you adjust?

screens.zh: 课程设计的专业性，能不能对齐教学目标、做出教师真用得起来的教研和教案
screens.en: Instructional-design rigor aligned to outcomes and usable by teachers

asks.zh: 给一个知识点，你怎么设计它的教学路径和练习？
asks.en: Design the learning path and practice for one topic

asks.zh: 你设计的课程老师不按你的用，你怎么办？
asks.en: Teachers don't follow your curriculum — what do you do?

asks.zh: 怎么用学习数据去迭代一门课程？
asks.en: How do you use learning data to iterate a course?

insider.zh: 弱的人堆知识点和资料，强的人从学习目标和常见错误倒推教学设计
insider.en: Weak pile up content; strong design back from goals and misconceptions

followups.zh: 怎么衡量一套课程好不好？
followups.en: How do you measure whether a curriculum is good?

screens.zh: 能不能同时扛住教学质量和招生营收，管好教师团队、处理家校危机
screens.en: Owning both teaching quality and revenue, staff, and crises

asks.zh: 教学口碑和营收目标冲突时你怎么取舍？
asks.en: Reputation versus revenue targets — how do you trade off?

asks.zh: 一个资深名师带不出成绩还闹情绪，你怎么管？
asks.en: A star teacher underperforms and acts out — how do you manage it?

asks.zh: 出现家长集体投诉的危机，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A wave of parent complaints — how do you handle the crisis?

insider.zh: 弱的人只顾教学或只顾经营一头，强的人清楚两者互为因果、都要盯
insider.en: Weak lean one way; strong see quality and revenue as one loop

followups.zh: 你怎么定和拆解一个校区的目标？
followups.en: How do you set and break down a campus's targets?

screens.zh: 靠不靠谱有没有耐心，能不能盯住掉队学生、把老师课上讲的内容巩固下来
screens.en: Reliability, patience, catching stragglers, reinforcing the lesson

asks.zh: 一个学生作业总不交，你怎么跟进？
asks.en: A student never turns in homework — how do you follow up?

asks.zh: 批改时发现全班一道题都错，你怎么反馈给老师？
asks.en: The whole class missed one question — how do you flag it?

asks.zh: 家长在群里问你孩子情况，你怎么答？
asks.en: A parent asks about their child in the chat — how do you reply?

insider.zh: 弱的人机械批改考勤，强的人主动发现哪个学生要掉队、及时提醒老师和家长
insider.en: Weak grade mechanically; strong flag at-risk students early

followups.zh: 老师讲的和你理解的不一致，学生问你，你怎么办？
followups.en: You disagree with the teacher and a student asks you — what do you do?

screens.zh: 能不能诊断出单个学生的薄弱点，个性化辅导、盯出可量化的提分
screens.en: Diagnosing individual gaps and driving measurable score gains

asks.zh: 一个学生成绩卡住不动，你怎么找原因、怎么破？
asks.en: A student's score plateaus — how do you diagnose and break it?

asks.zh: 同一道错题，你怎么判断是知识不会还是习惯问题？
asks.en: A wrong answer — knowledge gap or bad habit, how do you tell?

asks.zh: 怎么让一个抗拒学习的学生愿意跟你练？
asks.en: How do you get a resistant student to engage?

insider.zh: 弱的人陪着刷题，强的人先诊断薄弱环节再针对性补、盯着提分证据
insider.en: Weak drill along; strong diagnose then target, tracking gains

followups.zh: 家长只看分数，短期提不上去你怎么沟通？
followups.en: Parents only watch scores and it's slow — how do you communicate?

screens.zh: 能不能横向统筹学员全程，盯住进度和情绪风险，把续报和口碑做出来
screens.en: Steering the whole journey, spotting risk, driving retention

asks.zh: 一个学员成绩下滑还想退课，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A student's grades drop and they want to quit — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你怎么同时盯几十个学员的进度、知道谁快出问题？
asks.en: How do you track dozens of students and spot who's at risk?

asks.zh: 续报季到了，你怎么让家长愿意继续报？
asks.en: Renewal season — how do you keep families re-enrolling?

insider.zh: 弱的人等家长找上门，强的人主动盯数据和信号、在退课念头出现前就介入
insider.en: Weak wait for complaints; strong intervene before churn forms

followups.zh: 老师和家长对孩子判断不一致，你怎么协调？
followups.en: Teacher and parent disagree about a child — how do you mediate?

screens.zh: 心理辅导专业性和危机处理能力，守不守得住伦理边界
screens.en: Counseling skill, crisis handling, and ethical boundaries

asks.zh: 一个学生透露有自伤念头，你第一步做什么？
asks.en: A student reveals self-harm thoughts — what's your first step?

asks.zh: 学习问题背后其实是家庭问题，你怎么介入？
asks.en: The learning issue is really a family issue — how do you intervene?

asks.zh: 家长要你透露孩子的咨询内容，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A parent demands to know what the child told you — what do you do?

insider.zh: 弱的人直接给学习建议，强的人先分辨这是学习问题还是需要转介的心理问题
insider.en: Weak give study tips; strong triage learning versus clinical need

followups.zh: 你怎么判断一个案例超出了你的处理范围、要转介？
followups.en: How do you know a case exceeds your scope and needs referral?

screens.zh: 懂不懂升学就业行情，能不能把学员匹配到现实可达的去向、管住家长预期
screens.en: Knowing the landscape, matching to realistic outcomes, managing expectations

asks.zh: 学员分数和目标学校有差距，家长不接受，你怎么谈？
asks.en: Score falls short of the target school and parents won't accept it

asks.zh: 填志愿时冲稳保你怎么帮学员配？
asks.en: How do you balance reach, match, and safety choices?

asks.zh: 怎么帮一个方向不明的学生找到合适的路径？
asks.en: How do you help a directionless student find a path?

insider.zh: 弱的人报个理想清单，强的人拿真实录取和就业数据把预期拉到现实
insider.en: Weak hand over a wish list; strong ground it in real placement data

followups.zh: 你怎么持续更新对院校和就业市场的判断？
followups.en: How do you keep your read on schools and the job market current?

screens.zh: 能不能设计出让人学得下去的在线体验，用数据把完课率和续报做上去
screens.en: Designing sticky online learning and lifting completion with data

asks.zh: 你的课程完课率很低，你怎么诊断和改？
asks.en: Low completion rate — how do you diagnose and fix it?

asks.zh: 怎么设计能让学员坚持学下去的节奏和激励？
asks.en: How do you design pacing and incentives that keep learners going?

asks.zh: 自适应学习听着好，落地时最大的坑是什么？
asks.en: Adaptive learning sounds great — what's the biggest pitfall in practice?

insider.zh: 弱的人把线下课搬到线上，强的人按线上注意力规律重新设计学习路径
insider.en: Weak port classroom online; strong redesign for online attention

followups.zh: 你看哪些数据判断一门在线课到底有没有效果？
followups.en: Which metrics tell you an online course actually works?

screens.zh: 能不能在教师、教室、学员多重约束下排好课，把学籍成绩管得准、不出错
screens.en: Scheduling under constraints and keeping records accurate

asks.zh: 一个老师突然请假，二十个班要调，你怎么排？
asks.en: A teacher calls in sick and twenty classes need rescheduling

asks.zh: 排课时教室和老师时间都撞了，你怎么解？
asks.en: Room and teacher times both clash — how do you resolve it?

asks.zh: 成绩录入出错被家长发现，你怎么处理和防范？
asks.en: A grade-entry error a parent caught — how do you fix and prevent it?

insider.zh: 弱的人手忙脚乱救火，强的人把约束和冲突规则理清、让排课有章可循、不用反复重排
insider.en: Weak firefight; strong codify constraints so scheduling doesn't redo itself

followups.zh: 怎么让排课既满足教学又不浪费资源？
followups.en: How do you schedule to serve teaching without wasting capacity?

screens.zh: 能不能设计出上百小时不崩、可调平衡的系统，讲得清玩家动机和经济循环，而不只是想点子
screens.en: Systems that stay fun and balanced over hundreds of hours, not just ideas

asks.zh: 你设计的一个系统上线后数值失衡，怎么定位和调回来？
asks.en: A live system went out of balance — how did you diagnose and fix it?

asks.zh: 给一个成长或战斗系统，你会先定义哪几个核心变量？
asks.en: For a progression or combat system, which core variables do you define first?

asks.zh: 怎么判断一个机制是有深度，还是只是复杂？
asks.en: How do you tell real depth from mere complexity?

insider.zh: 强的张口先讲玩家动机和留存曲线，能把好玩拆成可调的数值；只堆机制点子、策划案写得程序看不懂的，做不下去
insider.en: Strong hires start from motivation and translate fun into tunable numbers

followups.zh: 数值和体验打架时你站哪边，怎么权衡？
followups.en: When numbers and feel conflict, which wins?

followups.zh: 你怎么保证策划案不让程序反复返工？
followups.en: How do you keep the spec from causing rework?

screens.zh: 空间节奏和难度曲线的把控，以及不靠文字和箭头就能引导玩家的功力，白盒到成品的迭代纪律
screens.en: Spatial pacing, wordless guidance, whitebox iteration discipline

asks.zh: 一个关卡你怎么控制难度曲线和节奏？
asks.en: How do you shape a level's difficulty curve and pacing?

asks.zh: 不用箭头和文字，你怎么把玩家引到正确方向？
asks.en: Without arrows or text, how do you guide the player?

asks.zh: 白盒阶段你先验证什么，什么时候才让美术进场？
asks.en: What do you validate in whitebox before art comes in?

insider.zh: 行家会讲视线引导、地标和光照动线这些不写字的引导手法；新手堆满敌人和机关，却说不清玩家为什么会走对
insider.en: Pros lead with sightlines and landmarks, not more enemies

followups.zh: 关卡被测出来无聊，你怎么诊断问题在哪？
followups.en: Testers find it boring — how do you diagnose why?

screens.zh: 叙事能不能服务玩法和系统，而不是硬塞一部小说进去，以及分支和玩家能动性的取舍
screens.en: Story serving gameplay, and branching under budget

asks.zh: 剧情和玩法节奏打架时你怎么处理？
asks.en: When story and gameplay pacing collide, what do you do?

asks.zh: 分支叙事怎么设计才不让工作量爆炸？
asks.en: How do you branch without blowing up the workload?

asks.zh: 不打断操作的前提下，你怎么把世界观交代清楚？
asks.en: How do you convey the world without interrupting play?

insider.zh: 强的把叙事挂在系统上，懂环境叙事和碎片化交代；弱的写一长段过场硬塞，玩家只想跳过
insider.en: Strong writers hang story on systems; weak ones write skippable cutscenes

followups.zh: 如果玩家跳过所有剧情，你的设计还成立吗？
followups.en: If players skip all story, does your design still hold?

screens.zh: 能不能定出统一又可落地的视觉方向，3D 做得出来、预算也扛得住，接受修改快速迭代
screens.en: A coherent, buildable visual direction that iterates fast

asks.zh: 给一个题材，你怎么定整体视觉基调和配色？
asks.en: Given a theme, how do you set tone and palette?

asks.zh: 你的概念图怎么让下游建模不走样？
asks.en: How do your concepts keep 3D from drifting off?

asks.zh: 方案被美术总监推翻重来，你怎么反应？
asks.en: The art director scraps your work — how do you respond?

insider.zh: 行家交的是能落地的设定，会给下游标注结构、材质和比例；新手只出好看的单张，一进 3D 就发现做不出来
insider.en: Pros hand off buildable sheets with structure notes, not just pretty images

screens.zh: 拓扑、UV、贴图的功底，加上能守住目标平台的面数和性能预算
screens.en: Topology, UV, texturing, and hitting the poly and perf budget

asks.zh: 移动端一个角色给你三万面，你怎么分配？
asks.en: 30k tris for a mobile character — how do you spend them?

asks.zh: 法线烘焙出问题，你一般先查什么？
asks.en: Normal bake looks wrong — what do you check first?

asks.zh: PBR 材质在不同光照下发灰，你怎么排？
asks.en: PBR material goes flat under some lighting — how do you fix it?

insider.zh: 强的建模时脑子里带着引擎里的样子和性能预算；弱的追高模精度，一进引擎就掉帧或穿模
insider.en: Strong artists model with the in-engine result and budget in mind

followups.zh: 美术效果和帧率冲突，你怎么取舍？
followups.en: Visual quality vs frame rate — how do you trade off?

screens.zh: 动画在引擎里、在玩家操控下手感好不好，而不只是在 Maya 里漂亮，状态机和融合的意识
screens.en: Animation that feels good under player control in-engine

asks.zh: 攻击动画手感差，你会从哪几个方面调？
asks.en: An attack feels bad — what do you tune?

asks.zh: 动作衔接卡顿，你怎么处理过渡和融合？
asks.en: Transitions stutter — how do you blend them?

asks.zh: 动画和打击判定帧怎么对齐？
asks.en: How do you align animation with hit frames?

insider.zh: 强的懂动画要为操作手感服务，会盯前摇后摇和取消窗口；弱的只做流畅的循环，一操作就发飘发粘
insider.en: Strong hires obsess over startup, recovery and cancel windows

screens.zh: 夹在美术和引擎之间，既要 shader 和管线功力，又要能帮美术解开卡点、守住性能线
screens.en: Shader and pipeline chops that unblock artists and hold perf

asks.zh: 美术资产拖垮帧率，你怎么定位是 CPU 还是 GPU 瓶颈？
asks.en: Assets tank FPS — how do you find if it's CPU or GPU bound?

asks.zh: 你写过什么工具帮美术提效？
asks.en: What tooling have you built to speed up artists?

asks.zh: 一个 shader 效果和性能怎么平衡？
asks.en: How do you balance a shader's look and cost?

insider.zh: 强的既能写 shader 又能搭工具流，还能跟美术和程序两边对话；弱的偏科，要么只会写效果要么只会调性能
insider.en: The good ones bridge both sides; the weak ones are one-sided

followups.zh: Draw call 太高，你从哪几层往下砍？
followups.en: Draw calls too high — what do you cut, and where?

screens.zh: 能不能把模糊的策划案落成健壮好维护的代码，会调手感和时序类问题
screens.en: Turning fuzzy specs into robust gameplay code, debugging feel

asks.zh: 策划的需求很模糊，你怎么落成代码？
asks.en: The design spec is vague — how do you turn it into code?

asks.zh: 角色移动手感怎么调，涉及哪些参数？
asks.en: How do you tune movement feel, and which params?

asks.zh: 一个偶现的战斗 bug，你怎么复现和定位？
asks.en: A rare combat bug — how do you repro and locate it?

insider.zh: 强的会追着策划问边界和意图，代码留扩展口；弱的照字面实现，需求一改就得重写
insider.en: Strong devs chase intent and leave room; weak ones code literally

followups.zh: 帧率波动导致物理表现不一致，你怎么解？
followups.en: Frame-rate swings break physics — how do you fix it?

screens.zh: 底层系统和渲染的深度，内存、GPU 管线、profiling，还有能造出全队都用得上的工具
screens.en: Low-level systems, rendering depth, profiling, team tooling

asks.zh: 渲染一帧的时间花在哪，你怎么拆？
asks.en: Where does a frame's time go — how do you break it down?

asks.zh: 内存占用过高，你怎么定位和优化？
asks.en: Memory usage too high — how do you locate and cut it?

asks.zh: 你实现过的一个渲染特性，性能是怎么控制的？
asks.en: A rendering feature you built — how did you keep it cheap?

insider.zh: 强的对 GPU 和 CPU 到底在干什么有切实的了解，拿 profiler 数据说话；弱的停在会用引擎 API，说不清底层开销
insider.en: Strong hires reason from the profiler, not from API familiarity

screens.zh: 能不能用中间件做随游戏状态变化的交互音频，而不只是交一堆线性音频文件
screens.en: Adaptive audio via middleware, not just linear sound files

asks.zh: 用 Wwise 或 FMOD，你怎么让音乐随战斗状态切换？
asks.en: In Wwise or FMOD, how do you shift music with combat state?

asks.zh: 大量音效同时触发，你怎么控制混音不糊？
asks.en: Many SFX fire at once — how do you keep the mix clean?

asks.zh: 一个音效没有打击感，你会怎么调？
asks.en: A sound lacks impact — how do you fix it?

insider.zh: 强的按游戏状态设计交互音频，懂 RTPC 和分层；弱的只交音频文件，不管在引擎里怎么触发和混
insider.en: Strong hires design around game state, RTPCs and layering

screens.zh: 结构化的测试思路、能复现的高质量缺陷报告，以及对 bug 藏在哪的直觉
screens.en: Structured testing, reproducible reports, instinct for where bugs hide

asks.zh: 一个 bug 偶现，你怎么写报告让程序能复现？
asks.en: A rare bug — how do you write it up so devs can repro?

asks.zh: 给你一个新功能，你怎么设计测试用例？
asks.en: New feature — how do you design test cases?

asks.zh: 时间不够只能测一部分，你怎么定优先级？
asks.en: Not enough time — how do you prioritize what to test?

insider.zh: 强的报告带稳定复现步骤和环境，会挑边界和回归；弱的只写游戏崩了，程序看了没法下手
insider.en: Strong testers give repro steps and hit edges; weak ones just say it crashed

followups.zh: 你怎么判断一个 bug 该不该卡上线？
followups.en: How do you decide if a bug should block release?

screens.zh: 能不能守住 scope、排期和团队士气，还敢做砍东西的硬决定，看的是交付，不是把 Jira 维护得漂亮
screens.en: Holding scope, schedule and morale, and making the hard cuts

asks.zh: 里程碑要延期，你怎么砍 scope、跟谁谈？
asks.en: A milestone will slip — what do you cut, and with whom?

asks.zh: 美术和程序为一个功能吵起来，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Art and code clash over a feature — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 版本快发了还有一堆 bug，你怎么定发不发？
asks.en: Ship date near, bugs remain — how do you call it?

insider.zh: 强的敢取舍、护得住节奏、风险提前暴露；弱的只搬进度条和开会，真要砍东西就和稀泥
insider.en: Strong producers cut and surface risk early; weak ones just track tickets

followups.zh: 你怎么早发现一个功能会做不完？
followups.en: How do you spot a feature that won't land, early?

screens.zh: 系统级的芯片架构判断，算力、带宽、功耗、面积的取舍，验证和流片纪律
screens.en: Chip architecture judgment — PPA tradeoffs, verification, tape-out

asks.zh: 加速卡上算力、内存带宽、功耗三者你怎么权衡？
asks.en: Compute vs bandwidth vs power on an accelerator — how do you trade off?

asks.zh: 内存带宽喂不饱计算单元，架构上你怎么解？
asks.en: Bandwidth can't feed the compute — how do you solve it in architecture?

asks.zh: 流片前你最担心哪一类问题，怎么提前堵？
asks.en: What worries you most before tape-out, and how do you catch it?

insider.zh: 强的每个取舍都能算出功耗、面积和成本的代价，拿真实约束说话；只跑通仿真、说不清量产和良率的还差一层
insider.en: Strong hires price every tradeoff in power, area and yield

screens.zh: 器件、制程、封装的物理功底，信号完整性、散热和工艺波动对良率的影响
screens.en: Device and packaging physics — signal integrity, thermal, yield

asks.zh: 高速信号完整性出问题，你的排查路径是什么？
asks.en: Signal integrity issues — what's your debug path?

asks.zh: 先进封装里散热和互连密度怎么权衡？
asks.en: In advanced packaging, how do you trade thermal against interconnect density?

asks.zh: 制程波动怎么影响良率，你怎么设计来兜住？
asks.en: How does process variation hit yield, and how do you design for it?

insider.zh: 行家能把器件物理一路算到量产良率上；只会看原理图、碰到工艺和封装实际约束就卡的是新手
insider.en: Pros connect device physics to yield; novices stall at schematics

screens.zh: 能不能建起并跑稳大规模 GPU 集群，调度、网络、存储，让上千张卡持续满载
screens.en: Building and running large GPU clusters at high utilization

asks.zh: 千卡训练一张卡挂了，整个任务怎么不白跑？
asks.en: One GPU dies mid thousand-card run — how do you not lose it all?

asks.zh: GPU 利用率上不去，你从哪几层查？
asks.en: GPU utilization is low — which layers do you check?

asks.zh: 分布式训练的网络你怎么设计，为什么？
asks.en: How do you design the network for distributed training, and why?

insider.zh: 强的盯集群整体利用率和故障恢复，懂 checkpoint 和网络拓扑；弱的会装卡装驱动，但撑不住规模化的稳定性
insider.en: Strong hires own utilization and fault recovery, not just setup

followups.zh: 一次大规模训练中断，你的容错设计是什么？
followups.en: A big run crashes — what's your fault-tolerance design?

screens.zh: ML 平台的生产可靠性，SLO 思维、on-call、事故响应、突发负载下的容量和扩缩容
screens.en: Production reliability — SLOs, on-call, incidents, autoscaling

asks.zh: 推理服务延迟突然飙高，你的排查顺序是什么？
asks.en: Inference latency spikes — what's your triage order?

asks.zh: 你怎么给一个 GPU 服务定 SLO 和容量？
asks.en: How do you set SLOs and capacity for a GPU service?

asks.zh: 一次线上事故，你怎么复盘和防复发？
asks.en: After an incident, how do you review and prevent recurrence?

insider.zh: 强的用 SLO 和错误预算说话，事故后改系统不改人；弱的靠人肉救火，复盘停在下次注意
insider.en: Strong SREs fix systems after incidents, not blame people

screens.zh: 研究品味和原创性，能框住真问题、设计实验、讲清前人为什么失败
screens.en: Research taste and originality — framing problems that matter

asks.zh: 最近一篇让你改变想法的论文是什么，为什么？
asks.en: A recent paper that changed your mind — which, and why?

asks.zh: 一个想法你怎么判断值不值得投几个月去做？
asks.en: How do you decide an idea is worth months of work?

asks.zh: 实验结果和预期不符，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Results defy expectations — what do you do?

insider.zh: 强的有自己的研究品味，说得清什么问题重要、为什么；弱的能复现别人的结果，却提不出真正的新问题
insider.en: Strong scientists pose new problems; weak ones only reproduce

followups.zh: 你怎么设计一个能证伪自己假设的实验？
followups.en: How do you design an experiment that could falsify your own hypothesis?

screens.zh: 能不能把研究想法搭成又快又稳的实验，会调不收敛的训练、保证可复现，还要懂足够的 ML，能跟科学家一起迭代
screens.en: Making experiments run fast and correct at scale to enable science

asks.zh: 训练跑不收敛，你怎么系统排查？
asks.en: Training won't converge — how do you debug it systematically?

asks.zh: 你怎么把一个实验的迭代速度提上去？
asks.en: How do you speed up an experiment's iteration loop?

asks.zh: 复现一篇论文对不上点数，你怎么查？
asks.en: A paper won't reproduce — how do you chase the gap?

insider.zh: 强的能把实验管线搭得又快又稳，让科学家专注想法；弱的只会跑现成脚本，一改架构就崩
insider.en: Strong REs build fast, stable pipelines; weak ones only run scripts

followups.zh: 显存不够跑大 batch，你有哪些手段？
followups.en: Out of VRAM for a big batch — what levers do you have?

screens.zh: 能不能把验证过的模型做成可靠可扩展的线上服务，权衡延迟、成本和质量
screens.en: Productionizing a validated model with the right latency-cost-quality tradeoffs

asks.zh: 一个模型离线指标好、上线效果差，你怎么查？
asks.en: Offline metrics strong, online weak — how do you diagnose?

asks.zh: 推理成本太高，你有哪些压缩和加速手段？
asks.en: Inference costs too much — how do you compress and speed it up?

asks.zh: 特征线上线下不一致，你怎么解？
asks.en: Train-serve feature skew — how do you fix it?

insider.zh: 强的把模型当成要长期运维的系统，盯线上指标和成本；弱的停在 notebook 里跑高分，不管上线后怎么活
insider.en: Strong MLEs own the live system and its cost, not just the notebook score

followups.zh: 模型上线后效果衰减，你怎么发现和应对？
followups.en: The model decays in production — how do you catch and respond?

screens.zh: 能不能建可靠可扩展的数据和特征管线，数据质量、schema 演进、批流和规模化成本
screens.en: Reliable, scalable data and feature pipelines with quality and lineage

asks.zh: 一条管线经常延迟或出脏数据，你怎么治？
asks.en: A pipeline keeps lagging and leaking dirty data — how do you fix it?

asks.zh: 训练数据规模翻十倍，你的管线要怎么改？
asks.en: Data grows 10x — how does your pipeline change?

asks.zh: 你怎么保证特征的质量和一致性？
asks.en: How do you guarantee feature quality and consistency?

insider.zh: 强的把数据质量和可回溯放第一位，管线带监控和血缘；弱的能跑通 ETL，但数据一错就找不到源头
insider.en: Strong DEs put quality and lineage first; weak ones can't trace an error

screens.zh: 模型全生命周期的管线，版本、模型 CI/CD、漂移监控、可复现部署和 serving
screens.en: Model lifecycle plumbing — versioning, CI/CD, drift, reproducible deploys

asks.zh: 你怎么做到一个模型能一键回滚到上个版本？
asks.en: How do you make a model one-click roll back a version?

asks.zh: 模型上线后你怎么监控数据漂移和效果衰减？
asks.en: How do you monitor drift and decay after deploy?

asks.zh: 从训练到部署，你怎么保证可复现？
asks.en: From training to deploy, how do you keep it reproducible?

insider.zh: 强的把全生命周期做成自动化和可追溯；弱的手动部署，出问题都不知道线上跑的是哪个版本
insider.en: Strong MLOps automate and trace; weak ones can't say which version is live

screens.zh: 能不能做出真能用的 LLM 功能，检索质量、评测、延迟成本，以及处理幻觉和失败模式
screens.en: Shipping LLM features that work — retrieval, eval, failure handling

asks.zh: 你的 RAG 检索不准，你从哪几步优化？
asks.en: RAG retrieval is off — what do you optimize, step by step?

asks.zh: 怎么评估一个 LLM 功能好不好，别只说感觉？
asks.en: How do you evaluate an LLM feature beyond gut feel?

asks.zh: 模型幻觉在生产里你怎么兜底？
asks.en: How do you guard against hallucination in production?

insider.zh: 强的有一套评测和迭代方法，拿数据判断好坏；弱的靠调 prompt 碰运气，说不清为什么这版更好
insider.en: Strong AIEs have an eval loop; weak ones tweak prompts by luck

followups.zh: Agent 多步任务中途出错，你怎么设计恢复？
followups.en: A multi-step agent errs mid-task — how do you design recovery?

screens.zh: 对可行性和用例价值的判断，能说清模型能做什么、不能做什么，把 eval 指标绑到用户价值
screens.en: Feasibility and value judgment — scoping what the model can do, eval tied to value

asks.zh: 一个 AI 需求你怎么判断技术上现在能不能做？
asks.en: How do you judge if an AI ask is technically feasible now?

asks.zh: 模型效果达不到预期，产品怎么设计兜底体验？
asks.en: The model underperforms — how do you design the fallback UX?

asks.zh: 你怎么给一个 AI 功能定义成功指标？
asks.en: How do you define success metrics for an AI feature?

insider.zh: 强的懂模型能力边界，把 eval 和用户价值挂钩；弱的把 AI 当魔法，需求脱离可行性，也说不清怎么衡量好坏
insider.en: Strong AI PMs know the capability edge; weak ones treat AI as magic

followups.zh: 准确率 85% 的功能，你敢不敢上，怎么上？
followups.en: An 85%-accurate feature — do you ship it, and how?

screens.zh: 能不能在客户脏乱的真实环境里把模型落地，工程能力加上把客户真问题问清楚的本事
screens.en: Landing a model in a messy customer env — engineering plus problem framing

asks.zh: 客户现场数据和你预期完全不一样，你怎么办？
asks.en: On-site data is nothing like you expected — what now?

asks.zh: 客户提的需求技术上做不到，你怎么谈？
asks.en: A client ask is technically impossible — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 你怎么在客户环境里快速搭一个能用的原型？
asks.en: How do you stand up a working prototype in a client's env fast?

insider.zh: 强的既能写代码又能现场把客户真问题问清楚、快速交出能用的东西；弱的只等清晰需求，面对模糊和脏数据就卡
insider.en: Strong FDEs code and frame the real problem on-site; weak ones wait for clean specs

followups.zh: 交付的系统客户自己维护不了，你怎么设计？
followups.en: The client can't maintain what you delivered — how do you design for that?

screens.zh: 对什么好卖的商业直觉和毛利纪律，读需求、管进货预算，不被自己的偏好带偏
screens.en: Commercial instinct on what sells, margin and open-to-buy discipline

asks.zh: 你怎么判断一个新品该进多少货？
asks.en: How do you decide how much of a new SKU to buy?

asks.zh: 一个品类卖不动、库存积压，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A category stalls with excess stock — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你踩过最大的选品坑是什么，学到了什么？
asks.en: Your worst buying mistake — what did you learn?

insider.zh: 强的用数据和周转率选货，对毛利和库存风险敏感；弱的凭个人喜好压货，卖不掉就打折清仓
insider.en: Strong buyers buy on turnover and margin, not personal taste

screens.zh: 谈判筹码和品类 P&L 的经营，能一边把品类毛利做起来一边管住供应商关系和账期
screens.en: Negotiation leverage and category P&L ownership

asks.zh: 跟一个强势供应商谈进价，你的筹码是什么？
asks.en: Negotiating cost with a strong vendor — what's your leverage?

asks.zh: 你负责的品类要提毛利，你有哪几个杠杆？
asks.en: To lift your category's margin, what levers do you pull?

asks.zh: 供应商断供或涨价，你怎么应对？
asks.en: A vendor cuts supply or raises price — how do you respond?

insider.zh: 强的把品类当一个 P&L 来经营，谈判有数据和替代方案做底；弱的只做订单执行，被供应商牵着走
insider.en: Strong CMs run a P&L with data and alternatives; weak ones just process orders

followups.zh: 自有品牌和品牌货，你怎么平衡？
followups.en: How do you balance private label against branded goods?

screens.zh: 定量的定价功底，弹性、竞品反应、毛利与销量的取舍，以及建模型和信模型的判断
screens.en: Quantitative pricing — elasticity, competitive response, margin vs volume

asks.zh: 你怎么估一个商品的价格弹性？
asks.en: How do you estimate a product's price elasticity?

asks.zh: 竞品降价了，你跟不跟，这笔账怎么算？
asks.en: A competitor cuts price — do you follow, and how do you do the math?

asks.zh: 自动调价模型给了个反直觉的价，你信不信？
asks.en: The pricing model outputs a counterintuitive price — do you trust it?

insider.zh: 强的懂弹性和交叉影响，会区分该跟的价和不该跟的；弱的只对标竞品价，说不清降价到底赚了还是亏了
insider.en: Strong analysts know elasticity; weak ones just match competitors blindly

followups.zh: 降价冲了销量但毛利下滑，这个平衡点你怎么定？
followups.en: Lower price lifts volume but cuts margin — where's the balance?

screens.zh: 效果营销的严谨度，ROAS 和 ACoS 的账、预算分配、归因，以及带来能赚钱的站内流量
screens.en: Performance rigor — ROAS math, budget allocation, attribution

asks.zh: 广告 ROAS 上不去，你从哪几个环节拆？
asks.en: ROAS won't rise — which levers do you break it into?

asks.zh: 预算固定，你怎么在多个广告位之间分配？
asks.en: Fixed budget — how do you split it across placements?

asks.zh: 站内广告和自然流量怎么平衡，别左手打右手？
asks.en: How do you balance paid and organic without cannibalizing?

insider.zh: 强的算得清每一块广告费带来的增量利润，懂归因；弱的只看点击和曝光，把本来会买的人也算成广告的功劳
insider.en: Strong hires measure incremental profit; weak ones credit ads for organic buyers

followups.zh: 你怎么衡量广告的增量，而不是蹭自然转化？
followups.en: How do you measure ad incrementality, not just borrowed conversions?

screens.zh: 带来能转化又持久的自然流量，搜索意图、站内排序、内容和关键词策略
screens.en: Durable, discoverable organic traffic that converts

asks.zh: 一个类目自然流量下滑，你怎么诊断？
asks.en: A category's organic traffic drops — how do you diagnose it?

asks.zh: 站内搜索和外部搜索优化，思路有什么不同？
asks.en: On-site vs external search — how does your approach differ?

asks.zh: 你怎么判断一批关键词值不值得投入去做？
asks.en: How do you decide a keyword set is worth the effort?

insider.zh: 强的盯能转化的流量和长期可见度，懂搜索意图；弱的只堆关键词和排名，来的流量不买单
insider.en: Strong strategists chase converting traffic; weak ones chase rankings alone

screens.zh: 能不能用产品撬动漏斗指标，问题定义、排优先级、用实验说话，把功能挂到 GMV 上
screens.en: Moving funnel metrics via product — prioritization, experiments, tied to GMV

asks.zh: 结算转化率低，你怎么定位问题、排优先级？
asks.en: Checkout conversion is low — how do you locate it and prioritize?

asks.zh: 一个功能上线后指标没动，你怎么复盘？
asks.en: A feature ships and metrics don't move — how do you review it?

asks.zh: 一堆需求里，你怎么决定先做哪个？
asks.en: Among many asks, how do you decide what's first?

insider.zh: 强的从漏斗数据倒推该做什么，拿实验验证；弱的堆功能清单，说不清每个功能撬动哪个指标
insider.en: Strong PMs work back from funnel data; weak ones pile features

followups.zh: 长期留存和短期转化冲突，你怎么取舍？
followups.en: Long-term retention vs short-term conversion — how do you choose?

screens.zh: 以转化为导向的设计，详情页和结算的摩擦、移动优先，用数据和测试验证，不靠审美
screens.en: Conversion-oriented design — checkout friction, validated by data

asks.zh: 详情页跳出率高，你会先改什么？
asks.en: High PDP bounce — what do you change first?

asks.zh: 结算流程你怎么减少放弃，有哪些常见坑？
asks.en: How do you cut checkout abandonment, and what are the traps?

asks.zh: 你的设计怎么用数据验证，而不是靠好看？
asks.en: How do you validate a design with data, not taste?

insider.zh: 强的拿转化和 A/B 数据说话，懂电商结算的减法；弱的追视觉美感，加了动效反而拖慢下单
insider.en: Strong designers subtract for conversion; weak ones add decoration that slows checkout

screens.zh: 优化履约网络的成本和时效，路由、承运商组合、单均成本建模，而且要顾到真实约束
screens.en: Optimizing network cost and speed — routing, carrier mix, cost-per-order

asks.zh: 单均履约成本要降，你从哪几块入手？
asks.en: To cut cost per order, where do you start?

asks.zh: 时效和成本冲突，你怎么给不同订单分配路径？
asks.en: Speed vs cost — how do you route different orders?

asks.zh: 一个仓的发货成本异常高，你怎么查？
asks.en: One FC's ship cost is off — how do you investigate?

insider.zh: 强的会建成本模型、在时效和成本间量化取舍；弱的只做报表，提不出能落地省钱的方案
insider.en: Strong analysts model cost tradeoffs; weak ones just report

screens.zh: 仓内的吞吐和人效，流程和布局优化、瓶颈分析、安全
screens.en: Throughput and labor efficiency inside the FC — bottlenecks, layout, safety

asks.zh: 拣货是瓶颈，你怎么分析和改善作业流？
asks.en: Picking is the bottleneck — how do you analyze and improve the flow?

asks.zh: 大促峰值产能不够，你怎么临时扩？
asks.en: Peak overruns capacity — how do you flex up?

asks.zh: 你怎么在提效和员工安全之间平衡？
