asks.en: How do you balance efficiency against worker safety?

insider.zh: 强的会做流程和瓶颈分析，拿吞吐和工时数据说话；弱的只提多招人，说不清瓶颈在哪个工位
insider.en: Strong IEs find the bottleneck station; weak ones just add headcount

screens.zh: 规模上来以后还能把运营跑稳，用人和成本达成吞吐与时效，尤其扛得住大促
screens.en: Running a live op at scale — throughput and SLA through people and cost, at peak

asks.zh: 大促当天爆仓，你怎么保时效和团队？
asks.en: The FC floods on peak day — how do you protect SLA and the team?

asks.zh: 你怎么在人力成本和发货时效之间做平衡？
asks.en: How do you balance labor cost against ship speed?

asks.zh: 一个仓出错率高，你怎么找根因、带团队改？
asks.en: High error rate — how do you find root cause and lead the fix?

insider.zh: 强的既懂运营指标又能带住一线团队，峰值稳得住；弱的只盯数字，真出状况压不住现场
insider.en: Strong managers hold both metrics and the floor under peak

screens.zh: 需求预测和库存平衡，既不缺货也不积压，把补货信号回传给采购
screens.en: Demand forecasting and inventory balance — no stockout, no dead stock

asks.zh: 你怎么在缺货和积压之间定安全库存？
asks.en: How do you set safety stock between stockout and overstock?

asks.zh: 需求预测老是不准，你怎么改进？
asks.en: Forecasts keep missing — how do you improve them?

asks.zh: 一个爆款突然断货，你怎么补救和预防？
asks.en: A hot item stocks out — how do you recover and prevent it?

insider.zh: 强的懂预测误差和补货周期，在服务水平和资金占用间算账；弱的只看当前库存，要么频繁断货要么仓里全是滞销
insider.en: Strong planners weigh service level against tied-up cash

followups.zh: 大促备货，你怎么定量、避免大促后一堆库存？
followups.en: For a big sale, how do you stock without a post-sale glut?

screens.zh: 能推动业务的模型，推荐、预测、定价能上线并抬真实指标，评测和 A/B 靠谱
screens.en: Models that ship and lift real metrics — recs, forecast, pricing, sound A/B

asks.zh: 推荐模型离线指标高、线上没提升，怎么查？
asks.en: Recs score high offline but flat online — how do you diagnose?

asks.zh: 你怎么给一个模型设计线上 A/B 实验？
asks.en: How do you design an online A/B test for a model?

asks.zh: 一个预测模型怎么落成业务能用的东西？
asks.en: How do you turn a forecast model into something the business uses?

insider.zh: 强的模型能上线，拿业务增量和 A/B 验证；弱的停在离线跑高 AUC，跟真实收益挂不上钩
insider.en: Strong DSes ship and prove lift; weak ones chase offline AUC

followups.zh: 推荐总推热门，长尾和多样性你怎么处理？
followups.en: Recs keep pushing hits — how do you handle long tail and diversity?

screens.zh: 造出整个业务闭环运转所依赖的平台，可扩展低延迟的推荐和定价服务，峰值下的可靠性
screens.en: Building the platform the loop runs on — scalable, low-latency, resilient

asks.zh: 推荐接口要扛大促峰值，你怎么设计和降级？
asks.en: The recs API must survive peak — how do you design and degrade it?

asks.zh: 定价引擎要求毫秒级返回，你怎么做？
asks.en: The pricing engine needs millisecond responses — how do you build it?

asks.zh: 一个高并发服务超时，你怎么定位和优化？
asks.en: A high-concurrency service times out — how do you locate and fix it?

insider.zh: 强的把模型工程化成稳定低延迟的平台，考虑降级和容量；弱的能写业务逻辑，扛不住峰值和延迟要求
insider.en: Strong engineers plan for degradation and capacity; weak ones only write logic

screens.zh: 能不能把模糊需求落成可制造、扛得住受力考验和成本推敲的设计。
screens.en: Can turn vague requirements into a manufacturable design that survives load and cost scrutiny.

asks.zh: 讲一个你做过的设计，公差和材料是怎么定的？
asks.en: Walk through a design you owned — how did you set tolerances and pick materials?

asks.zh: 强度不够又要减重，你怎么取舍？
asks.en: Strength shortfall vs weight target — how do you trade off?

asks.zh: 你怎么跟工艺和采购确认这个设计做得出来、买得到料？
asks.en: How do you confirm with process and sourcing that it's buildable and the material exists?

asks.zh: 用过哪些 CAD 和仿真工具，仿真结果你怎么验证？
asks.en: Which CAD and simulation tools, and how do you validate the sim?

insider.zh: 强的人从制造和装配倒推着设计，弱的人只画出好看的模型。
insider.en: Strong hires design backward from manufacturing (DFM); weak ones just build a pretty model.

followups.zh: 这个公差为什么这么定，松一档会怎样？
followups.en: Why that tolerance — what breaks if you loosen it one grade?

followups.zh: 供应商说这料做不出来，你的备选方案是什么？
followups.en: If the supplier can't make it, what's your plan B?

screens.zh: 出图规范、公差标注和读图能力，图纸能不能直接下车间不返工。
screens.en: Standards-clean drawings, correct tolerancing, shop-ready without rework.

asks.zh: 你熟悉哪套制图标准，形位公差的基准怎么选？
asks.en: Which drafting standard, and how do you pick GD&T datums?

asks.zh: 一张图纸交出去前你怎么自检？
asks.en: How do you self-check a drawing before releasing it?

asks.zh: 设计变更来了，你怎么管版本和图纸更新？
asks.en: When a change order lands, how do you manage revisions?

insider.zh: 强的人真懂形位公差，能挑出会造成加工歧义的标注，不是照抄工程师。
insider.en: Strong drafters actually understand GD&T and catch ambiguous callouts, not just trace the engineer.

followups.zh: 基准面选错会导致什么后果？
followups.en: What goes wrong if the datum is chosen wrong?

screens.zh: 能不能把图纸落成节拍稳、瓶颈少、工时可核的工艺和产线布局。
screens.en: Can turn drawings into a balanced line with defensible standard times.

asks.zh: 一条线产能不达标，你怎么找瓶颈？
asks.en: A line misses target output — how do you find the bottleneck?

asks.zh: 标准工时你怎么测，怎么防止操作工不认？
asks.en: How do you set standard times so operators accept them?

asks.zh: 讲一次你做的产线平衡或工艺改善，省了多少？
asks.en: Describe a line-balance or process improvement — how much did it save?

asks.zh: 价值流图你怎么用？
asks.en: How do you use value-stream mapping?

insider.zh: 强的人用节拍、OEE、瓶颈数据说话，弱的人凭经验拍工时。
insider.en: Strong IEs argue with takt, OEE and bottleneck data; weak ones eyeball the time.

followups.zh: 你算出来的节省，财务认吗，怎么核？
followups.en: Does finance accept your savings, and how is it verified?

followups.zh: 换线时间你怎么压？
followups.en: How do you cut changeover time (SMED)?

screens.zh: 交付、成本、质量、安全一起扛，尤其订单和产能冲突时敢做决策。
screens.en: Holds delivery, cost, quality and safety together and decides under conflict.

asks.zh: 订单排满了又插急单，你怎么排？
asks.en: The schedule is full and a rush order comes in — how do you sequence?

asks.zh: 车间良率突然掉，你头两小时做什么？
asks.en: Yield suddenly drops on the floor — what do you do in the first two hours?

asks.zh: 你带过多少人，怎么处理产量压力和员工流失的矛盾？
asks.en: How large a team, and how do you handle output pressure vs turnover?

asks.zh: 你盯哪几个指标，多久看一次？
asks.en: Which metrics do you watch, and how often?

insider.zh: 强的人在交付、成本、质量之间做明确取舍并担责，弱的人只喊数字或甩锅给上下游。
insider.en: Strong managers make explicit tradeoffs and own them; weak ones chase numbers and blame up- and downstream.

followups.zh: 那次没按期交付，根因和你的责任是什么？
followups.en: That missed delivery — root cause and your part in it?

screens.zh: 在缺料、改单、产能波动里让排程排得住、料齐得上。
screens.en: Keeps a schedule that holds under shortages, change orders and capacity swings.

asks.zh: 关键物料要延期到货，你怎么重排？
asks.en: A key material slips — how do you re-plan?

asks.zh: 你用什么系统跑 MRP，安全库存和提前期怎么设？
asks.en: Which system for MRP, and how do you set safety stock and lead times?

asks.zh: 客户临时改单量，你怎么评估影响并回复？
asks.en: Customer changes the order quantity — how do you assess impact and respond?

insider.zh: 强的人看得见提前期和 BOM 的连锁反应，会主动催料、提前防范，弱的人只被动改系统数字。
insider.en: Strong planners see lead-time and BOM ripple effects and expedite proactively; weak ones just edit the system reactively.

followups.zh: 安全库存定高占资金、定低断线，你怎么权衡？
followups.en: Too much safety stock ties up cash, too little starves the line — how do you weigh it?

screens.zh: 拿得到价、保得住交期、控得住质量和供应风险的采购判断。
screens.en: Lands price, secures delivery, and controls quality and supply risk.

asks.zh: 你怎么找和评估一家新供应商？
asks.en: How do you find and qualify a new supplier?

asks.zh: 供应商涨价 20%，你怎么谈？
asks.en: A supplier raises price 20% — how do you negotiate?

asks.zh: 独家供应商突然断供，你怎么办？
asks.en: Your single-source supplier suddenly cuts off — what now?

asks.zh: 最低价和交付可靠你怎么平衡？
asks.en: How do you balance lowest price against reliable delivery?

insider.zh: 强的人管的是总拥有成本和供应风险，弱的人只比单价。
insider.en: Strong buyers manage total cost of ownership and supply risk; weak ones just chase unit price.

followups.zh: 你砍下来的价，质量和交期有没有因此出问题？
followups.en: The price you cut — did quality or delivery suffer for it?

screens.zh: 现场管人、保安全、达产量、控质量的一线执行力。
screens.en: Frontline execution — managing people, safety, output and quality on the floor.

asks.zh: 老师傅不服你管，你怎么带？
asks.en: A veteran operator won't take your lead — how do you manage that?

asks.zh: 班上出了工伤或安全隐患，你怎么处理？
asks.en: An injury or safety hazard on your shift — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 当班产量差一截，你怎么补？
asks.en: Your shift is running short on output — how do you recover?

asks.zh: 你怎么给工人排班和分配工作？
asks.en: How do you schedule and assign work?

insider.zh: 强的人靠威信和现场解决问题带队，弱的人靠职级压人、只会上报。
insider.en: Strong supervisors lead with credibility and on-the-spot problem solving; weak ones lean on rank and just escalate.

followups.zh: 你处理过最难的员工冲突是什么，结果如何？
followups.en: Toughest people conflict you handled, and the outcome?

screens.zh: 看图、对刀、控尺寸和处置报警的实操本事，安全和稳定第一。
screens.en: Reads prints, sets up, holds tolerance, and reacts to alarms — safely and consistently.

asks.zh: 你操作过哪些机床和系统？
asks.en: Which machines and controls have you run (FANUC, Siemens)?

asks.zh: 加工出来的尺寸超差了，你先查什么？
asks.en: A part comes out over tolerance — what do you check first?

asks.zh: 你会不会改程序、对刀、设工件坐标系？
asks.en: Can you edit programs, set tools, and set the work offset?

asks.zh: 刀具磨损你怎么判断和更换？
asks.en: How do you judge tool wear and when to change it?

insider.zh: 强的人能读图纸、听声音判断刀具和参数问题，弱的人只会按启动键。
insider.en: Strong operators read prints and diagnose tool and parameter issues by sound and feel; weak ones just hit cycle-start.

followups.zh: 首件检验你怎么做，为什么重要？
followups.en: How do you run first-article inspection, and why does it matter?

screens.zh: 手上活稳定、按标准作业、跟得上节拍、报得出异常。
screens.en: Consistent hands, follows the work instruction, keeps takt, flags defects.

asks.zh: 你装过最复杂的产品是什么，多少道工序？
asks.en: Most complex product you've assembled, and how many steps?

asks.zh: 发现一个来料装不上，你会怎么做？
asks.en: An incoming part won't fit — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你怎么保证每台装出来都一样？
asks.en: How do you keep every unit consistent?

insider.zh: 强的人会停线报异常，弱的人为赶量把问题往下游藏。
insider.en: Strong assemblers stop and flag rather than force a bad part through; weak ones hide problems downstream to hit count.

followups.zh: 节拍紧和质量之间，你怎么取舍？
followups.en: Tight takt vs quality — how do you choose?

screens.zh: 量具会用、判定准、敢拦不良品，记录经得起追溯。
screens.en: Uses gauges right, judges accurately, dares to reject, keeps traceable records.

asks.zh: 你会用哪些量具？
asks.en: Which gauges can you use (calipers, micrometers, CMM)?

asks.zh: 一个零件在合格线边缘，你怎么判？
asks.en: A part sits right on the tolerance line — how do you call it?

asks.zh: 主管催你放行一批可疑品，你怎么办？
asks.en: A supervisor pushes you to pass a suspect lot — what do you do?

asks.zh: 抽检和全检你怎么选？
asks.en: Sampling vs 100% inspection — how do you decide?

insider.zh: 强的人守得住判定标准、顶得住产量压力，弱的人怕得罪人放水。
insider.en: Strong inspectors hold the line under output pressure; weak ones wave marginal parts through to avoid friction.

followups.zh: 你放行后发现批量不良，怎么处理和上报？
followups.en: You released it and then a batch defect shows up — how do you handle and escalate?

screens.zh: 能不能建体系、控过程、用数据把不良率压下来并扛住审核。
screens.en: Builds the system, controls the process, drives defects down with data, and passes audits.

asks.zh: 客户投诉一个批量质量问题，你怎么组织 8D？
asks.en: A customer reports a batch quality problem — how do you run the 8D?

asks.zh: 你怎么搭 SPC，控制图报警了怎么处理？
asks.en: How do you set up SPC, and what do you do when a control chart signals?

asks.zh: 体系审核你怎么准备？
asks.en: How do you prepare for a system audit (ISO, IATF)?

asks.zh: 质量成本你怎么算，怎么向管理层证明投入值得？
asks.en: How do you quantify cost of quality and justify the spend to leadership?

insider.zh: 强的人做的是预防和过程控制，弱的人只在末端多加检验。
insider.en: Strong quality managers prevent and control upstream; weak ones just add inspection at the end.

followups.zh: 根因分析你怎么防止停在表面原因？
followups.en: How do you keep root-cause analysis from stopping at the symptom?

followups.zh: 质量和交付冲突时你怎么和生产经理谈？
followups.en: When quality and delivery collide, how do you talk to the production manager?

screens.zh: 账实相符、先进先出、收发准确、不耽误产线的库存基本功。
screens.en: Book-to-floor accuracy, FIFO, correct receiving and picking that never starves the line.

asks.zh: 盘点账实不符，你怎么查？
asks.en: Count doesn't match the book — how do you investigate?

asks.zh: 你用什么系统管库存，怎么保证录入准确？
asks.en: Which system do you use, and how do you keep entries accurate?

asks.zh: 一批料急着上线但还没入库，你怎么处理？
asks.en: Material is needed on the line but not yet received — how do you handle it?

insider.zh: 强的人靠循环盘点主动纠偏，弱的人只等年终大盘点才发现差异。
insider.en: Strong clerks keep accuracy with cycle counts; weak ones only find gaps at year-end.

followups.zh: 呆滞料和过期料你怎么管？
followups.en: How do you manage slow-moving and expired stock?

screens.zh: 持证、安全意识、搬运准确不撞不压货、跟得上上料节奏。
screens.en: Licensed, safety-minded, accurate moves, keeps the line fed.

asks.zh: 你有叉车证吗，开过哪些机型？
asks.en: Are you certified, and which trucks have you operated?

asks.zh: 通道里有人你怎么操作？
asks.en: How do you operate when there are people in the aisle?

asks.zh: 货叠得太高或不稳，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A load is stacked too high or unstable — what do you do?

insider.zh: 强的人把安全放在效率前，弱的人图快在厂内飙车埋隐患。
insider.en: Strong operators put safety before speed; weak ones race the floor and create hazards.

followups.zh: 出过或差点出过什么事故，你怎么防？
followups.en: Any accident or near-miss, and how do you prevent it?

screens.zh: 把发运排得准、成本压得住、异常处理得快，客户按时收货。
screens.en: Schedules shipments accurately, controls freight cost, handles exceptions so goods arrive on time.

asks.zh: 一批货要赶客户收货窗口但产能没跟上，你怎么协调？
asks.en: A shipment must hit the customer's window but production is late — how do you coordinate?

asks.zh: 你怎么选承运商和运输方式，怎么控运费？
asks.en: How do you choose carriers and modes, and control freight cost?

asks.zh: 一批货丢了或延误，你怎么处理和对客户交代？
asks.en: A shipment is lost or delayed — how do you handle it and answer the customer?

insider.zh: 强的人统筹全链路成本和时效并管好承运商，弱的人只做订舱录单。
insider.en: Strong logisticians optimize end-to-end cost and lead time and manage carriers; weak ones just book and key in orders.

followups.zh: 出口报关和单证出问题你怎么应对？
followups.en: How do you deal with customs and documentation problems?

screens.zh: 故障判断快、修得好、能做预防性维护把停机压到最低。
screens.en: Fast diagnosis, solid repairs, and preventive maintenance that minimizes downtime.

asks.zh: 一台关键设备突然停机，你排查的步骤是什么？
asks.en: A critical machine suddenly stops — what's your troubleshooting sequence?

asks.zh: 机械、电气、液压你哪几样拿手？
asks.en: Mechanical, electrical, hydraulic — which are you strongest in?

asks.zh: 你做过哪些预防性维护，效果如何？
asks.en: What preventive maintenance have you run, and what was the effect?

asks.zh: 备件缺货耽误维修，你怎么办？
asks.en: A missing spare part is holding up a repair — what do you do?

insider.zh: 强的人找根因防复发，弱的人头痛医头修完就走。
insider.en: Strong mechanics find root cause to stop recurrence; weak ones just patch and leave.

followups.zh: 修得快和修得对冲突时你怎么选？
followups.en: When fast and correct conflict, which do you pick?

screens.zh: 信息录得准、保险核得清、待人接物稳，尤其面对着急的病人。
screens.en: Accurate info, clean insurance verification, and composure with anxious patients.

asks.zh: 病人很着急、插队吵闹，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A patient is anxious and cutting the line — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 保险信息不全或核验不过，你怎么办？
asks.en: Insurance info is incomplete or won't verify — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你怎么保证录入的个人和保险信息准确？
asks.en: How do you keep demographic and insurance entry accurate?

insider.zh: 强的人一次把信息和保险核到位、少给后面的计费环节埋雷，弱的人图快录错拖累计费。
insider.en: Strong clerks get info and coverage right the first time; weak ones rush and create billing problems downstream.

followups.zh: 你怎么在保护隐私的同时快速办理？
followups.en: How do you stay fast while protecting privacy (HIPAA)?

screens.zh: 危急分级判断准、能识别高危、在信息不全和高压下快速决策。
screens.en: Accurate acuity, spots red flags, decides fast under pressure with incomplete info.

asks.zh: 候诊区同时来了胸痛病人、发烧小孩和割伤病人，你怎么分级？
asks.en: Chest pain, a febrile child and a laceration arrive at once — how do you triage?

asks.zh: 你用哪套分诊标准，依据是什么？
asks.en: Which triage scale do you use (ESI, five-level), and on what basis?

asks.zh: 病人主诉轻但你直觉不对，你怎么做？
asks.en: The complaint sounds minor but your gut says otherwise — what do you do?

insider.zh: 强的人能从一堆普通主诉里抓出真正危急的那个，弱的人照着表打分错过高危。
insider.en: Strong triage nurses catch the truly sick one among routine complaints; weak ones score by the sheet and miss red flags.

followups.zh: 分级偏保守和资源浪费之间你怎么平衡？
followups.en: How do you balance over-triage against wasting resources?

followups.zh: 有没有分错过级，学到什么？
followups.en: Ever mis-triaged, and what did you learn?

screens.zh: 临床和行政两头都能干、采集准、周转快，医生用着顺手。
screens.en: Does both clinical and clerical work, accurate intake, fast turnover, makes the physician efficient.

asks.zh: 你会哪些操作，抽血、心电图、生命体征、注射？
asks.en: Which procedures can you do — venipuncture, ECG, vitals, injections?

asks.zh: 诊室排满了，你怎么安排周转？
asks.en: Rooms are full — how do you manage turnover?

asks.zh: 病人不肯配合抽血或问诊，你怎么办？
asks.en: A patient won't cooperate with a draw or history — what do you do?

insider.zh: 强的人预判医生下一步、把诊室准备到位，弱的人只等着被逐条指派。
insider.en: Strong MAs anticipate the physician's next step and set the room up; weak ones wait to be told each task.

followups.zh: 采集病史你怎么在准确和快之间平衡？
followups.en: How do you balance accuracy and speed when taking a history?

screens.zh: 临床判断和鉴别诊断的稳与准，加沟通和带团队的能力。
screens.en: Sound clinical judgment and differential, plus communication and team leadership.

asks.zh: 讲一个诊断有难度的病例，你的思路是什么？
asks.en: Walk through a tough diagnosis — what was your reasoning?

asks.zh: 病人要求开一个你认为没必要的检查或抗生素，你怎么办？
asks.en: A patient demands a test or antibiotic you think is unnecessary — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你怎么和护士、专科、药师协作管理一个复杂病人？
asks.en: How do you work with nursing, specialists and pharmacy on a complex patient?

asks.zh: 出了诊疗差错你怎么处理？
asks.en: How do you handle a clinical error?

insider.zh: 强的人讲得清鉴别诊断和排除思路，弱的人跳步就下结论。
insider.en: Strong physicians reason through the differential out loud; weak ones jump to a conclusion.

followups.zh: 不确定的时候你怎么决定查还是观察？
followups.en: When uncertain, how do you decide to investigate or watch and wait?

followups.zh: 你怎么向病人交代坏消息？
followups.en: How do you break bad news to a patient?

screens.zh: 独立接诊的临床能力，加上清楚执业范围边界、知道什么时候该转给医生。
screens.en: Independent clinical competence plus knowing scope limits and when to escalate to a physician.

asks.zh: 你独立管理哪类病人，什么情况会转给医生？
asks.en: Which patients do you manage independently, and when do you refer to a physician?

asks.zh: 讲一个你独立诊断和处理的复杂病例。
asks.en: Describe a complex case you diagnosed and managed on your own.

asks.zh: 你怎么和监督医生分工协作？
asks.en: How do you divide work with your collaborating physician?

insider.zh: 强的人清楚自己能力和执业范围的边界、该转就转，弱的人要么越界要么什么都往上推。
insider.en: Strong NPs know the edge of their scope and refer appropriately; weak ones either overreach or escalate everything.

followups.zh: 你怎么保持处方和用药知识更新？
followups.en: How do you keep prescribing and drug knowledge current?

screens.zh: 监督下独立干活的能力、跨科室适应力，和医生协作顺不顺。
screens.en: Works autonomously under supervision, adapts across specialties, collaborates well with the physician.

asks.zh: 你轮转过哪些科室，怎么快速上手一个新专科？
asks.en: Which specialties have you rotated through, and how do you ramp on a new one?

asks.zh: 什么情况你会叫监督医生或叫停手术？
asks.en: When would you call the attending or stop a procedure?

asks.zh: 讲一个你独立处理、后来和医生复盘的病例。
asks.en: Describe a case you handled solo and later reviewed with the physician.

insider.zh: 强的人清楚哪些能自己拍板、哪些必须请示监督医生，弱的人分不清这条线。
insider.en: Strong PAs know what they can own and what needs the attending; weak ones blur that line.

followups.zh: 跨专科时你怎么补自己不熟的知识？
followups.en: How do you fill knowledge gaps when you switch specialties?

screens.zh: 专科技术深度、手术判断和并发症处理，以及复杂病例的决策。
screens.en: Depth of specialty skill, operative judgment, complication management, and decisions on hard cases.

asks.zh: 讲一个术中出意外你怎么处置的病例。
asks.en: Describe an intraoperative complication and how you handled it.

asks.zh: 一个边缘手术指征的病人，你怎么决定做不做？
asks.en: A borderline surgical indication — how do you decide to operate or not?

asks.zh: 你的手术量和并发症率大概什么水平？
asks.en: What are your case volume and complication rates?

asks.zh: 转诊来的诊断和你判断不一致，你怎么办？
asks.en: The referral diagnosis differs from your read — what do you do?

insider.zh: 强的人敢讲自己的并发症和不做手术的判断，弱的人只报成功病例、回避风险讨论。
insider.en: Strong specialists discuss their complications and their decisions not to operate; weak ones only cite successes.

followups.zh: 你怎么和病人沟通手术风险和知情同意？
followups.en: How do you communicate surgical risk and informed consent?

followups.zh: 什么情况你会承认这台你不该做、该转给别人？
followups.en: When would you admit a case isn't yours and refer it out?

screens.zh: 执行医嘱准、观察病情变化敏锐、同时管多个病人时的时间安排和交接不出错。
screens.en: Accurate order execution, sharp at catching deterioration, safe multi-patient time management and handoff.

asks.zh: 你同时管几个病人，怎么排优先级？
asks.en: How many patients at once, and how do you prioritize?

asks.zh: 病人在恶化、医生还没到，你做什么？
asks.en: A patient is deteriorating and the physician isn't there yet — what do you do?

asks.zh: 一个医嘱你觉得有问题，你怎么处理？
asks.en: You think an order is wrong — how do you handle it?

asks.zh: 交接班你怎么保证信息不漏？
asks.en: How do you make sure nothing is dropped at handoff?

insider.zh: 强的人是最早发现病情变化并敢质疑医嘱的那道防线，弱的人只机械执行。
insider.en: Strong RNs are the first line to catch deterioration and question a wrong order; weak ones just execute mechanically.

followups.zh: 给药查对你怎么落实，出过差错吗？
followups.en: How do you enforce medication checks — any errors?

followups.zh: 家属情绪失控你怎么处理？
followups.en: How do you handle a family member losing control?

screens.zh: 基础护理扎实、给药和监测准、清楚哪些必须上报 RN。
screens.en: Solid basic care, accurate meds and monitoring, clear on what must go to the RN.

asks.zh: 你负责哪些护理操作，哪些必须交给 RN？
asks.en: Which nursing tasks do you own, and which must go to the RN?

asks.zh: 监测中发现异常生命体征，你的流程是什么？
asks.en: You find abnormal vitals during monitoring — what's your process?

asks.zh: 你怎么和 RN 分工配合？
asks.en: How do you split work with the RN?

insider.zh: 强的人守得住执业范围、该报的及时报，弱的人要么越权要么漏报。
insider.en: Strong LPNs respect scope and report promptly; weak ones overstep or under-report.

followups.zh: 病人情况突然变化你第一步做什么？
followups.en: A patient changes suddenly — what's your first move?

screens.zh: 基础照护做得细、观察上报及时、对病人有耐心和尊重。
screens.en: Attentive basic care, timely reporting of changes, patience and dignity with patients.

asks.zh: 你怎么照护一个不能自理、脾气也不好的病人？
asks.en: How do you care for a patient who can't self-care and is irritable?

asks.zh: 病人有什么变化你会马上报告 RN？
asks.en: What changes would make you report to the RN right away?

asks.zh: 一天照护很多病人，你怎么保证都照顾到？
asks.en: With many patients in a shift, how do you make sure none is neglected?

insider.zh: 强的人在床旁最先察觉皮肤、进食、精神的细微变化并报告，弱的人只完成体力活。
insider.en: Strong CNAs notice subtle changes in skin, intake and mood at the bedside; weak ones just do the physical tasks.

followups.zh: 病人摔倒了你第一步做什么？
followups.en: A patient falls — what do you do first?

screens.zh: 检测准、质控严、危急值报得及时，懂结果异常时的复核判断。
screens.en: Accurate testing, strict QC, timely critical-value reporting, judgment on rechecking abnormals.

asks.zh: 一个结果明显异常但和临床对不上，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A result is clearly abnormal but doesn't fit the clinical picture — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你怎么做室内质控，失控了怎么办？
asks.en: How do you run internal QC, and what do you do when it's out of control?

asks.zh: 危急值你的报告流程是什么？
asks.en: What's your critical-value reporting workflow?

insider.zh: 强的人会质疑对不上的结果、先复核再发报告，弱的人机器出啥就发啥。
insider.en: Strong technologists question results that don't fit and recheck before releasing; weak ones report whatever the machine says.

followups.zh: 标本不合格你怎么判断和处理？
followups.en: How do you identify and handle an unacceptable specimen?

screens.zh: 摆位准、成像质量高、辐射防护到位，难配合的病人也拍得出可判读片子。
screens.en: Correct positioning, image quality, radiation safety, gets diagnostic images even from difficult patients.

asks.zh: 病人配合不了标准体位，你怎么拍出可判读的片子？
asks.en: A patient can't hold the standard position — how do you still get a diagnostic image?

asks.zh: 辐射防护你怎么落实？
asks.en: How do you apply radiation safety (ALARA)?

asks.zh: 片子质量不行，你怎么判断要不要重拍？
asks.en: The image is poor — how do you decide whether to re-shoot?

insider.zh: 强的人在辐射剂量和成像质量之间权衡、尽量一次拍好，弱的人反复重拍加剂量。
insider.en: Strong techs balance dose and image quality to get it right the first time; weak ones re-shoot and pile on dose.

followups.zh: 孕妇或儿童检查你怎么调整？
followups.en: How do you adjust for a pregnant patient or a child?

screens.zh: 审方抓得出相互作用和剂量错误、用药重整严、患教讲得清。
screens.en: Catches interactions and dosing errors on review, rigorous med reconciliation, clear counseling.

asks.zh: 你审出过什么严重的处方问题，怎么和医生沟通？
asks.en: What serious Rx problem have you caught, and how did you raise it with the prescriber?

asks.zh: 一个剂量你觉得偏高，医生坚持，你怎么办？
asks.en: You think a dose is too high but the physician insists — what do you do?

asks.zh: 多重用药的老人你怎么做用药重整？
asks.en: How do you reconcile meds for a polypharmacy elderly patient?

insider.zh: 强的人敢挡住有问题的处方并和医生据理力争，弱的人怕冲突照发。
insider.en: Strong pharmacists hold a bad Rx and push back with the prescriber; weak ones avoid conflict and dispense.

followups.zh: 抗生素管理和管制药品你怎么把关？
followups.en: How do you steward antibiotics and control controlled substances?

screens.zh: 配药准、批号效期核对严、流程合规、周转快不出错。
screens.en: Accurate filling, strict lot and expiry checks, compliant workflow, fast and error-free.

asks.zh: 你怎么核对确保拿对药、拿对剂量？
asks.en: How do you verify the right drug and the right dose?

asks.zh: 发现库存药快过期或被召回，你怎么处理？
asks.en: You find stock nearing expiry or under recall — what do you do?

asks.zh: 配药高峰期你怎么保证不出错？
asks.en: How do you stay error-free during peak volume?

insider.zh: 强的人把每一步核对当红线、可疑就找药师，弱的人熟练之后靠惯性省步骤。
insider.en: Strong techs treat every check as non-negotiable and flag to the pharmacist; weak ones skip steps once comfortable.

followups.zh: 管制药品的清点和记录你怎么做？
followups.en: How do you count and document controlled substances?

screens.zh: 评估心理、社会和经济方面的需求、链接资源、处理棘手的出院障碍和家庭矛盾。
screens.en: Assesses psychosocial and financial needs, links resources, handles hard discharge barriers and family conflict.

asks.zh: 病人医学上能出院但没人照顾、也付不起，你怎么办？
asks.en: A patient is medically ready to leave but has no caregiver and can't pay — what do you do?

asks.zh: 家属对治疗方案有分歧，你怎么协调？
asks.en: The family disagrees on the care plan — how do you mediate?

asks.zh: 你怎么评估和应对疑似虐待或忽视？
asks.en: How do you assess and act on suspected abuse or neglect?

insider.zh: 强的人能找出卡住出院的真实社会障碍并链接到资源，弱的人只发一张转介单。
insider.en: Strong social workers surface the real barrier holding up discharge and connect resources; weak ones just hand over a referral sheet.

followups.zh: 手上资源不够满足病人需求时你怎么办？
followups.en: What do you do when available resources fall short of the need?

screens.zh: 横向统筹力，把多科室、出院计划、随访、支付方串起来，不让病人在环节之间掉队。
screens.en: Cross-functional steering — stitching specialties, discharge, follow-up and payer so the patient doesn't fall through.

asks.zh: 一个涉及多科室和保险的复杂病人，你怎么统筹出院和随访？
asks.en: A complex patient across specialties and payers — how do you coordinate discharge and follow-up?

asks.zh: 你怎么降低再入院率？
asks.en: How do you reduce readmissions?

asks.zh: 医生、护士、家属、保险几方目标不一致，你怎么协调？
asks.en: When physician, nurse, family and payer want different things, how do you align them?

insider.zh: 强的人主动预判衔接断点、提前铺路，弱的人只被动处理已经出问题的转介。
insider.en: Strong coordinators anticipate handoff gaps and set them up early; weak ones only react to referrals that already broke.

followups.zh: 你用什么指标衡量协调做得好不好？
followups.en: What metrics tell you the coordination is working?

followups.zh: 保险不批你要的服务，你怎么争取？
followups.en: The payer denies a service you need — how do you fight for it?

screens.zh: 编码准、懂 ICD 和 CPT 规则、能从病历里读出该编的码，合规、不高编也不漏编。
screens.en: Accurate coding, knows ICD and CPT rules, reads the chart right, compliant without upcoding or undercoding.

asks.zh: 病历文档不足以支持某个诊断编码，你怎么办？
asks.en: Documentation doesn't support a diagnosis code — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你怎么保证编码合规、避免高编风险？
asks.en: How do you keep coding compliant and avoid upcoding risk?

asks.zh: ICD 和 CPT 你怎么保持更新？
asks.en: How do you keep current on ICD and CPT?

insider.zh: 强的人会向医生查询澄清而不是猜着编，弱的人凭印象套码埋下审计风险。
insider.en: Strong coders query the physician to clarify rather than guess; weak ones code by impression and invite audit risk.

followups.zh: 编码被拒付，你怎么申诉？
followups.en: A coded claim is denied — how do you appeal?

screens.zh: 出账准、拒付会申诉、懂保险规则、把该收的钱收回来。
screens.en: Accurate claims, works denials, knows payer rules, collects what's owed.

asks.zh: 一笔理赔被拒付，你的处理流程是什么？
asks.en: A claim is denied — what's your process?

asks.zh: 你怎么降低拒付率？
asks.en: How do you bring down the denial rate?

asks.zh: 病人对账单有异议，你怎么沟通？
asks.en: A patient disputes a bill — how do you handle it?

insider.zh: 强的人分析拒付根因、从源头减少，弱的人只是一张张重投。
insider.en: Strong billers analyze denial root causes to cut them at the source; weak ones just resubmit one by one.

followups.zh: 逾期未收账款你怎么跟进？
followups.en: How do you follow up on aged receivables?

screens.zh: 建模干净、找数据快、备忘录写得清，基本功和抗压能力。
screens.en: Clean modeling, fast data work, clear memo writing, fundamentals and stamina.

asks.zh: 给你一家公司，你怎么搭三张表和一个 DCF 或 LBO 模型？
asks.en: Given a company, how do you build the three statements and a DCF or LBO?

asks.zh: 讲一个你跟过的行业或标的，投资逻辑是什么？
asks.en: Walk through a name or sector you've followed — what's the thesis?

asks.zh: Excel 快捷键和建模习惯，你熟到什么程度？
asks.en: How fluent are you in Excel shortcuts and modeling hygiene?

asks.zh: EBITDA 到自由现金流怎么调？
asks.en: How do you bridge from EBITDA to free cash flow?

insider.zh: 强的人清楚每个假设背后的商业逻辑，弱的人只会套模板拉公式。
insider.en: Strong analysts know the business logic behind each assumption; weak ones just fill a template.

followups.zh: 你这个增长假设凭什么，压测一下会怎样？
followups.en: What backs that growth assumption, and how does it hold under a stress test?

followups.zh: LBO 里回报主要来自杠杆还是增长？
followups.en: In the LBO, does the return come mainly from leverage or growth?

screens.zh: 能独立带一段尽调、把粗糙线索快速判生死、指挥分析师产出。
screens.en: Owns a diligence workstream, kills or advances leads fast, and directs analysts.

asks.zh: 一个 teaser 到你手上，你先看什么、多快决定深入还是 pass？
asks.en: A teaser lands — what do you look at first, and how fast do you decide to dig or pass?

asks.zh: 讲一个你主导的尽调，发现的关键问题是什么？
asks.en: Describe a diligence you led — what was the key finding?

asks.zh: 你怎么给分析师分活、检查他们的模型？
asks.en: How do you assign work to analysts and check their models?

insider.zh: 强的人一旦识别出 deal breaker 就果断叫停，弱的人舍不得沉没成本把死单拖下去。
insider.en: Strong associates spot the deal breaker early and kill fast; weak ones sink cost into a dead deal.

followups.zh: 你最近 pass 掉的一个 deal，理由是什么，后来看对不对？
followups.en: A deal you recently passed — why, and did it prove right?

followups.zh: 尽调里最容易被卖方藏起来的是什么？
followups.en: What does the seller most often hide in diligence?

screens.zh: 项目统筹力，把多条尽调线、外部顾问的意见和模型收敛成一份能过会的备忘录。
screens.en: Deal quarterbacking — converging workstreams, advisors and models into a memo that survives committee.

asks.zh: 你怎么协调财务、商业、法律几条尽调线并管好时间表？
asks.en: How do you coordinate the financial, commercial and legal workstreams and hold the timeline?

asks.zh: 投委会最可能挑战这个 deal 哪里，你怎么提前堵？
asks.en: Where will the committee attack this deal, and how do you pre-empt it?

asks.zh: 一条尽调线出了红旗但 deal 你看好，你怎么处理？
asks.en: A workstream throws a red flag but you like the deal — how do you handle it?

insider.zh: 强的人站在投委会角度提前预判问题、把备忘录打磨到没有软肋，弱的人只做汇总。
insider.en: Strong VPs pre-empt the committee's objections and harden the memo; weak ones just aggregate the workstreams.

followups.zh: 交易结构和估值你怎么和对方谈？
followups.en: How do you negotiate structure and valuation with the other side?

followups.zh: 顾问和你判断不一致时你听谁的？
followups.en: When an advisor disagrees with you, whose call wins?

screens.zh: 谈判落地力和投后驱动力，把关键条款谈成、把被投公司往目标推。
screens.en: Closes key terms and drives the portfolio company toward the plan.

asks.zh: 讲一个你主导谈成或谈崩的交易，关键卡点在哪？
asks.en: Describe a deal you closed or lost — what was the sticking point?

asks.zh: 被投公司管理层不配合你的价值创造计划，你怎么办？
asks.en: Portfolio management resists your value-creation plan — what do you do?

asks.zh: 你自有的 sourcing 渠道有哪些？
asks.en: What proprietary sourcing channels do you bring?

insider.zh: 强的人既能谈成交易又能在董事会真正影响公司，弱的人只在纸面上做交易。
insider.en: Strong principals both close and actually move the company at the board; weak ones just do paper deals.

followups.zh: 你怎么判断一个 CEO 该换还是该扶？
followups.en: How do you decide whether to replace or back a CEO?

followups.zh: 你带来的 deal flow 有多少最终成交？
followups.en: Of the deal flow you sourced, how much actually closed?

screens.zh: 投资判断的历史业绩、能不能募到钱、能不能带团队、为过往业绩负责。
screens.en: Track record of judgment, ability to raise, and to lead the team and own the record.

asks.zh: 讲一个你力排众议投或否的 deal，结果如何？
asks.en: A deal you pushed through or killed against the room — how did it turn out?

asks.zh: 你的 track record 和回报大概什么水平？
asks.en: What's your track record and returns (DPI and IRR)?

asks.zh: 你怎么和 LP 建立信任、募下一期？
asks.en: How do you build LP trust and raise the next fund?

asks.zh: 团队里一个明星 associate 想走，你怎么留？
asks.en: A star associate wants to leave — how do you retain them?

insider.zh: 强的人敢讲自己看走眼的项目和从中学到什么，弱的人只报业绩不谈失手。
insider.en: Strong partners own the deals they got wrong and what they learned; weak ones only cite winners.

followups.zh: 你的 alpha 到底来自 sourcing、判断还是投后？
followups.en: Does your alpha come from sourcing, judgment or portfolio work?

followups.zh: 市场变了，你的策略怎么调整？
followups.en: The market shifts — how do you adjust strategy?

screens.zh: 行业看得深、能提出可投资的主题、把标的地图画准。
screens.en: Deep sector insight, generates investable theses, maps targets accurately.

asks.zh: 你覆盖的行业，现在最值得投的主题是什么，为什么？
asks.en: In your sector, what's the most investable theme right now, and why?

asks.zh: 你怎么建一个行业的标的地图和优先级？
asks.en: How do you build a target map and rank it for a sector?

asks.zh: 一个热门赛道你为什么反而看空？
asks.en: A hot space you're actually bearish on — why?

insider.zh: 强的人的行业观点能直接转成可落地的投资主题，弱的人只做行业综述不落到标的。
insider.en: Strong sector analysts turn a view into an investable thesis; weak ones write summaries that never reach a target.

followups.zh: 你的判断和卖方研究不同在哪？
followups.en: Where does your read diverge from sell-side research?

followups.zh: 这个主题最大的风险变量是什么？
followups.en: What's the biggest risk variable in that thesis?

screens.zh: 能不能穿透账目、还原真实盈利质量、找出被粉饰的地方。
screens.en: Sees through the books, normalizes true earnings quality, catches what's dressed up.

asks.zh: QoE 里你怎么调整一次性和非经常性项目？
asks.en: In a QoE, how do you adjust one-time and non-recurring items?

asks.zh: 你发现过哪种常见的盈利粉饰手法？
asks.en: What earnings-dressing tricks have you caught?

asks.zh: 净负债和营运资本调整怎么影响成交价？
asks.en: How do net-debt and working-capital adjustments move the price?

insider.zh: 强的人知道 EBITDA 最容易在哪里被做高并逐笔盘问，弱的人只做数字勾稽。
insider.en: Strong FDD knows where EBITDA gets inflated and interrogates it line by line; weak ones just tie out the numbers.

followups.zh: 营运资本正常水平你怎么定，对价款有什么影响？
followups.en: How do you set a normalized working-capital level, and how does it hit the price?

screens.zh: 能不能验证投资逻辑赖以成立的市场规模、竞争格局和客户留存。
screens.en: Validates market size, competitive position and customer retention that the thesis rests on.

asks.zh: 你怎么验证一个市场的真实规模和增速？
asks.en: How do you validate a market's real size and growth?

asks.zh: 客户访谈里你怎么问出真实的留存和转换意愿？
asks.en: In customer interviews, how do you surface real retention and switching intent?

asks.zh: 尽调结论和管理层说法冲突，你怎么呈现？
asks.en: Your findings contradict management's story — how do you present it?

insider.zh: 强的人用客户访谈的一手证据证伪投资逻辑，弱的人堆二手市场报告凑页数。
insider.en: Strong CDD tests the thesis with primary customer evidence; weak ones pad the deck with secondary reports.

followups.zh: 这个增长故事里最脆弱的假设是哪个？
followups.en: Which assumption in the growth story is weakest?

screens.zh: 能不能找出致命法律风险、把条款谈到保护买方、SPA 起草滴水不漏。
screens.en: Surfaces deal-killing legal risk, negotiates protective terms, drafts a tight SPA.

asks.zh: 尽调里发现一个或有负债或诉讼，你怎么处置？
asks.en: You find a contingent liability or litigation in diligence — how do you deal with it?

asks.zh: SPA 里陈述保证和赔偿条款你怎么设计保护买方？
asks.en: How do you design reps, warranties and indemnities to protect the buyer?

asks.zh: 交割先决条件你会重点放哪些？
asks.en: Which conditions precedent do you focus on?

insider.zh: 强的人分得清哪些是真能杀死交易的风险、哪些用条款能兜住，弱的人把所有风险都标红吓退交易。
insider.en: Strong counsel separates deal-killers from risks that terms can cover; weak ones flag everything red and scare the deal off.

followups.zh: 竞业、知识产权、监管审批哪个你最先查？
followups.en: Non-compete, IP or regulatory approval — which do you check first?

screens.zh: 能不能真的下到被投公司，把增长和降本落地、和管理层一起把业绩做出来。
screens.en: Actually goes into the company, lands growth and cost plans, and lifts performance with management.

asks.zh: 讲一个你带被投公司做出的具体价值创造成果，数字是多少？
asks.en: Describe a concrete value-creation result you drove — what were the numbers?

asks.zh: 管理层抵触你的改造，你怎么推动？
asks.en: Management resists your changes — how do you push it through?

asks.zh: 你的 100 天计划一般抓哪几件事？
asks.en: What does your first-100-days plan focus on?

insider.zh: 强的人撸起袖子和管理层一起干出结果，弱的人只坐在董事会提建议。
insider.en: Strong operating partners roll up their sleeves and deliver with management; weak ones just advise from the board seat.

followups.zh: 你怎么把自己创造的价值和市场大盘涨跌区分开？
followups.en: How do you separate the value you created from market beta?

screens.zh: 能不能募到钱，把业绩讲成 LP 信得过的故事、维护 LP 关系、跑通募资流程。
screens.en: Can raise — turns performance into an LP-credible story, manages relationships, runs the raise.

asks.zh: 业绩不算亮眼的一期基金，你怎么向 LP 讲故事募下一期？
asks.en: A middling fund vintage — how do you tell the story to raise the next one?

asks.zh: 你维护和开发过哪些类型的 LP？
asks.en: What types of LPs have you built and maintained?

asks.zh: LP 尽调最常挑战你们哪里，你怎么答？
asks.en: Where do LPs push hardest in diligence, and how do you answer?

insider.zh: 强的人能把业绩诚实地讲成 LP 信得过的故事，弱的人只报漂亮数字回避难题。
insider.en: Strong IR frames performance honestly into a story LPs trust; weak ones pitch the good numbers and dodge the hard questions.

followups.zh: 关键 LP 决定不再跟投，你怎么应对？
followups.en: A key LP decides not to re-up — how do you respond?

screens.zh: 基金核算准、资本召集和分配算得对、NAV 和 LP 报表经得起审计。
screens.en: Accurate fund accounting, correct calls and distributions, audit-proof NAV and LP statements.

asks.zh: 分配瀑布和 carry 你怎么算？
asks.en: How do you calculate the distribution waterfall and carry?

asks.zh: 估值和 NAV 你怎么保证经得起审计？
asks.en: How do you make NAV and valuations audit-proof?

asks.zh: 管理费和费用分摊你怎么处理？
asks.en: How do you handle management fees and expense allocation?

insider.zh: 强的人吃透 LPA 里瀑布和 carry 的每条约定并算得分毫不差，弱的人只做常规记账。
insider.en: Strong controllers master the waterfall and carry terms in the LPA to the letter; weak ones just keep the books.

followups.zh: 一笔跨期分配算错了你怎么发现和更正？
followups.en: A distribution was miscalculated across periods — how do you catch and correct it?

screens.zh: 能把被投公司经营数据变成可信的季度估值和回报跟踪、及早发现异常。
screens.en: Turns portfolio operating data into credible quarterly valuations and returns, and flags trouble early.

asks.zh: 一家非上市被投公司，你用什么方法估值，可比公司怎么选？
asks.en: How do you value a private portfolio company, and how do you pick comparables?

asks.zh: 你怎么从季度经营数据里发现一家公司要出问题？
asks.en: How do you spot a company heading for trouble in its quarterly data?

asks.zh: IRR 和 MOIC 你怎么算，时间加权和资金加权有什么区别？
asks.en: How do you compute IRR and MOIC, and how do time- and money-weighted differ?

insider.zh: 强的人能从数字趋势里提前嗅出被投公司的风险，弱的人只按季度填估值表。
insider.en: Strong monitors sniff out portfolio risk from the data trend early; weak ones just fill the quarterly valuation sheet.

followups.zh: 估值假设被审计或 LP 质疑，你怎么支撑？
followups.en: When auditors or LPs challenge a valuation assumption, how do you defend it?
